```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getFormatter, getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { MerchantReview, NotedAction } from '@/components/admin/AdminClient';
import { inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('admin'))('title') };
}

interface Zone {
  h3_cell: string;
  active: number;
  hidden: number;
  open_reports: number;
  moderators: number;
}

const statsSchema = z.object({
  users: z.number(),
  banned: z.number(),
  active_videos: z.number(),
  hidden_videos: z.number(),
  open_reports: z.number(),
  pending_appeals: z.number(),
  pending_merchants: z.number(),
  zones: z.array(
    z.object({
      h3_cell: z.string(),
      active: z.number(),
      hidden: z.number(),
      open_reports: z.number(),
      moderators: z.number(),
    }),
  ),
});

const STAT_KEYS = [
  'users',
  'banned',
  'active_videos',
  'hidden_videos',
  'open_reports',
  'pending_appeals',
  'pending_merchants',
] as const;
const STAT_LINKS: Partial<Record<(typeof STAT_KEYS)[number], string>> = {
  active_videos: '/moderation',
  hidden_videos: '/moderation',
  open_reports: '/moderation',
  pending_appeals: '/moderation#appeals-title',
  pending_merchants: '#merchants',
};
const REVERTIBLE = new Set(['hide', 'remove', 'auto_hide', 'validate', 'warn', 'ban']);
const AUDIT_KINDS = [
  'validate',
  'hide',
  'remove',
  'warn',
  'auto_hide',
  'revert',
  'ban',
  'unban',
  'appeal_upheld',
  'appeal_rejected',
] as const;

export default async function AdminPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    q?: string;
    page?: string;
    auditPage?: string;
    action?: string;
    actor?: string;
    target?: string;
    since?: string;
  }>;
}) {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (viewer?.role !== 'admin') notFound();
  const {
    q,
    page: pageParam,
    auditPage: auditPageParam,
    action,
    actor,
    target,
    since,
  } = await searchParams;
  const admin = adminClient();
  const search = (q ?? '')
    .trim()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, '')
    .slice(0, 80);
  const page = /^\d+$/.test(pageParam ?? '') ? Math.min(Number(pageParam), 1000) : 0;
  const pageSize = 20;
  const userOffset = page * pageSize;
  const auditPage = /^\d+$/.test(auditPageParam ?? '') ? Math.min(Number(auditPageParam), 1000) : 0;
  const auditOffset = auditPage * pageSize;
  const auditKind = AUDIT_KINDS.find((kind) => kind === action);
  const auditActor = /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(actor ?? '') ? actor : undefined;
  const auditTarget = ['user', 'video', 'zone', 'system'].includes(target ?? '') ? target : '';
  const auditSince =
    /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(since ?? '') && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(`${since}T00:00:00.000Z`))
      ? since
      : undefined;
  const userColumns = 'id, username, role, reputation, banned_at';

  let auditQuery = admin
    .from('moderation_actions')
    .select('id, kind, note, created_at, actor_id, target_user_id, video_id, h3_cell', {
      count: 'exact',
    })
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .order('id', { ascending: false });
  if (auditKind) auditQuery = auditQuery.eq('kind', auditKind);
  if (auditActor) auditQuery = auditQuery.eq('actor_id', auditActor);
  if (auditSince) auditQuery = auditQuery.gte('created_at', `${auditSince}T00:00:00.000Z`);
  if (auditTarget === 'user') auditQuery = auditQuery.not('target_user_id', 'is', null);
  if (auditTarget === 'video') auditQuery = auditQuery.not('video_id', 'is', null);
  if (auditTarget === 'zone') auditQuery = auditQuery.not('h3_cell', 'is', null);
  if (auditTarget === 'system') {
    auditQuery = auditQuery.is('target_user_id', null).is('video_id', null).is('h3_cell', null);
  }
  auditQuery = auditQuery.range(auditOffset, auditOffset + pageSize - 1);

  const [stats, processingVideos, merchants, users, actions, t, tk, tc, format] = await Promise.all(
    [
      admin.rpc('admin_stats', { p_admin: viewer.id }),
      admin
        .from('videos')
        .select('id, author_id, category, caption, created_at', { count: 'exact' })
        .eq('status', 'processing')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
        .limit(20),
      admin
        .from('merchant_profiles')
        .select('user_id, business_name, description, created_at')
        .eq('status', 'pending')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
        .limit(20),
      search
        ? /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(search)
          ? admin
              .from('profiles')
              .select(userColumns)
              .eq('id', search)
              .range(userOffset, userOffset + pageSize - 1)
          : admin
              .from('profiles')
              .select(userColumns, { count: 'exact' })
              .ilike('username', `%${search}%`)
              .order('username')
              .range(userOffset, userOffset + pageSize - 1)
        : admin
            .from('profiles')
            .select(userColumns, { count: 'exact' })
            .not('banned_at', 'is', null)
            .order('username')
            .range(userOffset, userOffset + pageSize - 1),
      auditQuery,
      getTranslations('admin'),
      getTranslations('moderation.decisions.kinds'),
      getTranslations('common.categories'),
      getFormatter(),
    ],
  );

  const parsedStats = statsSchema.safeParse(stats.data);
  if (
    stats.error ||
    processingVideos.error ||
    merchants.error ||
    users.error ||
    actions.error ||
    !parsedStats.success
  ) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-5 p-4 sm:p-6">
        <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
        <Notice kind="error">{t('loadError')}</Notice>
        <Link href="/admin" className="w-fit font-semibold text-accent underline">
          {t('refresh')}
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const actionRows = actions.data;
  const profileIds = [
    ...new Set([
      ...processingVideos.data.map((video) => video.author_id),
      ...actionRows.flatMap((action) =>
        [action.actor_id, action.target_user_id].filter((id): id is string => id !== null),
      ),
      ...merchants.data.map((merchant) => merchant.user_id),
    ]),
  ];
  const videoIds = processingVideos.data.map((video) => video.id);
  const [actionProfiles, processingJobs] = await Promise.all([
    profileIds.length > 0
      ? admin.from('profiles').select('id, username').in('id', profileIds)
      : Promise.resolve(null),
    videoIds.length > 0
      ? admin
          .from('media_jobs')
          .select('video_id, status, attempts, max_attempts, updated_at')
          .eq('kind', 'process')
          .in('video_id', videoIds)
          .order('updated_at', { ascending: false })
      : Promise.resolve(null),
  ]);
  if (actionProfiles?.error || processingJobs?.error) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-5xl flex-col gap-5 p-4 sm:p-6">
        <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
        <Notice kind="error">{t('loadError')}</Notice>
        <Link href="/admin" className="w-fit font-semibold text-accent underline">
          {t('refresh')}
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const profileNames = new Map(
    (actionProfiles?.data ?? []).map((profile) => [profile.id, profile.username]),
  );
  const latestJobByVideo = new Map<string, NonNullable<typeof processingJobs>['data'][number]>();
  for (const job of processingJobs?.data ?? []) {
    if (job.video_id && !latestJobByVideo.has(job.video_id)) {
      latestJobByVideo.set(job.video_id, job);
    }
  }
  const { zones } = parsedStats.data;
  const auditParams = new URLSearchParams({
    ...(search ? { q: search } : {}),
    ...(auditKind ? { action: auditKind } : {}),
    ...(auditActor ? { actor: auditActor } : {}),
    ...(auditTarget ? { target: auditTarget } : {}),
    ...(auditSince ? { since: auditSince } : {}),
  });
  const userPageHref = (nextPage: number) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({ ...(search ? { q: search } : {}) });
    params.set('page', String(nextPage));
    return `/admin?${params}#users`;
  };
  const auditPageHref = (nextPage: number) => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(auditParams);
    params.set('auditPage', String(nextPage));
    return `/admin?${params}#actions`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col gap-8 p-4 pb-[calc(6rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))] sm:p-6">
      <header className="flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-line pb-6 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:justify-between">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent">
            Neighbors Live
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 max-w-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
        </div>
        <Link
          href="/moderation"
          className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 py-2 font-semibold text-ink"
        >
          {t('openModeration')}
        </Link>
      </header>

      <nav
        aria-label={t('navigation')}
        className="sticky top-0 z-20 -mx-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto border-b border-line bg-ink/95 px-4 py-2 backdrop-blur sm:static sm:mx-0 sm:flex-wrap sm:overflow-visible sm:border-0 sm:bg-transparent sm:p-0"
      >
        {(['overview', 'processingVideos', 'zones', 'merchants', 'users', 'actions'] as const).map(
          (key) => (
            <a
              key={key}
              href={`#${key}`}
              className="min-h-10 shrink-0 rounded-full border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:border-accent focus-visible:outline-accent"
            >
              {t(key)}
            </a>
          ),
        )}
      </nav>

      <section
        id="overview"
        aria-labelledby="overview-title"
        className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3"
      >
        <h2 id="overview-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {t('overview')}
        </h2>
        <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4">
          {STAT_KEYS.map((key) => {
            const href = STAT_LINKS[key];
            return (
              <div
                key={key}
                className={`rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4 ${href ? 'transition-colors hover:border-accent' : ''}`}
              >
                <dt className="text-sm leading-snug text-fog">{t(`stats.${key}`)}</dt>
                <dd className="mt-2 text-3xl font-bold tabular-nums">
                  {href ? (
                    <Link href={href} className="rounded-sm focus-visible:underline">
                      {parsedStats.data[key].toLocaleString('fr-FR')}
                      <span className="mt-2 block text-xs font-semibold text-accent">
                        {t('view')}
                      </span>
                    </Link>
                  ) : (
                    parsedStats.data[key].toLocaleString('fr-FR')
                  )}
                </dd>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </dl>
      </section>

      <section
        id="processingVideos"
        aria-labelledby="processing-videos-title"
        className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="processing-videos-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('processingVideos')}
            <span className="ml-2 rounded-full bg-sky-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-sm text-sky-700">
              {(processingVideos.count ?? processingVideos.data.length).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}
            </span>
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('processingVideosHint')}</p>
        </div>
        {processingVideos.data.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-fog">
            {t('emptyProcessingVideos')}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            {processingVideos.data.map((video) => {
              const job = latestJobByVideo.get(video.id);
              const author = profileNames.get(video.author_id);
              return (
                <li
                  key={video.id}
                  className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                  data-testid="processing-video"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="truncate text-sm">
                      <strong>{tc(video.category)}</strong> · {video.caption || '—'}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-fog">
                      {t('processingVideoAuthor', {
                        username: author ? `@${author}` : video.author_id.slice(0, 8),
                      })}
                      {' · '}
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(video.created_at), {
                        dateStyle: 'medium',
                        timeStyle: 'short',
                      })}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="shrink-0 text-sm sm:text-right">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-sky-700">{t('videoStatusProcessing')}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                      {job ? (
                        <>
                          {t(`jobStatus.${job.status}`)}
                          {' · '}
                          {t('jobAttempts', {
                            attempts: job.attempts,
                            maxAttempts: job.max_attempts,
                          })}
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        t('noProcessingJob')
                      )}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <section id="zones" aria-labelledby="zones" className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div>
          <h2 id="zones" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('zones')}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('zonesHint')}</p>
        </div>
        {zones.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-fog">{t('emptyZones')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
            {zones.slice(0, 15).map((zone: Zone) => (
              <li
                key={zone.h3_cell}
                className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3"
              >
                <Link
                  href={`/moderation?cell=${zone.h3_cell}`}
                  className="shrink-0 font-mono font-semibold text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
                >
                  {t('zone', { short: zone.h3_cell.slice(3, 9) })}
                </Link>
                <span className="text-right text-sm text-fog">
                  {t('zoneRow', {
                    active: zone.active,
                    hidden: zone.hidden,
                    reports: zone.open_reports,
                    mods: zone.moderators,
                  })}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <section
        id="merchants"
        aria-labelledby="merchants-title"
        className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="merchants-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('merchants')}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('merchantsHint')}</p>
        </div>
        {merchants.data.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-fog">
            {t('emptyMerchants')}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-3 lg:grid-cols-2">
            {merchants.data.map((merchant) => (
              <li key={merchant.user_id}>
                <MerchantReview
                  userId={merchant.user_id}
                  name={merchant.business_name}
                  applicant={profileNames.get(merchant.user_id) ?? merchant.user_id.slice(0, 8)}
                  description={merchant.description}
                  submittedAt={format.dateTime(new Date(merchant.created_at), {
                    dateStyle: 'medium',
                    timeStyle: 'short',
                  })}
                />
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      <section
        id="users"
        aria-labelledby="users-title"
        className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="users-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('users')}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{search ? t('searchResults') : t('suspendedHint')}</p>
        </div>
        <form className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row" role="search">
          <label htmlFor="q" className="sr-only">
            {t('search')}
          </label>
          <input
            id="q"
            name="q"
            defaultValue={q}
            placeholder={t('search')}
            className={inputClass}
            autoComplete="off"
          />
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-line px-4 font-semibold hover:border-accent"
          >
            {t('searchSubmit')}
          </button>
        </form>
        {users.data.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-fog">
            {search ? t('noUsers') : t('noSuspended')}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid gap-2 md:grid-cols-2">
            {users.data.map((user) => (
              <li key={user.id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line p-4">
                <p className="text-sm">
                  <strong>@{user.username}</strong> · {t(`roles.${user.role}`)} ·{' '}
                  {t('reputation', { value: user.reputation })}
                  {user.banned_at && (
                    <span className="font-semibold text-alert"> · {t('banned')}</span>
                  )}
                </p>
                {user.id !== viewer.id && (
                  <NotedAction
                    label={user.banned_at ? t('unban') : t('ban')}
                    variant={user.banned_at ? 'secondary' : 'danger'}
                    body={{ type: 'ban', userId: user.id, banned: !user.banned_at }}
                  />
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {(users.count ?? 0) > pageSize && (
          <nav aria-label={t('userPagination')} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            <span className="text-sm text-fog">
              {t('pageOf', {
                page: page + 1,
                pages: Math.ceil((users.count ?? 0) / pageSize),
              })}
            </span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {page > 0 && (
                <Link
                  className="rounded-lg border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  href={userPageHref(page - 1)}
                >
                  {t('previous')}
                </Link>
              )}
              {userOffset + users.data.length < (users.count ?? 0) && (
                <Link
                  className="rounded-lg border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  href={userPageHref(page + 1)}
                >
                  {t('next')}
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>
          </nav>
        )}
      </section>

      <section
        id="actions"
        aria-labelledby="actions-title"
        className="scroll-mt-20 flex flex-col gap-3"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="actions-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {t('actions')}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('actionsHint')}</p>
        </div>
        <form action="/admin" method="get" className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('filterAction')}</span>
            <select name="action" defaultValue={auditKind ?? ''} className={inputClass}>
              <option value="">{t('allActions')}</option>
              {AUDIT_KINDS.map((kind) => (
                <option key={kind} value={kind}>
                  {tk(kind)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('filterActor')}</span>
            <input
              name="actor"
              defaultValue={auditActor}
              className={inputClass}
              placeholder={t('actorId')}
            />
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('filterTarget')}</span>
            <select name="target" defaultValue={auditTarget} className={inputClass}>
              <option value="">{t('allTargets')}</option>
              {(['user', 'video', 'zone', 'system'] as const).map((kind) => (
                <option key={kind} value={kind}>
                  {t(`targetTypes.${kind}`)}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          <label className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
            <span>{t('since')}</span>
            <input type="date" name="since" defaultValue={auditSince} className={inputClass} />
          </label>
          <div className="flex items-end gap-2">
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-line px-4 font-semibold hover:border-accent"
            >
              {t('applyFilters')}
            </button>
            <Link href="/admin#actions" className="min-h-11 content-center px-2 text-sm underline">
              {t('clearFilters')}
            </Link>
          </div>
        </form>
        {actionRows.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-line p-4 text-sm text-fog">{t('emptyActions')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ol className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {actionRows.map((action) => {
              const actor = action.actor_id
                ? (profileNames.get(action.actor_id) ?? action.actor_id.slice(0, 8))
                : t('system');
              const target = action.target_user_id
                ? (profileNames.get(action.target_user_id) ?? action.target_user_id.slice(0, 8))
                : null;
              return (
                <li
                  key={action.id}
                  className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line p-4"
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 text-sm">
                    <p className="font-semibold">
                      {tk(action.kind)} ·{' '}
                      {format.dateTime(new Date(action.created_at), {
                        dateStyle: 'medium',
                        timeStyle: 'short',
                      })}
                    </p>
                    <p className="text-fog">
                      {t('auditActor', { actor })}
                      {target && (
                        <>
                          {' · '}
                          {t('auditTarget', { target })}
                        </>
                      )}
                      {action.h3_cell && (
                        <>
                          {' · '}
                          <Link
                            href={`/moderation?cell=${action.h3_cell}`}
                            className="underline underline-offset-4"
                          >
                            {t('zone', { short: action.h3_cell.slice(3, 9) })}
                          </Link>
                        </>
                      )}
                      {action.video_id && (
                        <>
                          {' · '}
                          <Link
                            href={`/moderation?video=${action.video_id}`}
                            className="underline underline-offset-4"
                          >
                            {t('viewVideo')}
                          </Link>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </p>
                    {action.note && <p className="break-words text-fog">{action.note}</p>}
                  </div>
                  {REVERTIBLE.has(action.kind) && (
                    <NotedAction
                      label={t('revert')}
                      body={{ type: 'revert', actionId: action.id }}
                    />
                  )}
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        )}
        {(actions.count ?? 0) > pageSize && (
          <nav
            aria-label={t('auditPagination')}
            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"
          >
            <span className="text-sm text-fog">
              {t('pageOf', {
                page: auditPage + 1,
                pages: Math.ceil((actions.count ?? 0) / pageSize),
              })}
            </span>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {auditPage > 0 && (
                <Link
                  className="rounded-lg border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  href={auditPageHref(auditPage - 1)}
                >
                  {t('previous')}
                </Link>
              )}
              {auditOffset + actionRows.length < (actions.count ?? 0) && (
                <Link
                  className="rounded-lg border border-line px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  href={auditPageHref(auditPage + 1)}
                >
                  {t('next')}
                </Link>
              )}
            </div>
          </nav>
        )}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { MerchantForm } from '@/components/merchant/MerchantForm';
import { Card, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('merchant'))('title') };
}

async function merchantQuota(userId: string) {
  const admin = adminClient();
  const since = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 3_600_000).toISOString();
  const [{ count }, own, config] = await Promise.all([
    admin
      .from('videos')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('author_id', userId)
      .eq('is_merchant', true)
      .gt('created_at', since),
    admin.from('merchant_profiles').select('daily_quota').eq('user_id', userId).single(),
    admin.from('app_config').select('value').eq('key', 'merchant_daily_quota').single(),
  ]);
  return { used: count ?? 0, quota: own.data?.daily_quota ?? Number(config.data?.value ?? 3) };
}

export default async function MerchantPage() {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect('/login?next=/commerce');
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const t = await getTranslations('merchant');
  const { data: merchant } = await supabase
    .from('merchant_profiles')
    .select('business_name, status')
    .eq('user_id', viewer.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  const quota = merchant?.status === 'approved' ? await merchantQuota(viewer.id) : null;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col gap-4 p-4">
      <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
      <p className="text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
      <Link
        href="/commerces"
        className="text-sm font-semibold text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
      >
        {t('learnMore')}
      </Link>
      <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {!merchant && (
          <>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('apply')}</h2>
            <MerchantForm />
          </>
        )}
        {merchant?.status === 'pending' && <Notice>{t('pending')}</Notice>}
        {merchant?.status === 'rejected' && <Notice kind="error">{t('rejected')}</Notice>}
        {merchant?.status === 'approved' && quota && (
          <>
            <Notice kind="success">
              {t('approved')} — {merchant.business_name}
            </Notice>
            <p>{t('quota', quota)}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('rules')}</p>
            {quota.used < quota.quota && (
              <Link
                href="/filmer"
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 font-semibold text-ink"
              >
                {t('publish')}
              </Link>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { Decisions, type Decision } from '@/components/moderation/Decisions';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const APPEALABLE = new Set(['hide', 'remove', 'warn', 'auto_hide']);

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('moderation.decisions'))('title') };
}

export default async function DecisionsPage() {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect('/login?next=/me/decisions');
  const supabase = await createClient();
  // RLS: only decisions targeting the viewer and their own appeals are visible.
  const [actions, appeals, t] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from('moderation_actions')
      .select('id, kind, note, created_at')
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(50),
    supabase.from('appeals').select('action_id, status'),
    getTranslations('moderation.decisions'),
  ]);
  const appealByAction = new Map((appeals.data ?? []).map((a) => [a.action_id, a.status]));
  const items: Decision[] = (actions.data ?? []).map((a) => ({
    id: a.id,
    kind: a.kind,
    note: a.note,
    createdAt: a.created_at,
    appealStatus: appealByAction.get(a.id) ?? null,
    appealable: APPEALABLE.has(a.kind),
  }));
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col gap-4 p-4">
      <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
      <Decisions items={items} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import {
  AppealsQueue,
  ApplyForm,
  ModerationQueue,
  type AppealItem,
  type QueueItem,
} from '@/components/moderation/ModerationClient';
import { signMedia } from '@/lib/media';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  return { title: (await getTranslations('moderation'))('title') };
}

export default async function ModerationPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ cell?: string; video?: string }>;
}) {
  const viewer = await getViewer();
  if (!viewer) redirect('/login?next=/moderation');
  const t = await getTranslations('moderation');
  const admin = adminClient();

  if (!viewer.isModerator) {
    const [eligible, own] = await Promise.all([
      admin.rpc('moderator_eligible', { p_user: viewer.id }),
      admin
        .from('videos')
        .select('h3_cell')
        .eq('author_id', viewer.id)
        .in('status', ['active', 'expired']),
    ]);
    const cells = [...new Set((own.data ?? []).map((v) => v.h3_cell))];
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col gap-4 p-4">
        <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
        <p className="text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
        <ApplyForm eligible={Boolean(eligible.data)} cells={cells} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Zones: the moderator's cells (admins: every cell with something to review).
  const pendingQuery = admin
    .from('videos')
    .select('h3_cell')
    .or('status.eq.hidden,and(status.eq.active,report_count.gt.0)');
  const { data: pendingRows } =
    viewer.role === 'admin'
      ? await pendingQuery
      : await pendingQuery.in('h3_cell', viewer.moderatedCells);
  const pending = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of pendingRows ?? []) pending.set(r.h3_cell, (pending.get(r.h3_cell) ?? 0) + 1);
  const cells = [...new Set([...pending.keys(), ...viewer.moderatedCells])].sort(
    (a, b) => (pending.get(b) ?? 0) - (pending.get(a) ?? 0),
  );
  const { cell: requestedCell, video } = await searchParams;
  let requested = requestedCell;
  if (video && /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/.test(video)) {
    // Deep link from a notification or the admin dashboard: open the video's zone.
    const { data } = await admin.from('videos').select('h3_cell').eq('id', video).maybeSingle();
    requested = data?.h3_cell ?? requested;
    if (requested && viewer.role === 'admin' && !cells.includes(requested))
      cells.unshift(requested);
  }
  const cell = requested && cells.includes(requested) ? requested : cells[0];

  const [queueRes, appealsRes] = await Promise.all([
    cell ? admin.rpc('moderation_queue', { p_actor: viewer.id, p_cell: cell }) : null,
    admin.rpc('appeals_queue', { p_reviewer: viewer.id }),
  ]);
  const queueRows = queueRes?.data ?? [];
  const appealRows = appealsRes.data ?? [];
  const urls = await signMedia(
    [...queueRows, ...appealRows].flatMap((r) => [r.video_path, r.poster_path]),
  );
  const url = (p: string | null) => (p ? (urls.get(p) ?? null) : null);

  const queue: QueueItem[] = queueRows.map((r) => ({
    videoId: r.video_id,
    category: r.category,
    caption: r.caption,
    status: r.status,
    hiddenReason: r.hidden_reason,
    reportCount: r.report_count,
    reasons: r.reasons ?? [],
    author: r.author_username,
    videoUrl: url(r.video_path),
    posterUrl: url(r.poster_path),
  }));
  const appeals: AppealItem[] = appealRows.map((a) => ({
    appealId: a.appeal_id,
    reason: a.reason,
    actionKind: a.action_kind,
    actionNote: a.action_note,
    caption: a.caption,
    videoUrl: url(a.video_path),
    posterUrl: url(a.poster_path),
  }));

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col gap-5 p-4">
      <h1 className="pt-4 text-2xl font-bold">{t('title')}</h1>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
      <nav aria-label={t('zones')} className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {cells.slice(0, 12).map((c) => (
          <Link
            key={c}
            href={`/moderation?cell=${c}`}
            aria-current={c === cell ? 'page' : undefined}
            className={`rounded-full border px-3 py-1.5 text-sm ${c === cell ? 'border-accent bg-accent text-ink' : 'border-line'}`}
          >
            {t('zone', { short: c.slice(3, 9) })} {pending.get(c) ? `(${pending.get(c)})` : ''}
          </Link>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <section aria-labelledby="queue-title" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 id="queue-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {t('queue')}
        </h2>
        <ModerationQueue items={queue} />
      </section>
      <section aria-labelledby="appeals-title" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 id="appeals-title" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {t('appeals')}
        </h2>
        <AppealsQueue items={appeals} />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getFormatter, getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { MyVideos } from '@/components/profile/MyVideos';
import { signMedia } from '@/lib/media';
import { getViewer } from '@/lib/session';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

type Params = { params: Promise<{ username: string }> };

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { username } = await params;
  return { title: (await getTranslations('profile'))('title', { username }) };
}

export default async function ProfilePage({ params }: Params) {
  const { username } = await params;
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: profile } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id, username, bio, avatar_color, role, reputation, created_at')
    .eq('username', decodeURIComponent(username).toLowerCase())
    .is('banned_at', null)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!profile) notFound();

  const [viewer, zones, videos, t, tc, format] = await Promise.all([
    getViewer(),
    admin
      .from('zone_moderators')
      .select('h3_cell', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('user_id', profile.id),
    admin
      .from('videos')
      .select('id, category, caption, poster_path')
      .eq('author_id', profile.id)
      .eq('status', 'active')
      .gt('expires_at', new Date().toISOString())
      .order('published_at', { ascending: false })
      .limit(30),
    getTranslations('profile'),
    getTranslations('common'),
    getFormatter(),
  ]);
  const isOwner = viewer?.id === profile.id;
  const list = videos.data ?? [];
  const posters = await signMedia(list.map((v) => v.poster_path));
  const isModerator = (zones.count ?? 0) > 0;
  const since = format.dateTime(new Date(profile.created_at), { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' });

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col gap-6 p-4">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-4 pt-4">
        <Avatar username={profile.username} color={profile.avatar_color} size={72} />
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
          <h1 className="truncate text-2xl font-bold">@{profile.username}</h1>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
            {isModerator && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-accent px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold text-ink">
                {tc('badges.moderator')}
              </span>
            )}
            {profile.role === 'merchant' && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold text-ink">
                {tc('badges.merchant')}
              </span>
            )}
            {profile.role === 'admin' && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-fog px-2 py-0.5 font-semibold text-ink">
                {tc('badges.admin')}
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">
            {t('reputation')} : <strong className="text-white">{profile.reputation}</strong> ·{' '}
            {t('memberSince', { date: since })}
          </p>
        </div>
      </header>
      {profile.bio && <p className="whitespace-pre-line">{profile.bio}</p>}
      {isOwner && (
        <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-sm">
          <Link href="/parametres" className="rounded-xl border border-line px-3 py-2">
            {t('edit')}
          </Link>
          <Link href="/me/decisions" className="rounded-xl border border-line px-3 py-2">
            {t('decisions')}
          </Link>
        </nav>
      )}

      <section aria-labelledby="active-videos" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 id="active-videos" className="text-lg font-semibold">
          {t('activeVideos')}
        </h2>
        {list.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-fog">{t('noVideos')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
            {list.map((v) => {
              const poster = v.poster_path ? posters.get(v.poster_path) : undefined;
              return (
                <li key={v.id}>
                  <Link
                    href={`/v/${v.id}`}
                    className="relative block aspect-[9/16] overflow-hidden rounded-xl bg-panel"
                  >
                    {poster && (
                      // eslint-disable-next-line @next/next/no-img-element -- short-lived signed URL
                      <img
                        src={poster}
                        alt=""
                        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
                        loading="lazy"
                      />
                    )}
                    <span className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 p-1.5 text-[11px] leading-tight">
                      <span className="font-semibold">{tc(`categories.${v.category}`)}</span>
                      <span className="line-clamp-2 block text-fog">{v.caption}</span>
                    </span>
                  </Link>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
        )}
      </section>

      {isOwner && <MyVideos />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { sanitizeText } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const note = z.string().transform(sanitizeText).pipe(z.string().min(3).max(1000));

const schema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  z.object({ type: z.literal('ban'), userId: z.uuid(), banned: z.boolean(), note }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('revert'), actionId: z.number().int().positive(), note }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('merchant'), userId: z.uuid(), approve: z.boolean() }),
]);

/** Admin actions; `is_admin(actor)` is checked inside every SQL function. */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const body = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  if (body.type === 'ban') {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('admin_set_ban', {
        p_admin: user.id,
        p_user: body.userId,
        p_banned: body.banned,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
  } else if (body.type === 'revert') {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('admin_revert_action', {
        p_admin: user.id,
        p_action: body.actionId,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
  } else {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('admin_review_merchant', {
        p_admin: user.id,
        p_user: body.userId,
        p_approve: body.approve,
      }),
    );
  }
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { appealSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const schema = appealSchema.extend({ actionId: z.number().int().positive() });

/** The author contests a decision about them (RLS: target only, once, within 30 days). */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { actionId, reason } = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const res = await supabase
    .from('appeals')
    .insert({ action_id: actionId, author_id: user.id, reason });
  if (res.error?.code === '23505') throw new ApiError('already_appealed', 409);
  unwrap(res);
  return json({ ok: true }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { signInSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, route } from '@/lib/api';
import { limitAuthAttempt } from '@/lib/auth-limits';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** E-mail + password sign-in; session cookies are set by the Supabase SSR client. */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const { email, password } = await parseBody(req, signInSchema);
  await limitAuthAttempt(req, email);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
  if (error || !data.user) {
    if (error?.status === 429) throw new ApiError('rate_limited', 429);
    if (error?.code === 'email_not_confirmed') throw new ApiError('email_not_confirmed', 403);
    throw new ApiError('invalid_credentials', 401);
  }
  const [{ data: profile }, { data: settings }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('profiles').select('username').eq('id', data.user.id).single(),
    supabase.from('user_settings').select('onboarded_at').eq('user_id', data.user.id).single(),
  ]);
  const res = json({ ok: true, needsUsername: !profile?.username });
  // An account already onboarded elsewhere skips the onboarding on this device.
  if (settings?.onboarded_at) {
    res.cookies.set(ONBOARDED_COOKIE, '1', { path: '/', maxAge: 31_536_000, sameSite: 'lax' });
  }
  return res;
});
```

```ts
import { passwordSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Sets a new password for the signed-in user (after a reset link, or from the settings). */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  await requireUser();
  const { password } = await parseBody(req, z.object({ password: passwordSchema }));
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({ password });
  if (error) {
    if (error.code === 'same_password') throw new ApiError('same_password', 422);
    if (error.code === 'weak_password') throw new ApiError('password_too_weak', 422);
    throw new ApiError('password_update_failed', 400);
  }
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { emailSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, route } from '@/lib/api';
import { limitAuthAttempt } from '@/lib/auth-limits';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Sends a password reset link. Always answers OK (no account enumeration). */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const { email } = await parseBody(req, z.object({ email: emailSchema }));
  await limitAuthAttempt(req, email);
  const redirect = new URL('/auth/callback', clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL);
  redirect.searchParams.set('next', '/reinitialiser');
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {
    redirectTo: redirect.toString(),
  });
  if (error) console.error('resetPasswordForEmail failed', error.message);
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

`apps\web\src\app\api\auth\signup\route.ts`:

```ts
import { signUpSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, route } from '@/lib/api';
import { limitAuthAttempt } from '@/lib/auth-limits';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Sign-up with e-mail, password and pseudo. When e-mail confirmation is enabled on the
 * Supabase project, no session is returned and the user must click the confirmation link.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const { email, password, username } = await parseBody(req, signUpSchema);
  await limitAuthAttempt(req, email);
  const admin = adminClient();

  const { data: taken } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('id')
    .eq('username', username)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (taken) throw new ApiError('username_taken', 409);

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({
    email,
    password,
    options: {
      emailRedirectTo: new URL('/auth/callback', clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL).toString(),
    },
  });
  if (error) {
    if (error.status === 429) throw new ApiError('rate_limited', 429);
    if (error.code === 'weak_password') throw new ApiError('password_too_weak', 422);
    // Same answer whether or not the address exists (no account enumeration).
    throw new ApiError('signup_failed', 400);
  }
  if (!data.user) throw new ApiError('signup_failed', 400);

  // Trusted server-side write: the user id comes from the Auth server response.
  const { error: nameError } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .update({ username })
    .eq('id', data.user.id)
    .is('username', null);
  if (nameError?.code === '23505') throw new ApiError('username_taken', 409);

  return json({ ok: true, needsConfirmation: data.session === null }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { ApiError, json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
```

```ts
import { decodeCursor, encodeCursor, feedQuerySchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { getUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const PAGE = 8;
const querySchema = feedQuerySchema.extend({
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(20).optional(),
});

/**
 * Hyperlocal feed, cursor-paginated. The query position is used for this request only: it is
 * neither stored nor logged. Results carry fuzzed positions and 100 m distance buckets.
 */
export const GET = route(async (req) => {
  const q = querySchema.parse(Object.fromEntries(req.nextUrl.searchParams));
  const cursor = q.cursor ? decodeCursor(q.cursor) : null;
  if (q.cursor && !cursor) throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  const ref = cursor?.ref ?? new Date().toISOString();
  const limit = q.limit ?? PAGE;

  const rows = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('nearby_videos', {
      p_lat: q.lat,
      p_lng: q.lng,
      p_radius_m: q.radius,
      p_category: q.category,
      p_cursor_score: cursor?.score,
      p_cursor_id: cursor?.id,
      p_ref_time: ref,
      p_limit: limit,
    }),
  );
  const user = await getUser();
  const items = await hydrate(rows as PublicVideoRow[], user?.id ?? null);
  const last = rows.at(-1);
  const nextCursor =
    rows.length === limit && last ? encodeCursor({ score: last.score, id: last.id, ref }) : null;
  return json({ items, nextCursor });
});
```

```ts
import { groupByBucket } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

const schema = z.object({ confirm: z.string().min(1).max(40) });

/**
 * Account deletion: files are removed from storage right away (a purge job is also queued as a
 * safety net), then the auth user is deleted, which cascades to every row owned by the user.
 */
export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { confirm } = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: profile } = await admin
    .from('profiles')
    .select('username')
    .eq('id', user.id)
    .single();
  if (!profile || (profile.username ?? '') !== confirm.trim().toLowerCase()) {
    throw new ApiError('confirmation_mismatch', 422);
  }

  const paths = unwrap(await admin.rpc('prepare_account_deletion', { p_user: user.id })) ?? [];
  for (const [bucket, list] of groupByBucket(paths)) {
    const { error } = await admin.storage.from(bucket).remove(list);
    if (error) console.error('storage removal deferred to purge job', bucket, error.message);
  }

  const { error } = await admin.auth.admin.deleteUser(user.id);
  if (error) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  await supabase.auth.signOut();
  return json({ ok: true, deletedFiles: paths.length });
});
```

```ts
import { MODERATION_ACTIONS, sanitizeText } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

const cell = z.string().regex(/^[0-9a-f]{15}$/);

const schema = z.discriminatedUnion('type', [
  // Same fields as moderationDecisionSchema; "note required to remove" is enforced in SQL.
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('decision'),
    videoId: z.uuid(),
    action: z.enum(MODERATION_ACTIONS),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({
    type: z.literal('appeal'),
    appealId: z.uuid(),
    uphold: z.boolean(),
    note: z.string().max(1000).transform(sanitizeText).default(''),
  }),
  z.object({ type: z.literal('apply'), cell }),
]);

/**
 * Moderator actions. Authorization is enforced in SQL (zone moderator or admin, no
 * self-moderation, appeals reviewed by someone else); the actor is the verified session user.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const body = await parseBody(req, schema);
  const admin = adminClient();
  if (body.type === 'decision') {
    const actionId = unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('moderate_video', {
        p_actor: user.id,
        p_video: body.videoId,
        p_kind: body.action,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ actionId });
  }
  if (body.type === 'appeal') {
    unwrap(
      await admin.rpc('resolve_appeal', {
        p_reviewer: user.id,
        p_appeal: body.appealId,
        p_uphold: body.uphold,
        p_note: body.note,
      }),
    );
    return json({ ok: true });
  }
  unwrap(await admin.rpc('become_zone_moderator', { p_user: user.id, p_cell: body.cell }));
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { pushSubscribeSchema, zoneCell, zoneCenter } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/**
 * Subscribes this browser to alerts for a zone. The submitted position is only used to pick the
 * H3 cell; what is stored is the cell and its centre, never the device position.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { subscription, zone, radius } = await parseBody(req, pushSubscribeSchema);
  const cell = zoneCell(zone);
  const center = zoneCenter(cell);
  // One row per browser endpoint: a browser previously used by another account is re-assigned.
  await adminClient().from('push_subscriptions').delete().eq('endpoint', subscription.endpoint);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase.from('push_subscriptions').insert({
      user_id: user.id,
      endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
      p256dh: subscription.keys.p256dh,
      auth: subscription.keys.auth,
      zone_cell: cell,
      zone_center: `SRID=4326;POINT(${center.lng} ${center.lat})`,
      radius_m: radius,
    }),
  );
  return json({ zoneCell: cell }, 201);
});

export const DELETE = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const { endpoint } = await parseBody(req, z.object({ endpoint: z.url() }));
  const supabase = await createClient();
  unwrap(
    await supabase
      .from('push_subscriptions')
      .delete()
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .eq('endpoint', endpoint),
  );
  return json({ ok: true });
});
```

```ts
import { commentSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

type Ctx = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };
const PAGE = 20;
const beforeSchema = z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }).optional();
interface CommentRow {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  author_id: string;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string } | null;
}

const columns = 'id, body, created_at, author_id, author:profiles(username, avatar_color)';

/** Comments, newest first, paginated with a `before` timestamp cursor. */
export const GET = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const before = beforeSchema.parse(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('before') ?? undefined);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  let query = supabase
    .from('comments')
    .select(columns)
    .eq('video_id', id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(PAGE);
  if (before) query = query.lt('created_at', before);
  const rows = unwrap(await query);
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  return json({
    comments: rows.map((c) => ({ ...c, mine: c.author_id === data.user?.id })),
    nextBefore: rows.length === PAGE ? (rows.at(-1)?.created_at ?? null) : null,
  });
});

/** Text is sanitised by the schema; RLS checks authorship and ban, a trigger rate-limits. */
export const POST = route<Ctx>(async (req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const { body } = await parseBody(req, commentSchema);
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const comment = unwrap<CommentRow>(
    await supabase
      .from('comments')
      .insert({ video_id: id, author_id: user.id, body })
      .select(columns)
      .single(),
  );
  return json({ ...comment, mine: true }, 201);
});
```

```ts
import { MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, rawPathFor, RAW_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { ApiError, json, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** Step 3 of a publication: the raw file is verified in storage, then queued for the worker. */
export const POST = route<{ params: Promise<{ id: string }> }>(async (_req, { params }) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const id = z.uuid().parse((await params).id);
  const admin = adminClient();
  const { data: video } = await admin
    .from('videos')
    .select('mime_type, status, raw_path')
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('author_id', user.id)
    .maybeSingle();
  if (!video) throw new ApiError('not_found', 404);
  if (video.status !== 'processing' || video.raw_path) return json({ status: video.status });

  const path = rawPathFor(user.id, id, video.mime_type);
  const name = path.split('/')[1] ?? '';
  const { data: files } = await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).list(user.id, { search: name });
  const file = files?.find((f) => f.name === name);
  if (!file) throw new ApiError('upload_missing', 409);
  const size = Number((file.metadata as { size?: number } | null)?.size ?? 0);
  if (size <= 0 || size > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES) {
    await admin.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).remove([path]);
    throw new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  }
  unwrap(
    await admin.rpc('enqueue_processing', { p_author: user.id, p_video: id, p_raw_path: path }),
  );
  return json({ status: 'processing' });
});
```

```ts
import {
  computeExpiresAt,
  createVideoSchema,
  rawPathFor,
  RAW_BUCKET,
  realtimeCell,
  zoneCell,
} from '@nl/shared';
import { ApiError, json, parseBody, requireUser, route, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/**
 * Step 1 of a publication: validates everything server-side (schema, accuracy ≤ 100 m,
 * plausible position, coherence with the previous publication, rate limit, merchant quota)
 * and reserves the video row. The client then uploads the raw file (TUS) to `uploadPath`.
 */
export const POST = route(async (req) => {
  const user = await requireUser();
  const input = await parseBody(req, createVideoSchema);
  let expiresAt: Date;
  try {
    expiresAt = computeExpiresAt(input.category, new Date(), {
      eventEndsAt: input.eventEndsAt ? new Date(input.eventEndsAt) : undefined,
      merchantHours: input.merchantHours,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    throw new ApiError((error as Error).message, 422);
  }
  const point = { lat: input.lat, lng: input.lng };
  const videoId = unwrap(
    await adminClient().rpc('create_video', {
      p_author: user.id,
      p_category: input.category,
      p_caption: input.caption,
      p_lat: input.lat,
      p_lng: input.lng,
      p_accuracy: input.accuracy,
      p_h3_cell: zoneCell(point),
      p_realtime_cell: realtimeCell(point),
      p_mime: input.mimeType,
      p_duration_ms: input.durationMs,
      p_expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
    }),
  );
  if (!videoId) throw new ApiError('internal', 500);
  return json(
    { videoId, bucket: RAW_BUCKET, uploadPath: rawPathFor(user.id, videoId, input.mimeType) },
    201,
  );
});
```

```ts
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
import { safeNext } from '@/lib/redirect';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Magic link landing: exchanges the PKCE code for a session, then routes the new user. */
export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {
  const site = clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL;
  const code = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('code');
  const next = safeNext(req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('next'));
  if (!code) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);
  if (error || !data.user) return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login?error=callback', site));

  const [{ data: profile }, { data: settings }] = await Promise.all([
    supabase.from('profiles').select('username').eq('id', data.user.id).single(),
    supabase.from('user_settings').select('onboarded_at').eq('user_id', data.user.id).single(),
  ]);
  const target = profile?.username ? next : `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`;
  const res = NextResponse.redirect(new URL(target, site));
  // An account already onboarded elsewhere skips the onboarding on this new device.
  if (settings?.onboarded_at) {
    res.cookies.set(ONBOARDED_COOKIE, '1', { path: '/', maxAge: 31_536_000, sameSite: 'lax' });
  }
  return res;
```

```tsx
export default async function WelcomePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ next?: string }>;
}) {
  const next = safeNext((await searchParams).next);

  if (!viewer) redirect(`/login?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`);
  if (viewer.username) redirect(next);

      </div>
      <UsernameForm next={after} />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { notFound } from 'next/navigation';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';

const SLUGS = ['confidentialite', 'conditions', 'regles', 'contact'] as const;
type Slug = (typeof SLUGS)[number];
const isSlug = (s: string): s is Slug => (SLUGS as readonly string[]).includes(s);

type Params = { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> };

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) return {};
  return { title: (await getTranslations('legal'))(`pages.${slug}.title`) };
}

export default async function LegalPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { slug } = await params;
  if (!isSlug(slug)) notFound();
  const t = await getTranslations('legal');
  const tf = await getTranslations('common.footer');
  const sections = t.raw(`pages.${slug}.sections`) as Array<{ title: string; body: string }>;
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex max-w-2xl flex-col gap-6 p-6">
      <Link href="/" className="text-sm text-fog underline">
        ← Neighbors Live
      </Link>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">{t(`pages.${slug}.title`)}</h1>
      <p
        role="note"
        className="rounded-xl border border-amber-500 bg-amber-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm"
      >
        {t('draft')}
      </p>
      {sections.map((s) => (
        <section key={s.title} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{s.title}</h2>
          <p className="leading-relaxed text-fog">{s.body}</p>
        </section>
      ))}
      <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t('updated')}</p>
      <nav className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 border-t border-line pt-4 text-sm">
        <Link href="/legal/confidentialite">{tf('privacy')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/conditions">{tf('terms')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/regles">{tf('rules')}</Link>
        <Link href="/legal/contact">{tf('contact')}</Link>
      </nav>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}: {

  const signup = mode === 'signup';
  return (

      </div>
      <AuthForm
        mode={signup ? 'signup' : 'login'}
        next={target}
        callbackError={error === 'callback'}
      />
    </main>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\app\sw.ts`:

```ts
/// <reference lib="webworker" />
import {
  CacheFirst,
  ExpirationPlugin,
  NetworkFirst,
  NetworkOnly,
  Serwist,
  StaleWhileRevalidate,
  type PrecacheEntry,
  type SerwistGlobalConfig,
} from 'serwist';

declare global {
  interface WorkerGlobalScope extends SerwistGlobalConfig {
    __SW_MANIFEST: (PrecacheEntry | string)[] | undefined;
  }
}
declare const self: ServiceWorkerGlobalScope;

const serwist = new Serwist({
  precacheEntries: self.__SW_MANIFEST,
  // Soft update: the new worker waits until the user accepts the "update" banner.
  skipWaiting: false,
  clientsClaim: true,
  navigationPreload: true,
  runtimeCaching: [
    // API responses carry positions and short-lived signed URLs: never cached.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => url.pathname.startsWith('/api/') || url.pathname.startsWith('/auth/'),
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Private media (signed URLs) and video streams: network only.
    {
      matcher: ({ url, request }) =>
        url.pathname.includes('/storage/v1/') || request.destination === 'video',
      handler: new NetworkOnly(),
    },
    // Map style, glyphs and vector tiles: cache first, bounded.
    {
      matcher: ({ url }) => /openfreemap|tiles|maptiler|stadiamaps/.test(url.hostname),
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'map-tiles',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 800, maxAgeSeconds: 14 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // App code and styles: fast from cache, refreshed in background.
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin &&
        ['script', 'style', 'worker', 'font'].includes(request.destination),
      handler: new StaleWhileRevalidate({ cacheName: 'static' }),
    },
    {
      matcher: ({ request, url }) =>
        url.origin === self.location.origin && request.destination === 'image',
      handler: new CacheFirst({
        cacheName: 'images',
        plugins: [new ExpirationPlugin({ maxEntries: 60, maxAgeSeconds: 30 * 24 * 3600 })],
      }),
    },
    // Pages: network first with a short timeout, offline page as fallback.
    {
      matcher: ({ request }) => request.mode === 'navigate',
      handler: new NetworkFirst({ cacheName: 'pages', networkTimeoutSeconds: 4 }),
    },
  ],
  fallbacks: {
    entries: [{ url: '/offline', matcher: ({ request }) => request.destination === 'document' }],
  },
});

interface PushPayload {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  url: string;
  tag?: string;
}

self.addEventListener('push', (event) => {
  let data: PushPayload = { title: 'Neighbors Live', body: '', url: '/' };
  try {
    data = { ...data, ...(event.data?.json() as Partial<PushPayload>) };
  } catch {
    /* non-JSON payload: keep defaults */
  }
  event.waitUntil(
    self.registration.showNotification(data.title, {
      body: data.body,
      tag: data.tag,
      icon: '/icons/icon-192.png',
      badge: '/icons/badge-96.png',
      data: { url: data.url },
    }),
  );
});

self.addEventListener('notificationclick', (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  const target = new URL(
    (event.notification.data as { url?: string })?.url ?? '/',
    self.location.origin,
  );
  if (target.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
  event.waitUntil(
    self.clients.matchAll({ type: 'window', includeUncontrolled: true }).then((clients) => {
      const open = clients.find((c) => new URL(c.url).origin === target.origin);
      if (open) {
        void open.navigate(target.href);
        return open.focus();
      }
      return self.clients.openWindow(target.href);
    }),
  );
});

serwist.addEventListeners();
```

```tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getTranslations } from 'next-intl/server';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { hydrate, type PublicVideoRow } from '@/lib/feed';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

type Params = { params: Promise<{ id: string }> };

async function load(id: string) {
  if (!z.uuid().safeParse(id).success) return null;
  const { data } = await adminClient().rpc('get_public_video', { p_id: id });
  if (!data?.length) return null;
  const [item] = await hydrate(data as PublicVideoRow[], null);
  return item ?? null;
}

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: Params): Promise<Metadata> {
  const item = await load((await params).id);
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  if (!item) return { title: tc('appName') };
  const category = tc(`categories.${item.category}`);
  return {
    title: `${category} — ${item.caption || tc('appName')}`,
    description: item.caption,
    openGraph: { title: category, description: item.caption, type: 'video.other' },
  };
}

/** Shareable deep link: public preview (fuzzed data only), then "open in the feed". */
export default async function VideoPage({ params }: Params) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const item = await load(id);
  const t = await getTranslations('video');
  const tc = await getTranslations('common');
  return (
    <main id="main" className="mx-auto flex min-h-dvh max-w-md flex-col gap-4 p-4">
      {!item ? (
        <p className="pt-10 text-center text-fog">{t('unavailable')}</p>
      ) : (
        <>
          <video
            src={item.videoUrl ?? undefined}
            poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
            controls
            playsInline
            muted
            autoPlay
            loop
            aria-label={item.caption}
            className="aspect-[9/16] w-full rounded-2xl bg-black object-cover"
          />
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{tc(`categories.${item.category}`)}</p>
          {item.caption && <p className="text-lg">{item.caption}</p>}
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('by', { username: item.author.username ?? '' })}</p>
        </>
      )}
      <Link
        href={item ? `/?video=${item.id}` : '/'}
```

```tsx
/** Relative luminance (WCAG) of a #rrggbb colour. */
function luminance(hex: string): number {
  const channel = (i: number) => {
    const c = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  };
  return 0.2126 * channel(1) + 0.7152 * channel(3) + 0.0722 * channel(5);
}

/** White or near-black initials, whichever reaches the better contrast on `bg`. */
export function initialsColor(bg: string): string {
  const l = luminance(bg);
  return 1.05 / (l + 0.05) >= (l + 0.05) / (luminance('#0b0d10') + 0.05) ? '#ffffff' : '#0b0d10';
}

/** Generated avatar: initials on the colour derived from the account id (no uploaded photo). */
export function Avatar({
  username,
  color,
  size = 40,
}: {
  username: string | null;
  color: string;
  size?: number;
}) {
  const initials = (username ?? '?').replace(/_/g, '').slice(0, 2).toUpperCase() || '?';
  return (
    <span
      aria-hidden="true"
      className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full font-bold"
      style={{
        width: size,
        height: size,
        backgroundColor: color,
        color: initialsColor(color),
        fontSize: size * 0.4,
      }}
    >
      {initials}
    </span>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui';

/**
 * Explanation shown BEFORE any system permission prompt (camera, microphone, location,
 * notifications). Rendered as an accessible modal dialog.
 */
export function PermissionPrimer({
  open,
  title,
  children,
  confirmLabel,
  cancelLabel,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  confirmLabel: string;
  cancelLabel: string;
  onConfirm: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const dialog = ref.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    if (open && !dialog.open) dialog.showModal();
    if (!open && dialog.open) dialog.close();
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onCancel={(e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        onCancel();
      }}
      className="m-auto w-[min(92vw,28rem)] rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-5 text-white backdrop:bg-black/70"
    >
      <h2 id={titleId} className="mb-3 text-xl font-bold">
        {title}
      </h2>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 text-sm text-fog">{children}</div>
      <div className="mt-5 flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Button onClick={onConfirm} autoFocus>
          {confirmLabel}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={onCancel}>
          {cancelLabel}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

type Body =
  | { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean; note: string }
  | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number; note: string }
  | { type: 'merchant'; userId: string; approve: boolean };

function useAdminAction() {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const run = async (body: Body) => {
    if (pending) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/admin', { body });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : {
            kind: 'error',
            text:
              res.error === 'review_conflict'
                ? t('review_conflict')
                : (errorText(res.error) ?? t('actionError')),
          },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
    setPending(false);
  };
  return { run, status, pending };
}

export function MerchantReview({
  userId,
  name,
  applicant,
  description,
  submittedAt,
}: {
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  applicant: string;
  description: string;
  submittedAt: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const review = (approve: boolean) => {
    if (window.confirm(t(approve ? 'confirmApproveMerchant' : 'confirmRejectMerchant', { name }))) {
      void run({ type: 'merchant', userId, approve });
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex h-full flex-col gap-4 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4">
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">{name}</h3>
        <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('merchantApplicant', { username: applicant })}</p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm leading-relaxed text-fog">
          {description || t('noMerchantDescription')}
        </p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-fog">{t('submittedAt', { date: submittedAt })}</p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(true)}>
          {t('approve')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => review(false)}>
          {t('rejectMerchant')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

type NotedBody =
  { type: 'ban'; userId: string; banned: boolean } | { type: 'revert'; actionId: number };

/** Ban / unban or revert, both requiring a written reason. */
export function NotedAction({
  label,
  body,
  variant = 'secondary',
}: {
  label: string;
  body: NotedBody;
  variant?: 'secondary' | 'danger';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('admin');
  const { run, status, pending } = useAdminAction();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const id = `note-${body.type}-${body.type === 'ban' ? body.userId : body.actionId}`;
  const submit = () => {
    if (body.type === 'ban' && body.banned && !window.confirm(t('confirmBan'))) return;
    if (body.type === 'revert' && !window.confirm(t('confirmRevert'))) return;
    void run({ ...body, note });
  };
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="sr-only">
          {t('note')}
        </label>
        <input
          id={id}
          className={inputClass}
          placeholder={t('note')}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
        <Button variant={variant} disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3} onClick={submit}>
          {pending ? t('saving') : label}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}
```
