```tsx
'use client';

import { passwordSchema, usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Auth-specific error codes first, then the generic ones. */
function useAuthError() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.errors');
  const generic = useErrorText();
  return (code: string | null | undefined) => (code && t.has(code) ? t(code) : generic(code));
}

function PasswordInput({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  autoComplete,
}: {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  autoComplete: 'current-password' | 'new-password';
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <input
        id={id}
        type={visible ? 'text' : 'password'}
        autoComplete={autoComplete}
        required
        maxLength={72}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}
        className={`${inputClass} pr-24`}
      />
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setVisible((v) => !v)}
        aria-pressed={visible}
        aria-controls={id}
        className="absolute inset-y-0 right-2 my-auto h-9 rounded-lg px-2 text-sm text-fog"
      >
        {visible ? t('hidePassword') : t('showPassword')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function Consent() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth.login');
  return (
    <p className="text-xs text-fog">
      {t.rich('consent', {
        terms: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/conditions">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
        privacy: (c) => (
          <Link className="underline" href="/legal/confidentialite">
            {c}
          </Link>
        ),
      })}
    </p>
  );
}

/** Sign-in and sign-up on one screen (switchable), e-mail + password. */
export function AuthForm({
  mode: initialMode,
  next,
  callbackError,
}: {
  mode: 'login' | 'signup';
  next: string;
  callbackError: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(initialMode);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(
    callbackError ? t('login.callbackError') : null,
  );
  const [confirmSent, setConfirmSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    if (mode === 'signup') {
      if (!usernameSchema.safeParse(username).success)
        return setError(t('errors.username_invalid'));
      const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
      if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    }
    setPending(true);
    const res =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? await api<{ needsConfirmation?: boolean }>('/api/auth/signup', {
            body: { email, password, username },
          })
        : await api<{ needsUsername?: boolean }>('/api/auth/login', { body: { email, password } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    const data = res.data as { needsConfirmation?: boolean; needsUsername?: boolean };
    if (mode === 'signup' && data.needsConfirmation) return setConfirmSent(email);
    const target =
      mode === 'signup'
        ? `/onboarding?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
        : data.needsUsername
          ? `/bienvenue?next=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`
          : next;
    router.replace(target);
    router.refresh();
  }

  if (confirmSent) {
    return <Notice kind="success">{t('signup.checkEmail', { email: confirmSent })}</Notice>;
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email">
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          name="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      {mode === 'signup' && (
        <Field label={t('signup.username')} htmlFor="username" hint={t('signup.usernameHint')}>
          <input
            id="username"
            name="username"
            autoComplete="username"
            autoCapitalize="none"
            spellCheck={false}
            maxLength={20}
            value={username}
            onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </Field>
      )}
      <Field
        label={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.password') : t('login.password')}
        htmlFor="password"
        hint={mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.passwordHint') : undefined}
      >
        <PasswordInput
          id="password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete={mode === 'signup' ? 'new-password' : 'current-password'}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || !email || !password}>
        {mode === 'signup' ? t('signup.submit') : t('login.submit')}
      </Button>
      {mode === 'login' && (
        <Link href="/mot-de-passe-oublie" className="text-center text-sm underline">
          {t('login.forgot')}
        </Link>
      )}
      <p className="text-center text-sm text-fog">
        {mode === 'login' ? t('login.noAccount') : t('signup.hasAccount')}{' '}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="font-semibold text-white underline"
          onClick={() => {
            setError(null);
            setMode(mode === 'login' ? 'signup' : 'login');
          }}
        >
          {mode === 'login' ? t('login.toSignup') : t('signup.toLogin')}
        </button>
      </p>
      <Consent />
    </form>
  );
}

export function ForgotForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [sent, setSent] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/auth/reset', { body: { email } });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return setError(
        res.error === 'invalid_input' ? t('login.invalidEmail') : authError(res.error),
      );
    }
    setSent(email);
  }

  if (sent) return <Notice kind="success">{t('forgot.sent', { email: sent })}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('login.email')} htmlFor="email" error={error}>
        <input
          id="email"
          type="email"
          autoComplete="email"
          inputMode="email"
          required
          value={email}
          onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
          className={inputClass}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!email}>
        {t('forgot.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export function NewPasswordForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('auth');
  const authError = useAuthError();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const pwd = passwordSchema.safeParse(password);
    if (!pwd.success) return setError(authError(pwd.error.issues[0]?.message));
    if (password !== confirm) return setError(t('reset.mismatch'));
    const res = await api('/api/auth/password', { body: { password } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(res.status === 401 ? t('reset.expired') : authError(res.error));
    setDone(true);
    router.replace('/');
  }

  if (done) return <Notice kind="success">{t('reset.done')}</Notice>;
  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4" noValidate>
      <Field label={t('reset.password')} htmlFor="new-password" hint={t('signup.passwordHint')}>
        <PasswordInput
          id="new-password"
          value={password}
          onChange={setPassword}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('reset.confirm')} htmlFor="confirm-password">
        <PasswordInput
          id="confirm-password"
          value={confirm}
          onChange={setConfirm}
          autoComplete="new-password"
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!password || !confirm}>
        {t('reset.submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { usernameSchema } from '@nl/shared';

export function UsernameForm({ next }: { next: string }) {

  const router = useRouter();
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const parsed = usernameSchema.safeParse(username);
    if (!parsed.success) return setError(t('invalid'));
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: { username: parsed.data } });

    router.replace(next);

      <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="username" error={error}>

          autoCapitalize="none"
          spellCheck={false}
          maxLength={20}
          value={username}
          onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value.toLowerCase())}
          className={inputClass}
          aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button type="submit" disabled={pending || username.length < 3}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { MAX_RECORDING_MS } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { pickMimeType } from '@/lib/recorder';

export interface Recording {
  blob: Blob;
  mime: string;
  durationMs: number;
}

type CamError = 'denied' | 'notFound' | 'unsupported' | 'generic';

const supportedMime = () =>
  typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined'
    ? null
    : pickMimeType((m) => MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(m));

async function openCamera(facing: 'environment' | 'user'): Promise<MediaStream | CamError> {
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || !supportedMime()) return 'unsupported';
  try {
    return await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({
      video: { facingMode: { ideal: facing }, width: { ideal: 720 }, height: { ideal: 1280 } },
      audio: true,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    const name = (e as DOMException).name;
    if (name === 'NotAllowedError' || name === 'SecurityError') return 'denied';
    return name === 'NotFoundError' ? 'notFound' : 'generic';
  }
}

/**
 * Full-screen camera: back camera by default, front/back switch, 30 s max with a gauge.
 * Only `getUserMedia` + `MediaRecorder` are used: there is no file picker (no gallery import).
 */
export function Camera({ onRecorded }: { onRecorded: (r: Recording) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const videoRef = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const streamRef = useRef<MediaStream | null>(null);
  const recorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const [facing, setFacing] = useState<'environment' | 'user'>('environment');
  const [error, setError] = useState<CamError | null>(null);
  const [recording, setRecording] = useState(false);
  const [elapsed, setElapsed] = useState(0);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  const stopTracks = () => {
    streamRef.current?.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
    streamRef.current = null;
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    void openCamera(facing).then((result) => {
      if (typeof result === 'string') {
        if (!cancelled) setError(result);
        return;
      }
      if (cancelled) {
        result.getTracks().forEach((tr) => tr.stop());
        return;
      }
      stopTracks();
      streamRef.current = result;
      if (videoRef.current) videoRef.current.srcObject = result;
      setError(null);
      setReady(true);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [facing]);

  useEffect(() => () => stopTracks(), []);

  const stop = useCallback(() => {
    if (recorderRef.current?.state === 'recording') recorderRef.current.stop();
  }, []);

  function record() {
    const stream = streamRef.current;
    const mime = supportedMime();
    if (!stream || !mime) return;
    const chunks: Blob[] = [];
    const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime, videoBitsPerSecond: 2_500_000 });
    const startedAt = performance.now();
    recorder.ondataavailable = (e) => {
      if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data);
    };
    recorder.onstop = () => {
      setRecording(false);
      const durationMs = Math.min(MAX_RECORDING_MS, Math.round(performance.now() - startedAt));
      stopTracks();
      onRecorded({ blob: new Blob(chunks, { type: mime }), mime, durationMs });
    };
    recorderRef.current = recorder;
    recorder.start(1000);
    setRecording(true);
    setElapsed(0);
    const tick = () => {
      if (recorder.state !== 'recording') return;
      const ms = performance.now() - startedAt;
      setElapsed(ms);
      if (ms >= MAX_RECORDING_MS) recorder.stop();
      else requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }

  const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / MAX_RECORDING_MS);
  const remaining = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((MAX_RECORDING_MS - elapsed) / 1000));

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto flex h-full max-w-md flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
        <Notice kind="error">{t(`errors.${error}`)}</Notice>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-full w-full bg-black">
      <video
        ref={videoRef}
        autoPlay
        muted
        playsInline
        aria-label={t('title')}
        className={`h-full w-full object-cover ${facing === 'user' ? '-scale-x-100' : ''}`}
      />
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 h-1.5 bg-white/20" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="h-full bg-alert" style={{ width: `${progress * 100}%` }} />
      </div>
      <p
        className="absolute left-1/2 top-4 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-black/60 px-3 py-1 text-sm"
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        {recording ? t('remaining', { seconds: remaining }) : t('maxDuration')}
      </p>
      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 flex items-center justify-around pb-[max(2rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        <span className="w-14" />
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={recording ? stop : record}
          disabled={!ready}
          aria-label={recording ? t('stop') : t('record')}
          className="relative flex h-20 w-20 items-center justify-center rounded-full border-4 border-white"
        >
          <svg className="absolute inset-0 -rotate-90" viewBox="0 0 80 80" aria-hidden="true">
            <circle
              cx="40"
              cy="40"
              r="36"
              fill="none"
              stroke="var(--color-alert)"
              strokeWidth="6"
              strokeDasharray={226}
              strokeDashoffset={226 * (1 - progress)}
            />
          </svg>
          <span
            className={`bg-alert transition-all ${recording ? 'h-7 w-7 rounded-md' : 'h-14 w-14 rounded-full'}`}
          />
        </button>
        <Button
          variant="secondary"
          className="h-14 w-14 rounded-full p-0"
          aria-label={t('switch')}
          disabled={recording}
          onClick={() => {
            setReady(false);
            setFacing((f) => (f === 'environment' ? 'user' : 'environment'));
          }}
        >
          <svg
            aria-hidden="true"
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            className="h-6 w-6"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="2"
          >
            <path d="M4 7h3l2-2h6l2 2h3v12H4zM9 13a3 3 0 015-2.2M15 13a3 3 0 01-5 2.2" />
          </svg>
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  CAPTION_MAX,
  CATEGORIES,
  MAX_ACCURACY_M,
  MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H,
  type Category,
} from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { enqueue } from '@/lib/offline-queue';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';
import { publish, PublishError, type Fix, type PublishMeta } from '@/lib/publish';
import { containerOf } from '@/lib/recorder';
import { Camera, type Recording } from './Camera';

type Step = 'primer' | 'camera' | 'preview' | 'form' | 'sending' | 'done' | 'queued';

/** datetime-local bounds for an event end: from now + 15 min to now + 7 days (local time). */
function eventBounds() {
  const local = (ms: number) => {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    return new Date(d.getTime() - d.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000).toISOString().slice(0, 16);
  };
  const now = Date.now();
  return { minEvent: local(now + 15 * 60_000), maxEvent: local(now + 7 * 24 * 3_600_000 - 60_000) };
}

export function CaptureFlow({ isMerchant }: { isMerchant: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations('capture');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<Step>('primer');
  const [rec, setRec] = useState<Recording | null>(null);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category>('alert');
  const [caption, setCaption] = useState('');
  const [eventEnd, setEventEnd] = useState('');
  const [merchantHours, setMerchantHours] = useState<number>(24);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const [locating, setLocating] = useState(false);

  const previewUrl = useMemo(() => (rec ? URL.createObjectURL(rec.blob) : null), [rec]);
  useEffect(() => () => void (previewUrl && URL.revokeObjectURL(previewUrl)), [previewUrl]);

  const categories = CATEGORIES.filter((c) => c !== 'shop' || isMerchant);

  async function locate(): Promise<Fix | null> {
    setLocating(true);
    try {
      const pos = await currentPosition();
      const fix = {
        lat: pos.coords.latitude,
        lng: pos.coords.longitude,
        accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy),
      };
      if (fix.accuracy > MAX_ACCURACY_M) {
        setError(t('location.imprecise', { accuracy: fix.accuracy }));
        return null;
      }
      return fix;
    } catch (e) {
      setError(
        (e as GeolocationPositionError).code === 1
          ? t('location.denied')
          : t('location.unavailable'),
      );
      return null;
    } finally {
      setLocating(false);
    }
  }

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!rec) return;
    setError(null);
    const fix = await locate();
    if (!fix) return;
    const meta: PublishMeta = {
      category,
      caption,
      mimeType: containerOf(rec.mime),
      durationMs: rec.durationMs,
      ...(category === 'event' && eventEnd && { eventEndsAt: new Date(eventEnd).toISOString() }),
      ...(category === 'shop' && { merchantHours }),
    };
    const keepForLater = async () => {
      await enqueue({ id: crypto.randomUUID(), blob: rec.blob, meta, fix, createdAt: Date.now() });
      setStep('queued');
    };
    if (!navigator.onLine) return keepForLater();
    setStep('sending');
    try {
      await publish(rec.blob, meta, fix, setProgress);
      setStep('done');
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof PublishError && err.retryable) return keepForLater();
      setStep('form');
      const code = err instanceof PublishError ? err.code : 'generic';
      setError(t.has(`errorsPublish.${code}`) ? t(`errorsPublish.${code}`) : errorText(code));
    }
  }

  const [{ minEvent, maxEvent }] = useState(eventBounds);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex flex-col bg-ink">
      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-10 flex justify-end p-3">
        <Link
          href="/"
          aria-label={t('close')}
          className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/60 text-2xl"
        >
          ×
        </Link>
      </header>

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={step === 'primer'}
        title={t('primer.title')}
        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={() => setStep('camera')}
        onCancel={() => router.push('/')}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.camera')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>
        </ul>
        <p>{t('primer.privacy')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      {step === 'camera' && (
        <Camera
          onRecorded={(r) => {
            setRec(r);
            setStep('preview');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {step === 'preview' && previewUrl && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col">
          <h1 className="sr-only">{t('preview.title')}</h1>
          <video
            src={previewUrl}
            controls
            autoPlay
            loop
            playsInline
            className="min-h-0 flex-1 bg-black object-contain"
          />
          <div className="flex gap-3 p-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
            <Button
              variant="secondary"
              className="flex-1"
              onClick={() => {
                setRec(null);
                setStep('camera');
              }}
            >
              {t('preview.retake')}
            </Button>
            <Button className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep('form')}>
              {t('preview.next')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {(step === 'form' || step === 'sending') && (
        <form
          onSubmit={submit}
          className="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-lg flex-1 flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto p-4 pt-16"
        >
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{t('form.title')}</h1>
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('form.category')}</legend>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {categories.map((c) => (
                <label
                  key={c}
                  className={`flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-xl border px-2 text-sm ${category === c ? 'border-accent bg-accent text-ink' : 'border-line'}`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="category"
                    value={c}
                    checked={category === c}
                    onChange={() => setCategory(c)}
                    className="sr-only"
                  />
                  {tc(c)}
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-fog">{t(`form.lifetime.${category}`)}</p>
          </fieldset>
          <Field
            label={t('form.caption')}
            htmlFor="caption"
            hint={t('form.captionHint', { count: caption.length })}
          >
            <textarea
              id="caption"
              className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
              maxLength={CAPTION_MAX}
              value={caption}
              onChange={(e) => setCaption(e.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          {category === 'event' && (
            <Field label={t('form.eventEnd')} htmlFor="event-end" hint={t('form.eventEndHint')}>
              <input
                id="event-end"
                type="datetime-local"
                required
                min={minEvent}
                max={maxEvent}
                className={inputClass}
                value={eventEnd}
                onChange={(e) => setEventEnd(e.target.value)}
              />
            </Field>
          )}
          {category === 'shop' && (
            <Field label={t('form.merchantDuration')} htmlFor="merchant-hours">
              <select
                id="merchant-hours"
                className={inputClass}
                value={merchantHours}
                onChange={(e) => setMerchantHours(Number(e.target.value))}
              >
                {MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H.map((h) => (
                  <option key={h} value={h}>
                    {t('form.hours', { count: h })}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
          )}
          {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
          {step === 'sending' && (
            <div role="status" className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p>{t('form.uploading', { percent: progress })}</p>
              <progress
                value={progress}
                max={100}
                className="w-full accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
              />
            </div>
          )}
          <Button
            type="submit"
            disabled={step === 'sending' || locating || (category === 'event' && !eventEnd)}
          >
            {locating
              ? t('form.locating')
              : error && /±/.test(error)
                ? t('location.retry')
                : t('form.publish')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}

      {(step === 'done' || step === 'queued') && (
        <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-md flex-1 flex-col justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="success">
            {step === 'done' ? t('form.processing') : t('offline.queued')}
          </Notice>
          <Link href="/me" className="rounded-xl bg-accent px-4 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">
            {t('form.seeStatus')}
          </Link>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setRec(null);
              setCaption('');
              setProgress(0);
              setStep('camera');
            }}
          >
            {t('form.another')}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';

/**
 * Republishes recordings kept offline once the network is back, but only if the device is
 * still within 100 m of where they were filmed (and with a precise fix).
 */
export function OfflineQueueRunner() {
  const t = useTranslations('capture.offline');
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(0);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [canRetry, setCanRetry] = useState(false);
  const running = useRef(false);

  const drain = useCallback(async () => {
    if (running.current || !navigator.onLine) return;
    running.current = true;
    setMessage(null);
    setCanRetry(false);
    try {
      // Loaded lazily: this runner is mounted on every page but rarely has work.
      const { judge, listQueued, removeQueued } = await import('@/lib/offline-queue');
      const items = await listQueued();
      setPending(items.length);
      if (items.length === 0) return;
      const { publish, PublishError } = await import('@/lib/publish');
      let fix;
      try {
        const pos = await currentPosition();
        fix = {
          lat: pos.coords.latitude,
          lng: pos.coords.longitude,
          accuracy: Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy),
        };
      } catch {
        setMessage(t('locationUnavailable'));
        setCanRetry(true);
        return;
      }
      for (const item of items) {
        const verdict = judge(item, Date.now(), fix);
        if (verdict === 'wait-precision') {
          setMessage(t('waitPrecision'));
          setCanRetry(true);
          continue;
        }
        if (verdict !== 'publish') {
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t(verdict === 'drop-stale' ? 'droppedStale' : 'droppedMoved'));
          continue;
        }
        try {
          await publish(item.blob, item.meta, item.fix, () => undefined);
          await removeQueued(item.id);
          setMessage(t('sent'));
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof PublishError && error.retryable) {
            setMessage(t('retryable'));
            setCanRetry(true);
          } else {
            await removeQueued(item.id);
            setMessage(t('failed'));
          }
        }
      }
      setPending((await listQueued()).length);
    } finally {
      running.current = false;
    }
  }, [t]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const onOnline = () => void drain();
    window.addEventListener('online', onOnline);
    const timer = setTimeout(onOnline, 3000);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', onOnline);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [drain]);

  if (!pending && !message) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 top-3 z-40 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel/95 px-3 py-2 text-sm shadow-lg"
    >
      <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-3xl items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>{message ?? t('pending', { count: pending })}</span>
        {canRetry && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => void drain()}
            className="min-h-11 shrink-0 rounded-lg px-3 font-semibold text-accent underline underline-offset-4"
          >
            {t('retry')}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';

interface LiveAlert {
  id: string;
  caption: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
}

/**
 * "Alertes proches" banner: initial list from the feed API, then live updates over Supabase
 * Realtime broadcast topics (one per H3 res-7 cell covering the radius). Payloads only carry
 * fuzzed positions.
 */
export function AlertsBanner({
  lat,
  lng,
  radius,
  onShow,
}: {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  radius: number;
  onShow: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed.alerts');
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<Map<string, string>>(new Map());
  const [flash, setFlash] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({
      lat: String(lat),
      lng: String(lng),
      radius: String(radius),
      category: 'alert',
      limit: '20',
    });
    void api<{ items: FeedItem[] }>(`/api/feed?${qs}`).then((res) => {
      if (alive && res.ok) setAlerts(new Map(res.data.items.map((i) => [i.id, i.caption])));
    });

    // Realtime client and H3 are loaded after first paint, only where the banner is used.
    let cleanup = () => {};
    void Promise.all([import('@nl/shared'), import('@/lib/supabase/browser')]).then(
      ([{ haversineMeters, realtimeCells }, { browserClient }]) => {
        if (!alive) return;
        const supabase = browserClient();
        const channels = realtimeCells({ lat, lng }, radius).map((cell) =>
          supabase
            .channel(`alerts:${cell}`, { config: { private: false } })
            .on('broadcast', { event: 'alert' }, ({ payload }) => {
              const a = payload as LiveAlert;
              if (haversineMeters({ lat, lng }, a) > radius + 50) return;
              setAlerts((prev) => new Map(prev).set(a.id, a.caption));
              setFlash(a.caption || '');
              setTimeout(() => setFlash(null), 6000);
            })
            .subscribe(),
        );
        cleanup = () => {
          for (const c of channels) void supabase.removeChannel(c);
        };
      },
    );
    return () => {
      alive = false;
      cleanup();
    };
  }, [lat, lng, radius]);

  if (alerts.size === 0) return null;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onShow}
        className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-alert px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
        aria-label={`${t('banner', { count: alerts.size })} — ${t('show')}`}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">⚠</span>
        {t('banner', { count: alerts.size })}
      </button>
      {flash !== null && (
        <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-sm">
          {t('new', { caption: flash })}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { COMMENT_MAX } from '@nl/shared';
import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { Button, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

interface Comment {
  id: string;
  body: string;
  created_at: string;
  mine: boolean;
  author: { username: string | null; avatar_color: string } | null;
}

interface Page {
  comments: Comment[];
  nextBefore: string | null;
}

export function Comments({
  videoId,
  signedIn,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  signedIn: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.commentsPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [comments, setComments] = useState<Comment[]>([]);
  const [next, setNext] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [body, setBody] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videoId) return;
    let alive = true;
    void api<Page>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`).then((res) => {
      if (!alive || !res.ok) return;
      setComments(res.data.comments);
      setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [videoId]);

  async function more() {
    if (!videoId || !next) return;
    const res = await api<Page>(
      `/api/videos/${videoId}/comments?before=${encodeURIComponent(next)}`,
    );
    if (res.ok) {
      setComments((c) => [...c, ...res.data.comments]);
      setNext(res.data.nextBefore);
    }
  }

  async function send(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId || !body.trim()) return;
    setError(null);
    const res = await api<Comment>(`/api/videos/${videoId}/comments`, { body: { body } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    setComments((c) => [res.data, ...c]);
    setBody('');
  }

  async function remove(id: string) {
    const res = await api(`/api/comments/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    if (res.ok) setComments((c) => c.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={videoId !== null} title={t('title')} onClose={onClose} closeLabel={tc('close')}>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {signedIn ? (
          <form onSubmit={send} className="flex gap-2">
            <label htmlFor="comment-body" className="sr-only">
              {t('placeholder')}
            </label>
            <input
              id="comment-body"
              className={inputClass}
              maxLength={COMMENT_MAX}
              placeholder={t('placeholder')}
              value={body}
              onChange={(e) => setBody(e.target.value)}
            />
            <Button type="submit" disabled={!body.trim()}>
              {t('send')}
            </Button>
          </form>
        ) : (
          <Notice>{t('login')}</Notice>
        )}
        {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
        {comments.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>
        ) : (
          <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {comments.map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id} className="flex gap-3">
                <Avatar
                  username={c.author?.username ?? null}
                  color={c.author?.avatar_color ?? '#64748b'}
                  size={32}
                />
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                    @{c.author?.username} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(c.created_at), now)}
                  </p>
                  <p className="whitespace-pre-line break-words">{c.body}</p>
                </div>
                {c.mine && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="self-start text-xs text-fog underline"
                    onClick={() => remove(c.id)}
                  >
                    {t('delete')}
                  </button>
                )}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {next && (
          <Button variant="ghost" onClick={more}>
            {t('more')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORIES, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { AlertsBanner } from './AlertsBanner';
import { VideoCard } from './VideoCard';

// Sheets are only needed once opened.
const Comments = dynamic(() => import('./Comments').then((m) => m.Comments), { ssr: false });
const ReportDialog = dynamic(() => import('./ReportDialog').then((m) => m.ReportDialog), {
  ssr: false,
});

interface Props {
  initialRadius: number;
  signedIn: boolean;
  focusId: string | null;
  initialCategory: Category | null;
  notice: string | null;
}

type Status = 'idle' | 'loading' | 'ready' | 'error';

export function Feed({ initialRadius, signedIn, focusId, initialCategory, notice }: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const router = useRouter();
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(initialRadius);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category | null>(initialCategory);
  const [items, setItems] = useState<FeedItem[]>([]);
  const [cursor, setCursor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('idle');
  const [active, setActive] = useState(0);
  const [muted, setMuted] = useState(true);
  const [commentsFor, setCommentsFor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [reportFor, setReportFor] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [autoplay, setAutoplay] = useState(true);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const loadingMore = useRef(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    const apply = () => setAutoplay(!mq.matches);
    const timer = setTimeout(apply, 0);
    mq.addEventListener('change', apply);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      mq.removeEventListener('change', apply);
    };
  }, []);

  const lat = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lat : null;
  const lng = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lng : null;
  const coords = lat !== null && lng !== null ? { lat, lng } : null;
  const [reloadKey, setReloadKey] = useState(0);

  const fetchPage = useCallback(
    async (after: string | null) => {
      if (lat === null || lng === null) return null;
      const qs = new URLSearchParams({
        lat: String(lat),
        lng: String(lng),
        radius: String(radius),
      });
      if (category) qs.set('category', category);
      if (after) qs.set('cursor', after);
      return api<{ items: FeedItem[]; nextCursor: string | null }>(`/api/feed?${qs}`);
    },
    [lat, lng, radius, category],
  );

  // First page (and focused deep-linked video) whenever position or filters change.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lat === null) return;
    let alive = true;
    const run = async () => {
      setStatus('loading');
      const [page, focused] = await Promise.all([
        fetchPage(null),
        focusId ? api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${focusId}/media`) : Promise.resolve(null),
      ]);
      if (!alive) return;
      if (!page?.ok) return setStatus('error');
      const first = focused?.ok ? [focused.data] : [];
      setItems([...first, ...page.data.items.filter((i) => i.id !== focusId)]);
      setCursor(page.data.nextCursor);
      setActive(0);
      listRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
      setStatus('ready');
    };
    void run();
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [fetchPage, focusId, lat, reloadKey]);

  const loadMore = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!cursor || loadingMore.current) return;
    loadingMore.current = true;
    const page = await fetchPage(cursor);
    loadingMore.current = false;
    if (page?.ok) {
      setItems((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        ...page.data.items.filter((i) => !prev.some((p) => p.id === i.id)),
      ]);
      setCursor(page.data.nextCursor);
    }
  }, [cursor, fetchPage]);

  const loadMoreRef = useRef(loadMore);
  useEffect(() => {
    loadMoreRef.current = loadMore;
  }, [loadMore]);

  // The card that is ≥60 % visible becomes active (autoplay), the next one is preloaded;
  // nearing the end of the list fetches the next page.
  useEffect(() => {
    const root = listRef.current;
    if (!root) return;
    const count = items.length;
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        for (const e of entries) {
          if (!e.isIntersecting || e.intersectionRatio < 0.6) continue;
          const index = Number((e.target as HTMLElement).dataset.index);
          setActive(index);
          if (index >= count - 2) void loadMoreRef.current();
        }
      },
      { root, threshold: [0.6] },
    );
    root.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[data-index]').forEach((el) => observer.observe(el));
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, [items]);

  const goLogin = () => router.push('/login?next=/');

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] w-full">
      <PermissionPrimer
        open={location.status === 'primer'}
        title={t('location.primerTitle')}
        confirmLabel={t('location.allow')}
        cancelLabel={t('location.later')}
        onConfirm={() => void locate()}
        onCancel={dismiss}
      >
        <p>{t('location.primerBody')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      <header className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-20 flex flex-col gap-2 bg-gradient-to-b from-black/80 to-transparent p-3 pb-6">
        <h1 className="sr-only">{t('title')}</h1>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <nav aria-label={t('filters.label')} className="flex flex-1 gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            <FilterChip active={category === null} onClick={() => setCategory(null)}>
              {t('filters.all')}
            </FilterChip>
            {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
              <FilterChip key={c} active={category === c} onClick={() => setCategory(c)}>
                {tc(`categories.${c}`)}
              </FilterChip>
            ))}
          </nav>
          <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="feed-radius">
            {t('filters.radius')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="feed-radius"
            value={radius}
            onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="min-h-11 rounded-full border border-line bg-black/70 px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {RADII_M.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>
                {tc(`radius.${r}`)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>
        {category === 'alert' && (
          <p className="rounded-xl border border-alert/50 bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-white">
            {t('alerts.notice')}
          </p>
        )}
        {coords && (
          <AlertsBanner
            lat={coords.lat}
            lng={coords.lng}
            radius={radius}
            onShow={() => setCategory('alert')}
          />
        )}
        {notice && <Notice kind="success">{notice}</Notice>}
      </header>

      {location.status !== 'ok' && location.status !== 'primer' && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          {location.status === 'locating' || location.status === 'unknown' ? (
            <p role="status" className="text-fog">
              {t('location.locating')}
            </p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Notice kind={location.status === 'denied' ? 'error' : 'info'}>
                {location.status === 'denied' ? t('location.denied') : t('location.needed')}
              </Notice>
              <Button onClick={() => void locate()}>{t('location.allow')}</Button>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {coords && status === 'loading' && items.length === 0 && <FeedSkeleton />}

      {coords && status === 'error' && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="error">{t('error')}</Notice>
          <Button onClick={() => setReloadKey((k) => k + 1)}>{tc('actions.retry')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      {coords && status === 'ready' && items.length === 0 && (
        <div className="flex h-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">{t('empty.title')}</h2>
          <p className="text-fog">{t('empty.body')}</p>
          <Link href="/filmer" className="rounded-xl bg-accent px-5 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">
            {t('empty.cta')}
          </Link>
          {radius < 3000 && (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setRadius(radius === 300 ? 1000 : 3000)}>
              {t('empty.wider', { radius: tc(`radius.${radius === 300 ? 1000 : 3000}`) })}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {items.length > 0 && (
        <div
          ref={listRef}
          className="h-full snap-y snap-mandatory overflow-y-scroll overscroll-contain"
          aria-busy={status === 'loading'}
        >
          {items.map((item, index) => (
            <div key={item.id} data-index={index} className="h-full w-full">
              <VideoCard
                item={item}
                active={index === active}
                load={index === active || index === active + 1}
                muted={muted}
                autoplay={autoplay}
                onToggleMute={() => setMuted((m) => !m)}
                onComments={(i) => setCommentsFor(i.id)}
                onReport={(i) => setReportFor(i.id)}
                onAuthRequired={goLogin}
                signedIn={signedIn}
              />
            </div>
          ))}
          <p className="py-6 text-center text-sm text-fog" role="status">
            {cursor ? t('loadingMore') : t('end')}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {commentsFor && (
        <Comments videoId={commentsFor} signedIn={signedIn} onClose={() => setCommentsFor(null)} />
      )}
      {reportFor && <ReportDialog videoId={reportFor} onClose={() => setReportFor(null)} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function FilterChip({
  active,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={`min-h-9 shrink-0 rounded-full border px-3 text-sm ${active ? 'border-accent bg-accent font-semibold text-ink' : 'border-line bg-black/60 text-white'}`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function FeedSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div
      className="flex h-full flex-col justify-end gap-3 bg-panel p-4 pb-8 motion-safe:animate-pulse"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="h-5 w-24 rounded-full bg-line" />
      <div className="h-5 w-3/4 rounded bg-line" />
      <div className="h-4 w-1/2 rounded bg-line" />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { REPORT_REASONS, type ReportReason } from '@nl/shared';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { Sheet } from './Sheet';

export function ReportDialog({
  videoId,
  onClose,
}: {
  videoId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('video.reportPanel');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [reason, setReason] = useState<ReportReason>('recognizable_person');
  const [details, setDetails] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  const close = () => {
    setStatus(null);
    setDetails('');
    onClose();
  };

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!videoId) return;
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${videoId}/report`, { body: { reason, details } });
    setPending(false);
    if (res.ok) setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    else
      setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: res.error === 'already_reported' ? t('already') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
  }

  return (
    <Sheet open={videoId !== null} title={t('title')} onClose={close} closeLabel={tc('close')}>
      {status?.kind === 'success' ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <Notice kind="success">{status.text}</Notice>
          <Button onClick={close}>{tc('close')}</Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('intro')}</p>
          <fieldset className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <legend className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium">{t('reason')}</legend>
            {REPORT_REASONS.map((r) => (
              <label
                key={r}
                className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line px-3"
              >
                <input
                  type="radio"
                  name="reason"
                  value={r}
                  checked={reason === r}
                  onChange={() => setReason(r)}
                  className="h-5 w-5 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
                />
                {t(`reasons.${r}`)}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
          <Field label={t('details')} htmlFor="report-details">
            <textarea
              id="report-details"
              className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
              maxLength={500}
              value={details}
              onChange={(e) => setDetails(e.target.value)}
            />
          </Field>
          {status && <Notice kind="error">{status.text}</Notice>}
          <Button type="submit" variant="danger" disabled={pending}>
            {t('submit')}
          </Button>
        </form>
      )}
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useId, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Accessible bottom sheet built on <dialog> (focus trap, Escape to close). */
export function Sheet({
  open,
  title,
  onClose,
  closeLabel,
  children,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  closeLabel: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const titleId = useId();
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = ref.current;
    if (!d) return;
    if (open && !d.open) d.showModal();
    if (!open && d.open) d.close();
  }, [open]);
  return (
    <dialog
      ref={ref}
      aria-labelledby={titleId}
      onClose={onClose}
      onClick={(e) => e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()}
      className="mb-0 mt-auto max-h-[80dvh] w-full max-w-lg rounded-t-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-0 text-white backdrop:bg-black/60 sm:m-auto sm:rounded-2xl"
    >
      <div className="flex max-h-[80dvh] flex-col">
        <header className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
          <h2 id={titleId} className="text-lg font-semibold">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label={closeLabel}
            className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center text-2xl"
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </header>
        <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4">{children}</div>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { CATEGORY_COLORS } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useFormatter, useLocale, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import type { FeedItem } from '@/lib/feed';
import { formatDistance } from './format';

interface Props {
  item: FeedItem;
  active: boolean;
  /** Only the visible video and the next one get a source (preload next only). */
  load: boolean;
  muted: boolean;
  autoplay: boolean;
  onToggleMute: () => void;
  onComments: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onReport: (item: FeedItem) => void;
  onAuthRequired: () => void;
  signedIn: boolean;
}

export function VideoCard({
  item,
  active,
  load,
  muted,
  autoplay,
  onToggleMute,
  onComments,
  onReport,
  onAuthRequired,
  signedIn,
}: Props) {
  const t = useTranslations('video');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const locale = useLocale();
  const ref = useRef<HTMLVideoElement>(null);
  const [src, setSrc] = useState(item.videoUrl);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(true);
  const [mediaState, setMediaState] = useState<'loading' | 'ready' | 'error'>('loading');
  const mediaRetries = useRef(0);
  const mediaRequest = useRef<{
    generation: number;
    controller: AbortController | null;
  }>({ generation: 0, controller: null });
  const [useful, setUseful] = useState({ reacted: item.reacted, count: item.usefulCount });
  const [toast, setToast] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [captionExpanded, setCaptionExpanded] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (active && autoplay) void video.play().catch(() => setPaused(true));
    if (!active || !autoplay) video.pause();
  }, [active, autoplay, src]);

  const requestMediaUrl = useCallback(async () => {
    const generation = ++mediaRequest.current.generation;
    mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    mediaRequest.current.controller = controller;

    try {
      const result = await api<FeedItem>(`/api/videos/${item.id}/media`, {
        signal: controller.signal,
      });
      if (controller.signal.aborted || generation !== mediaRequest.current.generation) return null;
      return result;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }, [item.id]);

  const refreshUrl = useCallback(
    async (force = false) => {
      if (mediaRetries.current >= 1) {
        setMediaState('error');
        return;
      }
      mediaRetries.current += 1;
      const res = await requestMediaUrl();
      if (!res) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl && (force || res.data.videoUrl !== src)) {
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        setMediaState('loading');
        return;
      }
      if (force && res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) ref.current?.load();
      setMediaState('error');
    },
    [requestMediaUrl, src],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load || src || mediaRetries.current >= 1) return;

    let current = true;
    mediaRetries.current += 1;
    void requestMediaUrl().then((res) => {
      if (!current || !res) return;
      if (res.ok && res.data.videoUrl) {
        mediaRetries.current = 0;
        setSrc(res.data.videoUrl);
        setMediaState('loading');
      } else {
        setMediaState('error');
      }
    });

    return () => {
      current = false;
    };
  }, [item.id, load, requestMediaUrl, src]);

  useEffect(
    () => () => {
      mediaRequest.current.generation += 1;
      mediaRequest.current.controller?.abort();
      mediaRequest.current.controller = null;
    },
    [item.id],
  );

  function retryMedia() {
    mediaRetries.current = 0;
    setMediaState('loading');
    void refreshUrl(true);
  }

  async function toggleUseful() {
    if (!signedIn) return onAuthRequired();
    const res = await api<{ reacted: boolean; usefulCount: number }>(
      `/api/videos/${item.id}/useful`,
      {
        method: useful.reacted ? 'DELETE' : 'POST',
        body: {},
      },
    );
    if (res.ok) setUseful({ reacted: res.data.reacted, count: res.data.usefulCount });
  }

  async function share() {
    const url = `${window.location.origin}/v/${item.id}`;
    try {
      if (navigator.share)
        await navigator.share({ title: tc(item.category), text: item.caption, url });
      else {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
        setToast(t('shared'));
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2000);
      }
    } catch {
      /* share sheet dismissed */
    }
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    const video = ref.current;
    if (!video) return;
    if (video.paused)
      void video.play().catch(() => {
        setPaused(true);
        setToast(t('playbackError'));
        setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3000);
      });
    else video.pause();
  }

  const distance = item.distanceM === null ? null : formatDistance(item.distanceM, locale);

  return (
    <article
      className="relative h-full w-full snap-start snap-always overflow-hidden bg-black"
      aria-label={`${tc(item.category)} — ${item.caption}`}
      data-testid="feed-item"
      data-video-id={item.id}
    >
      <video
        ref={ref}
        src={load && src ? src : undefined}
        poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
        preload={load ? 'auto' : 'none'}
        playsInline
        muted={muted}
        loop
        onPlay={() => setPaused(false)}
        onPause={() => setPaused(true)}
        onLoadedData={() => {
          mediaRetries.current = 0;
          setMediaState('ready');
        }}
        onError={() => {
          if (load && src) void refreshUrl();
        }}
        onClick={togglePlay}
        className="h-full w-full object-cover"
      />
      {load && mediaState === 'loading' && (
        <p
          role="status"
          className="pointer-events-none absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 rounded-full bg-black/70 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-white"
        >
          {t('mediaLoading')}
        </p>
      )}
      {load && mediaState === 'error' && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 bg-black/70 p-6 text-center">
          <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-white">
            {t('mediaUnavailable')}
          </p>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={retryMedia}

          >
            {t('retryMedia')}

      )}
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={togglePlay}
        aria-label={paused ? t('play') : t('pause')}
        disabled={mediaState !== 'ready'}
        className={`absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 flex h-16 w-16 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-black/50 text-3xl transition-opacity disabled:hidden ${paused ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 focus:opacity-100'}`}
      >
        <span aria-hidden="true">{paused ? '▶' : '❚❚'}</span>
      </button>

      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent px-4 pb-6 pt-24">
        <div className="pointer-events-auto flex max-w-[calc(100%-5rem)] flex-col gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs">
            <span
              className="rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-white"
              style={{ backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[item.category] }}

              {tc(item.category)}
            </span>
            {item.isMerchant && (
              <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-ink">
                {t('merchant')}
              </span>
            )}
            {distance && (
              <span className="text-fog">
                {t('distance', { distance: t(distance.unit, { value: distance.value }) })}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="text-fog">
              · {t('expires', { when: format.relativeTime(new Date(item.expiresAt), now) })}
            </span>
          </div>
          {item.caption && (
            <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-1">
              <p
                className={`text-base font-medium leading-snug ${captionExpanded ? '' : 'line-clamp-3'}`}
              >
                {item.caption}
              </p>
              {item.caption.length > 100 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  aria-expanded={captionExpanded}
                  onClick={() => setCaptionExpanded((expanded) => !expanded)}
                  className="min-h-11 rounded-lg px-1 text-left text-sm font-semibold text-white underline underline-offset-4"
                >
                  {captionExpanded ? t('captionLess') : t('captionMore')}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          <Link
            href={`/u/${item.author.username}`}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-fog"
          >
            <Avatar username={item.author.username} color={item.author.color} size={28} />
            {t('by', { username: item.author.username ?? '' })}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="absolute bottom-6 right-3 flex flex-col items-center gap-4 text-xs">
        <ActionButton
          label={t('usefulCount', { count: useful.count })}
          pressed={useful.reacted}
          onClick={toggleUseful}
          icon="M7 11v9H4v-9zm2 9h8.5a2 2 0 002-1.6l1.4-6A2 2 0 0019 10h-5V6a2 2 0 00-2-2l-3 7z"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('comments', { count: item.commentCount })}
          onClick={() => onComments(item)}
          icon="M4 5h16v11H8l-4 4z"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('share')}
          onClick={share}
          icon="M14 5l6 6-6 6M20 11H9a5 5 0 00-5 5v3"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={t('report')}
          onClick={() => (signedIn ? onReport(item) : onAuthRequired())}
          icon="M5 21V4h11l-1.5 4L16 12H5"
        />
        <ActionButton
          label={muted ? t('unmute') : t('mute')}
          onClick={onToggleMute}
          icon={
            muted
              ? 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM17 9l4 6m0-6l-4 6'
              : 'M4 9h4l5-4v14l-5-4H4zM16 8a5 5 0 010 8m2.5-10.5a8.5 8.5 0 010 13'
          }
        />
      </div>
      {toast && (
        <p
          role="status"

        >
          {toast}
        </p>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function ActionButton({
  label,
  icon,
  onClick,
  pressed,
}: {

}) {
```

```ts
/** "300 m" / "1,2 km" from a 100 m bucketed distance. */
export function formatDistance(
  meters: number,
  locale: string,
): { unit: 'm' | 'km'; value: string } {
  if (meters < 1000) return { unit: 'm', value: String(meters) };
  return {
    unit: 'km',
    value: new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }).format(meters / 1000),
  };
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\map\MapView.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import 'maplibre-gl/dist/maplibre-gl.css';
import { CATEGORIES, CATEGORY_COLORS, RADII_M, type Category } from '@nl/shared';
import type { ExpressionSpecification, GeoJSONSource, Map as MlMap, Marker } from 'maplibre-gl';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { useLocation } from '@/lib/useLocation';
import { circlePolygon, zoomForRadius } from './geometry';

interface Selected {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
}

type FC = { type: 'FeatureCollection'; features: unknown[] };

const colorExpression = [
  'match',
  ['get', 'category'],
  ...CATEGORIES.flatMap((c) => [c, CATEGORY_COLORS[c]]),
  '#9ca3af',
] as unknown as ExpressionSpecification;

export function MapView({ initialRadius }: { initialRadius: number }) {
  const t = useTranslations('map');
  const tf = useTranslations('feed');
  const tc = useTranslations('common');
  const { state: location, locate, dismiss } = useLocation();
  const container = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const mapRef = useRef<MlMap | null>(null);
  const markerRef = useRef<Marker | null>(null);
  const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(initialRadius);
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<Category | null>(null);
  const [count, setCount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Selected | null>(null);

  const lat = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lat : null;
  const lng = location.status === 'ok' ? location.lng : null;

  // Create the map once a position is known.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (lat === null || lng === null || !container.current || mapRef.current) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    void import('maplibre-gl').then((maplibregl) => {
      if (cancelled || !container.current) return;
      maplibregl.setWorkerUrl('/maplibre-gl-worker.mjs');
      const map = new maplibregl.Map({
        container: container.current,
        style: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL,
        center: [lng, lat],
        zoom: zoomForRadius(initialRadius),
        attributionControl: { compact: true },
      });
      mapRef.current = map;
      map.on('load', () => {
        map.addSource('radius', { type: 'geojson', data: circlePolygon(lat, lng, initialRadius) });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-fill',
          type: 'fill',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'fill-color': '#ffd34d', 'fill-opacity': 0.08 },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'radius-line',
          type: 'line',
          source: 'radius',
          paint: { 'line-color': '#ffd34d', 'line-width': 2 },
        });
        map.addSource('videos', {
          type: 'geojson',
          data: { type: 'FeatureCollection', features: [] },
          cluster: true,
          clusterRadius: 42,
          clusterMaxZoom: 17,
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'clusters',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': '#15181d',
            'circle-stroke-color': '#ffd34d',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
            'circle-radius': ['step', ['get', 'point_count'], 16, 10, 22, 30, 28],
          },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'cluster-count',
          type: 'symbol',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['has', 'point_count'],
          layout: { 'text-field': ['get', 'point_count_abbreviated'], 'text-size': 13 },
          paint: { 'text-color': '#ffffff' },
        });
        map.addLayer({
          id: 'points',
          type: 'circle',
          source: 'videos',
          filter: ['!', ['has', 'point_count']],
          paint: {
            'circle-color': colorExpression,
            'circle-radius': 9,
            'circle-stroke-color': '#ffffff',
            'circle-stroke-width': 2,
          },
        });
        map.on('click', 'points', (e) => {
          const p = e.features?.[0]?.properties as Selected | undefined;
          if (p) setSelected({ id: p.id, category: p.category, caption: p.caption });
        });
        map.on('click', 'clusters', async (e) => {
          const feature = e.features?.[0];
          const source = map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource;
          if (!feature) return;
          const zoom = await source.getClusterExpansionZoom(
            feature.properties.cluster_id as number,
          );
          map.easeTo({
            center: (feature.geometry as unknown as { coordinates: [number, number] }).coordinates,
            zoom,
          });
        });
        for (const layer of ['points', 'clusters']) {
          map.on('mouseenter', layer, () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = 'pointer'));
          map.on('mouseleave', layer, () => (map.getCanvas().style.cursor = ''));
        }
        markerRef.current = new maplibregl.Marker({ color: '#ffd34d' })
          .setLngLat([lng, lat])
          .addTo(map);
        setLoaded(true);
      });
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [lat, lng, initialRadius]);

  useEffect(() => () => mapRef.current?.remove(), []);

  // Data + radius overlay follow the position, radius and category filter.
  useEffect(() => {
    const map = mapRef.current;
    if (!loaded || !map || lat === null || lng === null) return;
    (map.getSource('radius') as GeoJSONSource).setData(circlePolygon(lat, lng, radius));
    markerRef.current?.setLngLat([lng, lat]);
    const qs = new URLSearchParams({ lat: String(lat), lng: String(lng), radius: String(radius) });
    if (category) qs.set('category', category);
    let alive = true;
    void api<FC>(`/api/map?${qs}`).then((res) => {
      if (!alive || !res.ok) return;
      (map.getSource('videos') as GeoJSONSource).setData(
        res.data as Parameters<GeoJSONSource['setData']>[0],
      );
      setCount(res.data.features.length);
    });
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, [loaded, lat, lng, radius, category]);

  function relocate() {
    void locate().then(() => {
      const map = mapRef.current;
      if (map && lat !== null && lng !== null)
        map.flyTo({ center: [lng, lat], zoom: zoomForRadius(radius) });
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="relative h-[calc(100dvh-4.5rem)] w-full">
      <h1 className="sr-only">{t('title')}</h1>
      <PermissionPrimer
        open={location.status === 'primer'}
        title={tf('location.primerTitle')}
        confirmLabel={tf('location.allow')}
        cancelLabel={tf('location.later')}
        onConfirm={() => void locate()}
        onCancel={dismiss}
      >
        <p>{tf('location.primerBody')}</p>
      </PermissionPrimer>

      <div ref={container} className="h-full w-full" role="region" aria-label={t('title')} />

      {(location.status === 'denied' || location.status === 'error') && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 p-6 text-center">
          <Notice kind="error">
            {location.status === 'denied' ? tf('location.denied') : tf('location.needed')}
          </Notice>
          <Button onClick={() => void locate()}>{tf('location.allow')}</Button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex flex-col gap-2 p-3">
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
          <Chip active={category === null} onClick={() => setCategory(null)}>
            {tf('filters.all')}
          </Chip>
          {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
            <Chip
              key={c}
              active={category === c}
              onClick={() => setCategory(c)}
              color={CATEGORY_COLORS[c]}
            >
              {tc(`categories.${c}`)}
            </Chip>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <label htmlFor="map-radius" className="sr-only">
            {tf('filters.radius')}
          </label>
          <select
            id="map-radius"
            value={radius}
            onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
            className="min-h-11 rounded-full border border-line bg-black/80 px-3 text-sm"
          >
            {RADII_M.map((r) => (
              <option key={r} value={r}>
                {tc(`radius.${r}`)}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
          {count !== null && (
            <p className="rounded-full bg-black/80 px-3 py-2 text-xs" role="status">
              {t('count', { count })}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <Button
        variant="secondary"
        className="absolute bottom-6 right-3 rounded-full"
        onClick={relocate}
        aria-label={t('locate')}
      >
        <svg
          aria-hidden="true"
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          className="h-5 w-5"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2"
        >
          <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4" />
          <path d="M12 2v3M12 19v3M2 12h3M19 12h3" />
        </svg>
        {t('locate')}
      </Button>
      <p className="absolute bottom-1 left-3 text-[10px] text-fog">{t('attribution')}</p>

      {selected && (
        <div
          className="absolute inset-x-3 bottom-20 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-3 shadow-xl"
          role="dialog"
          aria-label={tc(`categories.${selected.category}`)}
        >
          <span
            className="mt-1 h-3 w-3 shrink-0 rounded-full"
            style={{ backgroundColor: CATEGORY_COLORS[selected.category] }}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold">{tc(`categories.${selected.category}`)}</p>
            <p className="line-clamp-2 text-sm text-fog">{selected.caption}</p>
            <Link
              href={`/?video=${selected.id}`}
              className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-11 items-center rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 font-semibold text-ink"
            >
              {t('open')}
            </Link>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="h-11 w-11 text-xl"
            aria-label={tc('actions.close')}
            onClick={() => setSelected(null)}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Chip({
  active,
  onClick,
  color,
  children,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  color?: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      onClick={onClick}
      className={`flex min-h-9 shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full border px-3 text-sm ${active ? 'border-accent bg-accent font-semibold text-ink' : 'border-line bg-black/80'}`}
    >
      {color && (
        <span
          className="h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full"
          style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
          aria-hidden="true"
        />
      )}
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```

`apps\web\src\components\map\geometry.ts`:

```ts
/** GeoJSON polygon approximating a circle of `radiusM` around a point (for the radius overlay). */
export function circlePolygon(lat: number, lng: number, radiusM: number, steps = 64) {
  const coords: Array<[number, number]> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i += 1) {
    const a = (i / steps) * 2 * Math.PI;
    coords.push([
      lng + (radiusM * Math.cos(a)) / (111_320 * Math.cos((lat * Math.PI) / 180)),
      lat + (radiusM * Math.sin(a)) / 110_540,
    ]);
  }
  return {
    type: 'Feature' as const,
    properties: {},
    geometry: { type: 'Polygon' as const, coordinates: [coords] },
  };
}

/** Zoom level showing the whole radius on a phone screen. */
export const zoomForRadius = (radiusM: number): number =>
  radiusM <= 300 ? 15.5 : radiusM <= 1000 ? 14 : 12.4;
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export function MerchantForm() {
  const t = useTranslations('merchant');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [businessName, setBusinessName] = useState('');
  const [description, setDescription] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/merchant', { body: { businessName, description } });
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <Field label={t('businessName')} htmlFor="m-name">
        <input
          id="m-name"
          className={inputClass}
          maxLength={80}
          required
          value={businessName}
          onChange={(e) => setBusinessName(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Field label={t('description')} htmlFor="m-desc">
        <textarea
          id="m-desc"
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
          maxLength={280}
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={businessName.trim().length < 2}>
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```
