```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useNow, useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

/** Same window as the appeals RLS policy (30 days). */
const APPEAL_WINDOW_MS = 30 * 24 * 3_600_000;

export interface Decision {
  id: number;
  kind: string;
  note: string;
  createdAt: string;
  appealStatus: string | null;
  appealable: boolean;
}

export function Decisions({ items }: { items: Decision[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.decisions');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [reason, setReason] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [appealed, setAppealed] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());

  async function appeal(actionId: number) {
    const res = await api('/api/appeals', { body: { actionId, reason } });
    if (!res.ok) return setStatus({ kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' });
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('appealSent') });
    setAppealed(new Set(appealed).add(actionId));
    setOpen(null);
    setReason('');
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        {items.map((d) => (
          <li key={d.id}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="font-semibold">{t(`kinds.${d.kind}`)}</p>
              {d.note && <p className="text-sm text-fog">{d.note}</p>}
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">{format.relativeTime(new Date(d.createdAt), now)}</p>
              {d.appealStatus && (
                <p className="text-sm">
                  {t('appealed', { status: t(`status.${d.appealStatus}`) })}
                </p>
              )}
              {d.appealable &&
                now.getTime() - new Date(d.createdAt).getTime() < APPEAL_WINDOW_MS &&
                !d.appealStatus &&
                !appealed.has(d.id) &&
                (open === d.id ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    <Field label={t('appealLabel')} htmlFor={`appeal-${d.id}`}>
                      <textarea
                        id={`appeal-${d.id}`}
                        className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
                        maxLength={1000}
                        value={reason}
                        onChange={(e) => setReason(e.target.value)}
                      />
                    </Field>
                    <Button disabled={reason.trim().length < 10} onClick={() => appeal(d.id)}>
                      {t('appeal')}
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(d.id)}>
                    {t('appeal')}
                  </Button>
                ))}
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

export interface QueueItem {
  videoId: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: string;
  hiddenReason: string | null;
  reportCount: number;
  reasons: string[];
  author: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

export interface AppealItem {
  appealId: string;
  reason: string;
  actionKind: string;
  actionNote: string;
  caption: string | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
}

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ModerationQueue({ items }: { items: QueueItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const tr = useTranslations('video.reportPanel.reasons');
  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('empty')}</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.videoId} data-testid="queue-item" data-video-id={item.videoId}>
          <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-sm">
              <strong>{tc(item.category)}</strong>
              <span className="text-fog">@{item.author}</span>
              <span className="rounded-full bg-line px-2 py-0.5 text-xs">
                {t('reports', { count: item.reportCount })}
              </span>
              {item.status === 'hidden' && (
                <span className="rounded-full bg-amber-500 px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold text-ink">
                  {t('hiddenAuto')}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
            {item.videoUrl && (
              <video
                src={item.videoUrl}
                poster={item.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                controls
                playsInline
                preload="metadata"
                className="max-h-96 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
              />
            )}
            {item.caption && <p>{item.caption}</p>}
            {item.reasons.length > 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-fog">
                {t('reasons')} : {item.reasons.map((r) => tr(r)).join(', ')}
              </p>
            )}
            <DecisionForm videoId={item.videoId} />
          </Card>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}

function DecisionForm({ videoId }: { videoId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function decide(action: 'validate' | 'hide' | 'remove' | 'warn') {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'decision', videoId, action, note },
    });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) {
      const noteMissing = res.error === 'invalid_input' || res.error === 'note_required';
      return setStatus({
        kind: 'error',
        text: noteMissing ? t('note') : (errorText(res.error) ?? ''),
      });
    }
    setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('done') });
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Field label={t('note')} htmlFor={`note-${videoId}`}>
        <textarea
          id={`note-${videoId}`}
          className={`${inputClass} min-h-16`}
          maxLength={1000}
          value={note}
          onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Button disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('validate')}>
          {t('actions.validate')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('hide')}>
          {t('actions.hide')}
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="danger"
          disabled={pending || note.trim().length < 3}
          onClick={() => decide('remove')}
        >
          {t('actions.remove')}
        </Button>
        <Button variant="secondary" disabled={pending} onClick={() => decide('warn')}>
          {t('actions.warn')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function AppealsQueue({ items }: { items: AppealItem[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation');
  const tk = useTranslations('moderation.decisions.kinds');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function resolve(appealId: string, uphold: boolean) {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', {
      body: { type: 'appeal', appealId, uphold, note: notes[appealId] ?? '' },
    });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  if (items.length === 0) return <p className="text-fog">{t('appealsEmpty')}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-4">
        {items.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.appealId}>
            <Card className="flex flex-col gap-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
                {tk(a.actionKind)}
                {a.actionNote && <span className="font-normal text-fog"> — {a.actionNote}</span>}
              </p>
              {a.videoUrl && (
                <video
                  src={a.videoUrl}
                  poster={a.posterUrl ?? undefined}
                  controls
                  playsInline
                  preload="metadata"
                  className="max-h-80 w-full rounded-xl bg-black object-contain"
                />
              )}
              {a.caption && <p className="text-sm">{a.caption}</p>}
              <p className="text-sm">
                <span className="text-fog">{t('appealReason')} : </span>
                {a.reason}
              </p>
              <label className="sr-only" htmlFor={`an-${a.appealId}`}>
                {t('note')}
              </label>
              <textarea
                id={`an-${a.appealId}`}
                className={`${inputClass} min-h-14`}
                value={notes[a.appealId] ?? ''}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes({ ...notes, [a.appealId]: e.target.value })}
              />
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                <Button onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, true)}>{t('uphold')}</Button>
                <Button variant="secondary" onClick={() => resolve(a.appealId, false)}>
                  {t('reject')}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </Card>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ApplyForm({ eligible, cells }: { eligible: boolean; cells: string[] }) {
  const t = useTranslations('moderation.apply');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [cell, setCell] = useState(cells[0] ?? '');
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function apply() {
    const res = await api('/api/moderation', { body: { type: 'apply', cell } });
    setStatus(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('done') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('rules')}</p>
      <Notice kind={eligible ? 'success' : 'info'}>
        {eligible ? t('eligible') : t('notEligible')}
      </Notice>
      {eligible &&
        (cells.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('noZone')}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <Field label={t('zone')} htmlFor="apply-cell">
              <select
                id="apply-cell"
                className={inputClass}
                value={cell}
                onChange={(e) => setCell(e.target.value)}
              >
                {cells.map((c) => (
                  <option key={c} value={c}>
                    {c.slice(3, 9)}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </Field>
            <Button onClick={apply}>{t('submit')}</Button>
          </>
        ))}
      {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { isIos, isStandalone } from '@/lib/platform';

import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';

interface InstallPrompt extends Event {
  prompt: () => Promise<void>;
}

const STEPS = ['value', 'permissions', 'rules'] as const;
const INSTALL_STEP = STEPS.length;

export function Onboarding({
  next,
  signedIn,
  initialStep,
}: {
  next: string;
  signedIn: boolean;
  initialStep: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('onboarding');
  const router = useRouter();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(initialStep);
  const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState<InstallPrompt | null>(null);
  const [platform, setPlatform] = useState<'ios' | 'other' | 'installed'>('other');

  useEffect(() => {
    const onPrompt = (e: Event) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setPrompt(e as InstallPrompt);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () => setPlatform(isStandalone() ? 'installed' : isIos() ? 'ios' : 'other'),
      0,
    );
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', onPrompt);
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, []);

  async function finish() {
    // Non-sensitive preference cookie read by src/proxy.ts (no tracking, no personal data).
    document.cookie = `${ONBOARDED_COOKIE}=1; path=/; max-age=31536000; samesite=lax`;
    if (signedIn) await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { onboarded: true } });
    router.replace(next);
  }

  const key = step === INSTALL_STEP ? 'install' : (STEPS[step] ?? 'value');
  const list = (k: string) => t.raw(k) as string[];

  return (
    <main
      id="main"
      className="mx-auto flex h-dvh w-full max-w-xl flex-col gap-4 overflow-hidden px-5 py-4 sm:gap-6 sm:p-6"
    >
      <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between pt-1 text-sm text-fog">
        <p aria-live="polite">
          {t('step', {
            current: Math.min(step + 1, STEPS.length),
            total: STEPS.length,
          })}
        </p>
        <Button variant="ghost" onClick={finish}>
          {t('skip')}
        </Button>
      </div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-1.5" aria-hidden="true">
        {STEPS.map((s, i) => (
          <span
            key={s}
            className={`h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full ${i <= step ? 'bg-accent' : 'bg-line'}`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      <section
        className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain"
        aria-labelledby="onboarding-title"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 pb-4">
          {key === 'value' && (
            <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-accent">
              {t('value.eyebrow')}
            </p>
          )}
          <h1 id="onboarding-title" className="text-2xl font-bold leading-tight sm:text-3xl">
            {t(`${key}.title`)}
          </h1>
          {key === 'value' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-base leading-relaxed text-fog">{t('value.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                {list('value.points').map((p) => (
                  <li
                    key={p}
                    className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel px-3 py-2.5 text-sm leading-relaxed"
                  >
                    <span
                      className="mt-1.5 h-2 w-2 shrink-0 rounded-full bg-accent"
                      aria-hidden="true"
                    />
                    <span>{p}</span>
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'permissions' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('permissions.body')}</p>
              <ul className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {(['camera', 'location', 'notifications'] as const).map((p) => (
                  <li key={p} className="rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3">
                    {t(`permissions.${p}`)}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'install' && (
            <>
              <p className="text-fog">{t('install.body')}</p>
              {platform === 'installed' && <Notice kind="success">{t('install.installed')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'ios' && <Notice>{t('install.ios')}</Notice>}
              {platform === 'other' && (
                <>
                  <Notice>{t('install.android')}</Notice>
                  {prompt && (
                    <Button
                      onClick={async () => {
                        await prompt.prompt();
                        setPrompt(null);
                      }}
                    >
                      {t('install.button')}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('install.ios')}</p>
                </>
              )}
            </>
          )}
          {key === 'rules' && (
            <>
              <ul className="flex list-disc flex-col gap-2 pl-5">
                {list('rules.points').map((p) => (
                  <li key={p}>{p}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <Link href="/legal/regles" className="underline">
                {t('rules.link')}
              </Link>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-3 border-t border-line bg-ink pt-3 pb-[max(0.5rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
        {step > 0 && (
          <Button variant="secondary" className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep(step - 1)}>
            {t('back')}
          </Button>
        )}
        {step < STEPS.length - 1 ? (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={() => setStep(step + 1)}>
            {t('next')}
          </Button>
        ) : (
          <Button className="flex-1" onClick={finish}>
            {t('finish')}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useFormatter, useTranslations, useNow } from 'next-intl';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';

interface OwnVideo {
  id: string;
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  status: 'processing' | 'active' | 'hidden' | 'removed' | 'expired' | 'rejected';
  created_at: string;
}

const statusColor: Record<OwnVideo['status'], string> = {
  processing: 'bg-sky-500',
  active: 'bg-green-500',
  hidden: 'bg-amber-500',
  removed: 'bg-alert',
  expired: 'bg-line',
  rejected: 'bg-alert',
};

async function fetchOwnVideos(): Promise<OwnVideo[] | null> {
  const res = await api<{ videos: OwnVideo[] }>('/api/me/videos');
  return res.ok ? res.data.videos : null;
}

/** Owner view: status of every publication (processing → active / rejected) and withdrawal. */
export function MyVideos() {
  const t = useTranslations('profile');
  const tc = useTranslations('common.categories');
  const format = useFormatter();
  const now = useNow({ updateInterval: 60_000 });
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<OwnVideo[] | null>(null);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<{ kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(() => fetchOwnVideos().then((list) => list && setVideos(list)), []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void fetchOwnVideos().then((list) => alive && list && setVideos(list));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Poll while something is processing so the status flips to active/rejected without reload.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!videos?.some((v) => v.status === 'processing')) return;
    const timer = setInterval(load, 4000);
    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, [videos, load]);

  async function withdraw(id: string) {
    if (!window.confirm(t('withdrawConfirm'))) return;
    const res = await api(`/api/videos/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE', body: {} });
    setMessage(
      res.ok
        ? { kind: 'success', text: t('withdrawn') }
        : { kind: 'error', text: errorText(res.error) ?? '' },
    );
    if (res.ok) void load();
  }

  if (!videos || videos.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="my-videos" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="my-videos" className="text-lg font-semibold">
        {t('myVideos')}
      </h2>
      {message && <Notice kind={message.kind}>{message.text}</Notice>}
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2" aria-live="polite">
        {videos.map((v) => (
          <li
            key={v.id}
            className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3"
            data-testid="own-video"
            data-status={v.status}
          >
            <span
              className={`h-2.5 w-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-full ${statusColor[v.status]}`}
              aria-hidden="true"
            />
            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm">
                <strong>{tc(v.category)}</strong> · {v.caption || '—'}
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-fog">
                {t(`status.${v.status}`)} · {format.relativeTime(new Date(v.created_at), now)}
              </p>
            </div>
            {v.status !== 'removed' && (
              <Button variant="ghost" className="text-sm" onClick={() => withdraw(v.id)}>
                {t('withdraw')}
              </Button>
            )}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { PermissionPrimer } from '@/components/PermissionPrimer';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import {
  currentPosition,
  isIos,
  isStandalone,
  pushSupported,
  swRegistration,
  urlBase64ToUint8Array,
} from '@/lib/platform';

type State = 'loading' | 'unsupported' | 'ios-install' | 'off' | 'on';

async function detectState(): Promise<State> {
  if (isIos() && !isStandalone()) return 'ios-install';
  if (!pushSupported()) return 'unsupported';
  const reg = await swRegistration();
  const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
  return sub ? 'on' : 'off';
}

export function PushSettings({
  notifyAlerts,
  defaultRadius,
}: {
  notifyAlerts: boolean;
  defaultRadius: number;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations('push');
  const ts = useTranslations('settings.notifications');
  const tr = useTranslations('common.radius');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const [state, setState] = useState<State>('loading');
  const [radius, setRadius] = useState(defaultRadius);
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState(notifyAlerts);
  const [primer, setPrimer] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let alive = true;
    void detectState().then((s) => alive && setState(s));
    return () => {
      alive = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function enable() {
    setPrimer(false);
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      if ((await Notification.requestPermission()) !== 'granted') return setError(t('denied'));
      let pos: GeolocationPosition;
      try {
        pos = await currentPosition();
      } catch {
        return setError(t('noPosition'));
      }
      const reg = await swRegistration();
      if (!reg) return setError(errorText('generic'));
      const subscription =
        (await reg.pushManager.getSubscription()) ??
        (await reg.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: urlBase64ToUint8Array(clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY),
        }));
      const json = subscription.toJSON();
      const res = await api('/api/push/subscribe', {
        body: {
          subscription: { endpoint: json.endpoint, keys: json.keys },
          zone: { lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude },
          radius,
        },
      });
      if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
      setState('on');
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function disable() {
    setBusy(true);
    const reg = await swRegistration();
    const sub = await reg?.pushManager.getSubscription();
    if (sub) {
      await api('/api/push/subscribe', { method: 'DELETE', body: { endpoint: sub.endpoint } });
      await sub.unsubscribe();
    }
    setState('off');
    setBusy(false);
  }

  async function toggleAlerts(value: boolean) {
    setAlerts(value);
    const res = await api('/api/me/settings', { method: 'PATCH', body: { notifyAlerts: value } });
    if (!res.ok) setAlerts(!value);
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{ts('title')}</h2>
      <label className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <span>
          {ts('alerts')}
          <span className="block text-xs text-fog">{ts('alertsHint')}</span>
        </span>
        <input
          type="checkbox"
          className="h-6 w-6 accent-[var(--color-accent)]"
          checked={alerts}
          onChange={(e) => toggleAlerts(e.target.checked)}
        />
      </label>

      <h3 className="font-medium">{t('title')}</h3>
      {state === 'unsupported' && <Notice>{t('unsupported')}</Notice>}
      {state === 'ios-install' && (
        <Notice>
          {t('iosInstall')}{' '}
          <Link href="/onboarding?step=install" className="underline">
            {t('iosInstallLink')}
          </Link>
        </Notice>
      )}
      {(state === 'off' || state === 'on') && (
        <>
          <Field label={t('radius')} htmlFor="push-radius">
            <select
              id="push-radius"
              className={inputClass}
              value={radius}
              onChange={(e) => setRadius(Number(e.target.value))}
              disabled={state === 'on'}
            >
              {RADII_M.map((r) => (
                <option key={r} value={r}>
                  {tr(String(r))}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </Field>
          <p className="text-sm text-fog" aria-live="polite">
            {state === 'on' ? t('enabled', { radius: tr(String(radius)) }) : t('disabled')}
          </p>
          {state === 'off' ? (
            <Button onClick={() => setPrimer(true)} disabled={busy}>
              {t('enable')}
            </Button>
          ) : (
            <Button variant="secondary" onClick={disable} disabled={busy}>
              {t('disable')}
            </Button>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      {error && <Notice kind="error">{error}</Notice>}

      <PermissionPrimer
        open={primer}
        title={t('primer.title')}
        confirmLabel={t('primer.continue')}
        cancelLabel={t('primer.later')}
        onConfirm={enable}
        onCancel={() => setPrimer(false)}
      >
        <p>{t('primer.body')}</p>
        <ul className="list-disc pl-5">
          <li>{t('primer.notifications')}</li>
          <li>{t('primer.location')}</li>
        </ul>
      </PermissionPrimer>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { SerwistProvider, useSerwist } from '@serwist/turbopack/react';
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Registers the service worker (scope "/") and renders update / offline banners. */
export function PwaShell({ children, disable }: { children: ReactNode; disable: boolean }) {
  return (
    <SerwistProvider
      swUrl="/serwist/sw.js"
      disable={disable}
      options={{ scope: '/' }}
      reloadOnOnline={false}
    >
      {children}
      <UpdateBanner />
      <OfflineBanner />
    </SerwistProvider>
  );
}

function UpdateBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.update');
  const { serwist } = useSerwist();
  const [waiting, setWaiting] = useState(false);
  const accepted = useRef(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!serwist) return;
    const onWaiting = () => setWaiting(true);
    // Reload only after the user accepted an update, not on the very first install.
    const onControlling = () => {
      if (accepted.current) window.location.reload();
    };
    serwist.addEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
    serwist.addEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    return () => {
      serwist.removeEventListener('waiting', onWaiting);
      serwist.removeEventListener('controlling', onControlling);
    };
  }, [serwist]);
  if (!waiting) return null;
  return (
    <div
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-3 bottom-24 z-50 flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-panel p-3 shadow-xl"
    >
      <p className="flex-1 text-sm">{t('available')}</p>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => {
          accepted.current = true;
          serwist?.messageSkipWaiting();
        }}
        className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-accent px-3 font-semibold text-ink"
      >
        {t('reload')}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function OfflineBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations('common.offline');
  const [offline, setOffline] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOffline(!navigator.onLine);
    const timer = setTimeout(update, 0);
    window.addEventListener('online', update);
    window.addEventListener('offline', update);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      window.removeEventListener('online', update);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', update);
    };
  }, []);
  if (!offline) return null;
  return (
    <p
      role="status"
      className="fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-50 bg-amber-500 px-3 py-1.5 text-center text-sm font-semibold text-ink"
    >
      {t('banner')}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { RADII_M } from '@nl/shared';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Field, inputClass, Notice } from '@/components/ui';
import { useErrorText } from '@/components/useErrorText';

type Status = { kind: 'success' | 'error'; text: string } | null;

export function ProfileForm({ username, bio }: { username: string; bio: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.profile');
  const tw = useTranslations('auth.welcome');
  const ta = useTranslations('common.actions');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [values, setValues] = useState({ username, bio });
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const res = await api('/api/me/profile', { method: 'PATCH', body: values });
    if (res.ok) {
      setStatus({ kind: 'success', text: t('saved') });
      router.refresh();
      return;
    }
    const text =
      res.error === 'conflict'
        ? tw('taken')
        : res.error === 'invalid_input'
          ? tw('invalid')
          : (errorText(res.error) ?? '');
    setStatus({ kind: 'error', text });
  }

  return (
    <Card>
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold">{t('title')}</h2>
        <Field label={t('username')} htmlFor="s-username">
          <input
            id="s-username"
            className={inputClass}
            value={values.username}
            maxLength={20}
            autoCapitalize="none"
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, username: e.target.value.toLowerCase() })}
          />
        </Field>
        <Field label={t('bio')} htmlFor="s-bio" hint={t('bioHint', { count: values.bio.length })}>
          <textarea
            id="s-bio"
            className={`${inputClass} min-h-20`}
            value={values.bio}
            maxLength={160}
            onChange={(e) => setValues({ ...values, bio: e.target.value })}
          />
        </Field>
        {status && <Notice kind={status.kind}>{status.text}</Notice>}
        <Button type="submit">{ta('save')}</Button>
      </form>
    </Card>
  );
}

export function DangerZone({ username }: { username: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations('settings.danger');
  const errorText = useErrorText();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);

  async function remove() {
    setPending(true);
    const res = await api('/api/me', { method: 'DELETE', body: { confirm } });
    setPending(false);
    if (!res.ok) return setError(errorText(res.error));
    router.replace('/?deleted=1');
    router.refresh();
  }

  return (
    <Card className="flex flex-col gap-3 border-alert/60">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-alert">{t('title')}</h2>
      <p className="text-sm text-fog">{t('body')}</p>
      <Field label={t('confirmLabel', { username })} htmlFor="s-confirm" error={error}>
        <input
          id="s-confirm"
          className={inputClass}
          value={confirm}
          autoCapitalize="none"
          onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
        />
      </Field>
      <Button
        variant="danger"
        disabled={pending || confirm.trim().toLowerCase() !== username}
        onClick={remove}
      >
        {t('submit')}
      </Button>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import type { ButtonHTMLAttributes, ReactNode } from 'react';

type Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost';

const variants: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary: 'bg-accent text-ink hover:bg-yellow-300 disabled:bg-yellow-200/60',
  secondary: 'bg-panel text-white border border-line hover:border-fog disabled:opacity-60',
  danger: 'bg-alert text-ink hover:bg-red-400 disabled:opacity-60',
  ghost: 'text-fog hover:text-white disabled:opacity-60',
};

export function Button({
  variant = 'primary',
  className = '',
  ...props
}: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { variant?: Variant }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      {...props}
      className={`inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2 font-semibold transition-colors disabled:cursor-not-allowed ${variants[variant]} ${className}`}
    />
  );
}

export function Card({ children, className = '' }: { children: ReactNode; className?: string }) {
  return (
    <section className={`rounded-2xl border border-line bg-panel p-4 ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

export function Field({
  label,
  hint,
  error,
  htmlFor,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  error?: string | null;
  htmlFor: string;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
      <label htmlFor={htmlFor} className="text-sm font-medium">
        {label}
      </label>
      {children}
      {hint && !error && <p className="text-xs text-fog">{hint}</p>}
      {error && (
        <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-alert">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export const inputClass =
  'min-h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-line bg-ink px-3 py-2 text-white placeholder:text-fog/70 focus:border-accent focus:outline-none';

export function Notice({
  kind = 'info',
  children,
}: {
  kind?: 'info' | 'error' | 'success';
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  const color =
    kind === 'error'
      ? 'border-alert text-alert'
      : kind === 'success'
        ? 'border-green-500 text-green-300'
        : 'border-line text-fog';
  return (
    <p
      role={kind === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}
      className={`rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-sm ${color}`}
    >
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```ts
import type { Locale } from './locales';

/** One JSON file per namespace in messages/<locale>/. */
export const NAMESPACES = [
  'common',
  'auth',
  'profile',
  'settings',
  'capture',
  'feed',
  'map',
  'video',
  'moderation',
  'admin',
  'merchant',
  'push',
  'onboarding',
  'legal',
] as const;

type Messages = { [key: string]: string | Messages };

function deepMerge(base: Messages, override: Messages): Messages {
  const out: Messages = { ...base };
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(override)) {
    const b = out[k];
    out[k] = typeof v === 'object' && typeof b === 'object' ? deepMerge(b, v) : v;
  }
  return out;
}

async function load(locale: Locale, ns: string): Promise<Messages> {
  try {
    return (await import(`../../messages/${locale}/${ns}.json`)).default as Messages;
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

/** French is the reference; other locales override it key by key (missing keys fall back to French). */
export async function loadMessages(locale: Locale): Promise<Messages> {
  const entries = await Promise.all(
    NAMESPACES.map(async (ns) => {
      const fr = await load('fr', ns);
      return [ns, locale === 'fr' ? fr : deepMerge(fr, await load(locale, ns))] as const;
    }),
  );
  return Object.fromEntries(entries);
}
```

```ts
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { getRequestConfig } from 'next-intl/server';
import { isLocale, LOCALE_COOKIE, type Locale } from './locales';
import { loadMessages } from './messages';

// No locale prefix in URLs: the locale comes from a cookie set in the settings page.
export default getRequestConfig(async () => {
  const fromCookie = (await cookies()).get(LOCALE_COOKIE)?.value;
  const locale: Locale = isLocale(fromCookie) ? fromCookie : 'fr';
  return { locale, messages: await loadMessages(locale), timeZone: 'Europe/Paris' };
});
```

`apps\web\src\lib\api.ts`:

```ts
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { ZodError, type ZodType } from 'zod';
import { serverEnv } from '@/lib/env.server';
import { getUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;
  constructor(code: string, status: number) {
    super(code);
    this.status = status;
  }
}

/** Stable error codes raised by SQL functions, mapped to HTTP statuses. */
const DB_ERRORS: Record<string, number> = {
  rate_limited: 429,
  forbidden: 403,
  banned: 403,
  conflict_of_interest: 403,
  not_merchant: 403,
  not_eligible: 403,
  not_local: 403,
  not_found: 404,
  job_not_found: 404,
  note_required: 422,
  invalid_action: 422,
  radius_invalid: 422,
  position_invalid: 422,
  position_incoherent: 422,
  accuracy_too_low: 422,
  profile_incomplete: 409,
  merchant_quota_exceeded: 429,
  video_not_awaiting_upload: 409,
  video_not_active: 409,
  not_revertible: 409,
  review_conflict: 409,
};

export function fromDbError(error: { message: string; code?: string }): ApiError {
  if (error.message in DB_ERRORS)
    return new ApiError(error.message, DB_ERRORS[error.message] ?? 400);
  if (error.code === '23505') return new ApiError('conflict', 409);
  if (error.code === '42501') return new ApiError('forbidden', 403);
  if (error.code === '23514' || error.code === '22P02') return new ApiError('invalid_input', 422);
  console.error('Unexpected database error', error);
  return new ApiError('internal', 500);
}

/** Unwraps a Supabase `{ data, error }` result, converting errors to ApiError. */
export function unwrap<T>(result: {
  data: T | null;
  error: { message: string; code?: string } | null;
}): T {
  if (result.error) throw fromDbError(result.error);
  // Without an error, PostgREST returns data (void RPCs legitimately return null).
  return result.data as T;
}

export const json = (body: unknown, status = 200, headers?: HeadersInit) =>
  NextResponse.json(body, { status, headers: { 'Cache-Control': 'no-store', ...headers } });

/**
 * CSRF protection for cookie-authenticated mutations: the browser always sends `Origin` on
 * cross-site and same-site POST/PATCH/DELETE; it must match the host we are served from.
 */
export function assertSameOrigin(req: Request): void {
  const origin = req.headers.get('origin');
  const host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host') ?? req.headers.get('host');
  if (!origin || !host) throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
  let originHost: string;
  try {
    originHost = new URL(origin).host;
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
  }
  if (originHost !== host) throw new ApiError('bad_origin', 403);
}

type Handler<C> = (req: NextRequest, ctx: C) => Promise<Response>;

/** Wraps a route handler: CSRF check on mutations, uniform JSON errors. */
export function route<C = unknown>(handler: Handler<C>): Handler<C> {
  return async (req, ctx) => {
    try {
      if (!['GET', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'].includes(req.method)) assertSameOrigin(req);
      return await handler(req, ctx);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError) return json({ error: error.message }, error.status);
      if (error instanceof ZodError) {
        return json(
          {
            error: 'invalid_input',
            issues: error.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path.join('.'), message: i.message })),
          },
          422,
        );
      }
      console.error(error);
      return json({ error: 'internal' }, 500);
    }
  };
}

export async function requireUser() {
  const user = await getUser();
  if (!user) throw new ApiError('unauthorized', 401);
  return user;
}

export async function parseBody<T>(req: Request, schema: ZodType<T>): Promise<T> {
  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await req.json();
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError('invalid_json', 400);
  }
  return schema.parse(body);
}

/** Salted hash of the client IP: used as a rate-limit key, never stored raw. */
export const hashKey = (value: string): string =>
  createHash('sha256').update(serverEnv().IP_HASH_SALT).update(value).digest('hex').slice(0, 32);

export function ipKey(req: Request): string {
  const ip =
    req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for')?.split(',')[0]?.trim() ||
    req.headers.get('x-real-ip') ||
    'unknown';
  return hashKey(`ip:${ip}`);
}
```

```ts
import { hashKey, ipKey, unwrap } from '@/lib/api';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/**
 * Brute-force protection for every auth endpoint: counted per IP and per e-mail address
 * (both as salted hashes, never stored raw). Raises `rate_limited` (429).
 */
export async function limitAuthAttempt(req: Request, email: string): Promise<void> {
  const admin = adminClient();
  unwrap(await admin.rpc('check_rate_limit', { p_key: ipKey(req), p_rule: 'login' }));
  unwrap(
    await admin.rpc('check_rate_limit', {
      p_key: hashKey(`email:${email.toLowerCase()}`),
      p_rule: 'login',
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';

vi.mock('idb', () => ({ openDB: vi.fn() }));

const { judge, MAX_AGE_MS } = await import('./offline-queue');
const { containerOf, pickMimeType } = await import('./recorder');

describe('recorder format detection', () => {
  it('prefers MP4 when supported (Safari)', () => {
    const safari = (t: string) => t.startsWith('video/mp4');
    expect(pickMimeType(safari)).toBe('video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2');
  });
  it('falls back to WebM VP9/VP8 (Chrome, Firefox)', () => {
    const chrome = (t: string) => t.startsWith('video/webm');
    expect(pickMimeType(chrome)).toBe('video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus');
    const firefox = (t: string) => t === 'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus' || t === 'video/webm';
    expect(pickMimeType(firefox)).toBe('video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus');
  });
  it('returns null when recording is impossible', () => {
    expect(pickMimeType(() => false)).toBeNull();
  });
  it('maps to the container type sent to the server', () => {
    expect(containerOf('video/mp4;codecs=avc1')).toBe('video/mp4');
    expect(containerOf('video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus')).toBe('video/webm');
  });
});

describe('offline queue republication rules', () => {
  const filmed = { lat: 48.8722, lng: 2.3767, accuracy: 15 };
  const t0 = 1_000_000;
  const item = { fix: filmed, createdAt: t0 };
  it('republishes when still at the same place with a precise fix', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + 60_000, { lat: 48.8725, lng: 2.3768, accuracy: 20 })).toBe('publish');
  });
  it('drops the recording when the user moved away', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + 60_000, { lat: 48.8822, lng: 2.3767, accuracy: 10 })).toBe(
      'drop-moved',
    );
  });
  it('waits for a precise position instead of deciding on a bad fix', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + 60_000, { ...filmed, accuracy: 250 })).toBe('wait-precision');
  });
  it('drops stale recordings', () => {
    expect(judge(item, t0 + MAX_AGE_MS + 1, filmed)).toBe('drop-stale');
  });
});
```

```ts
'use client';

export type ApiResult<T> = { ok: true; data: T } | { ok: false; error: string; status: number };

/** JSON fetch for our own /api routes. Errors come back as stable codes (see lib/api.ts). */
export async function api<T = unknown>(
  path: string,
  init: { method?: string; body?: unknown; signal?: AbortSignal } = {},
): Promise<ApiResult<T>> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(path, {
      method: init.method ?? (init.body === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST'),
      headers: init.body === undefined ? undefined : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: init.body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(init.body),
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      signal: init.signal,
    });
    const data = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as T & { error?: string };
    if (!res.ok) return { ok: false, error: data.error ?? 'generic', status: res.status };
    return { ok: true, data };
  } catch (error) {
    if ((error as Error).name === 'AbortError') throw error;
    return { ok: false, error: 'network', status: 0 };
  }
}
```

```ts
interface CspOptions {
  nonce: string;
  isDev: boolean;
  supabaseUrl: string;
  mapStyleUrl: string;
  siteUrl: string;
}

/** Strict, nonce-based Content-Security-Policy (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md § Web). */
export function buildCsp({ nonce, isDev, supabaseUrl, mapStyleUrl, siteUrl }: CspOptions): string {
  const supabase = new URL(supabaseUrl);
  const realtime = `${supabase.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${supabase.host}`;
  const tiles = new URL(mapStyleUrl).origin;
  const directives: Record<string, string[]> = {
    'default-src': ["'self'"],
    'script-src': [
      "'self'",
      `'nonce-${nonce}'`,
      "'strict-dynamic'",
      ...(isDev ? ["'unsafe-eval'"] : []),
    ],
    // Inline <style> tags carry the nonce; dev tooling injects un-nonced styles.
    'style-src': ["'self'", isDev ? "'unsafe-inline'" : `'nonce-${nonce}'`],
    // style="" attributes (sizes, colours) cannot run script; <style> elements still need the nonce.
    'style-src-attr': ["'unsafe-inline'"],
    'img-src': ["'self'", 'blob:', 'data:', supabase.origin, tiles],
    'media-src': ["'self'", 'blob:', supabase.origin],
    'connect-src': ["'self'", supabase.origin, realtime, tiles],
    'font-src': ["'self'", 'data:'],
    'worker-src': ["'self'", 'blob:'],
    'child-src': ["'self'", 'blob:'],
    'manifest-src': ["'self'"],
    'object-src': ["'none'"],
    'base-uri': ["'self'"],
    'form-action': ["'self'"],
    'frame-ancestors': ["'none'"],
  };
  const parts = Object.entries(directives).map(([k, v]) => `${k} ${v.join(' ')}`);
  if (!isDev && siteUrl.startsWith('https://')) parts.push('upgrade-insecure-requests');
  return parts.join('; ');
}
```

```ts
import type { Category } from '@nl/shared';
import { signMedia } from '@/lib/media';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

/** Public shape of a video in the feed. Never contains the exact position. */
export interface FeedItem {
  id: string;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
  author: { id: string; username: string | null; color: string; isMerchant: boolean };
  publishedAt: string | null;
  expiresAt: string;
  usefulCount: number;
  commentCount: number;
  isMerchant: boolean;
  /** Fuzzed (~50 m) public position. */
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  /** Bucketed to 100 m; null when the viewer position is unknown (deep link). */
  distanceM: number | null;
  videoUrl: string | null;
  posterUrl: string | null;
  reacted: boolean;
}

export interface PublicVideoRow {
  id: string;
  author_id: string;
  author_username: string | null;
  author_color: string;
  author_is_merchant?: boolean;
  category: Category;
  caption: string;
  published_at: string | null;
  expires_at: string;
  useful_count: number;
  comment_count: number;
  is_merchant: boolean;
  public_lat: number;
  public_lng: number;
  distance_m?: number;
}

/** Adds short-lived media URLs and the viewer's "useful" state to public rows. */
export async function hydrate(
  rows: PublicVideoRow[],
  viewerId: string | null,
): Promise<FeedItem[]> {
  if (rows.length === 0) return [];
  const ids = rows.map((r) => r.id);
  const { data: paths } = await adminClient()
    .from('videos')
    .select('id, video_path, poster_path')
    .in('id', ids);
  const byId = new Map((paths ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  const urls = await signMedia((paths ?? []).flatMap((p) => [p.video_path, p.poster_path]));
  let reacted = new Set<string>();
  if (viewerId) {
    const supabase = await createClient();
    const { data } = await supabase.from('reactions').select('video_id').in('video_id', ids);
    reacted = new Set((data ?? []).map((r) => r.video_id));
  }
  return rows.map((r) => {
    const p = byId.get(r.id);
    return {
      id: r.id,
      category: r.category,
      caption: r.caption,
      author: {
        id: r.author_id,
        username: r.author_username,
        color: r.author_color,
        isMerchant: Boolean(r.author_is_merchant ?? r.is_merchant),
      },
      publishedAt: r.published_at,
      expiresAt: r.expires_at,
      usefulCount: r.useful_count,
      commentCount: r.comment_count,
      isMerchant: r.is_merchant,
      lat: r.public_lat,
      lng: r.public_lng,
      distanceM: r.distance_m ?? null,
      videoUrl: p?.video_path ? (urls.get(p.video_path) ?? null) : null,
      posterUrl: p?.poster_path ? (urls.get(p.poster_path) ?? null) : null,
      reacted: reacted.has(r.id),
    };
  });
}
```

```ts
import { VIDEO_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { adminClient, SIGNED_URL_TTL_S } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';

/** Short-lived signed URLs for private processed media (videos bucket only). */
export async function signMedia(
  paths: Array<string | null | undefined>,
): Promise<Map<string, string>> {
  const unique = [...new Set(paths.filter((p): p is string => Boolean(p)))];
  const out = new Map<string, string>();
  if (unique.length === 0) return out;
  const { data, error } = await adminClient()
    .storage.from(VIDEO_BUCKET)
    .createSignedUrls(unique, SIGNED_URL_TTL_S);
  if (error) throw error;
  for (const row of data) if (row.path && row.signedUrl) out.set(row.path, row.signedUrl);
  return out;
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { haversineMeters, MAX_ACCURACY_M } from '@nl/shared';
import { openDB, type IDBPDatabase } from 'idb';
import type { Fix, PublishMeta } from '@/lib/publish';

/** A recording kept on the device while offline. Stored only in this browser (IndexedDB). */
export interface QueuedPublication {
  id: string;
  blob: Blob;
  meta: PublishMeta;
  fix: Fix;
  createdAt: number;
  reserved?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string };
}

/** A queued video is republished only if the device is still within this distance of where it was filmed. */
export const MAX_DRIFT_M = 100;
/** Older recordings are dropped: hyperlocal news goes stale (alerts live 6 h). */
export const MAX_AGE_MS = 6 * 3_600_000;

let db: Promise<IDBPDatabase> | undefined;
const store = () =>
  (db ??= openDB('neighbors-live', 1, {
    upgrade(d) {
      d.createObjectStore('outbox', { keyPath: 'id' });
    },
  }));

export async function enqueue(item: QueuedPublication): Promise<void> {
  await (await store()).put('outbox', item);
}

export async function listQueued(): Promise<QueuedPublication[]> {
  return (await store()).getAll('outbox');
}

export async function removeQueued(id: string): Promise<void> {
  await (await store()).delete('outbox', id);
}

export type Verdict = 'publish' | 'drop-stale' | 'drop-moved' | 'wait-precision';

/** Decides what to do with a queued recording given the device's current position. */
export function judge(
  item: Pick<QueuedPublication, 'fix' | 'createdAt'>,
  now: number,
  current: Fix,
): Verdict {
  if (now - item.createdAt > MAX_AGE_MS) return 'drop-stale';
  if (current.accuracy > MAX_ACCURACY_M) return 'wait-precision';
  if (haversineMeters(item.fix, current) > MAX_DRIFT_M) return 'drop-moved';
  return 'publish';
}
```

```ts
'use client';

export const isIos = (): boolean =>
  typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
  (/iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(navigator.userAgent) ||
    (navigator.platform === 'MacIntel' && navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1));

/** True when running as an installed PWA (home screen), required for Web Push on iOS. */
export const isStandalone = (): boolean =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
  (window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches ||
    (navigator as Navigator & { standalone?: boolean }).standalone === true);

export const pushSupported = (): boolean =>
  typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
  'serviceWorker' in navigator &&
  'PushManager' in window &&
  'Notification' in window;

/** One-shot high-accuracy position (never watched, never stored client-side). */
export function currentPosition(timeoutMs = 15_000): Promise<GeolocationPosition> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (!('geolocation' in navigator)) return reject(new Error('unsupported'));
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(resolve, reject, {
      enableHighAccuracy: true,
      timeout: timeoutMs,
      maximumAge: 0,
    });
  });
}

/** Service worker registration, or null if none becomes ready in time. */
export async function swRegistration(timeoutMs = 5000): Promise<ServiceWorkerRegistration | null> {
  if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return null;
  return Promise.race([
    navigator.serviceWorker.ready,
    new Promise<null>((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve(null), timeoutMs)),
  ]);
}

export function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const padded = (base64 + '='.repeat((4 - (base64.length % 4)) % 4))
    .replace(/-/g, '+')
    .replace(/_/g, '/');
  const raw = atob(padded);
  const out = new Uint8Array(new ArrayBuffer(raw.length));
  for (let i = 0; i < raw.length; i += 1) out[i] = raw.charCodeAt(i);
  return out;
}
```

```ts
'use client';

import { RAW_BUCKET } from '@nl/shared';
import { Upload } from 'tus-js-client';
import { api } from '@/lib/client-api';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { browserClient } from '@/lib/supabase/browser';

export interface PublishMeta {
  category: string;
  caption: string;
  mimeType: 'video/mp4' | 'video/webm';
  durationMs: number;
  eventEndsAt?: string;
  merchantHours?: number;
}

export interface Fix {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  accuracy: number;
}

export class PublishError extends Error {
  readonly code: string;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  constructor(code: string, retryable: boolean) {
    super(code);
    this.code = code;
    this.retryable = retryable;
  }
}

/** Resumable upload (TUS, 6 MB chunks as required by Supabase) with automatic retries. */
function tusUpload(
  file: Blob,
  path: string,
  contentType: string,
  token: string,
  onProgress: (p: number) => void,
) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const upload = new Upload(file, {
      endpoint: `${clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/upload/resumable`,
      retryDelays: [0, 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000, 20000],
      headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'x-upsert': 'false' },
      uploadDataDuringCreation: true,
      removeFingerprintOnSuccess: true,
      metadata: { bucketName: RAW_BUCKET, objectName: path, contentType, cacheControl: '3600' },
      chunkSize: 6 * 1024 * 1024,
      onError: reject,
      onProgress: (sent, total) => onProgress(total ? Math.round((sent / total) * 100) : 0),
      onSuccess: () => resolve(),
    });
    void upload.findPreviousUploads().then((previous) => {
      if (previous[0]) upload.resumeFromPreviousUpload(previous[0]);
      upload.start();
    });
  });
}

/**
 * Full publication: reserve (server validation) → resumable upload → confirm.
 * `existingVideoId` lets the offline queue resume a publication already reserved.
 */
export async function publish(
  file: Blob,
  meta: PublishMeta,
  fix: Fix,
  onProgress: (percent: number) => void,
  existing?: { videoId: string; uploadPath: string },
): Promise<{ videoId: string }> {
  let target = existing;
  if (!target) {
    const res = await api<{ videoId: string; uploadPath: string }>('/api/videos', {
      body: { ...meta, ...fix, sizeBytes: file.size },
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new PublishError(res.error, res.status === 0);
    target = res.data;
  }
  const { data } = await browserClient().auth.getSession();
  const token = data.session?.access_token;
  if (!token) throw new PublishError('unauthorized', false);
  try {
    await tusUpload(file, target.uploadPath, meta.mimeType, token, onProgress);
  } catch {
    throw new PublishError('network', true);
  }
  const done = await api(`/api/videos/${target.videoId}/uploaded`, { body: {} });
  if (!done.ok) throw new PublishError(done.error, done.status === 0);
  return { videoId: target.videoId };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * MediaRecorder formats in order of preference. Safari (iOS/macOS) records MP4/H.264,
 * Chrome/Firefox/Android record WebM. The worker transcodes everything to MP4 anyway.
 */
export const MIME_CANDIDATES = [
  'video/mp4;codecs=avc1.42E01E,mp4a.40.2',
  'video/mp4',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus',
  'video/webm;codecs=vp8,opus',
  'video/webm',
] as const;

export function pickMimeType(isSupported: (type: string) => boolean): string | null {
  return MIME_CANDIDATES.find((t) => isSupported(t)) ?? null;
}

/** Container type sent to the server ("video/mp4" | "video/webm"), without codecs. */
export const containerOf = (mime: string): 'video/mp4' | 'video/webm' =>
  mime.startsWith('video/mp4') ? 'video/mp4' : 'video/webm';
```

```ts
import { cache } from 'react';
import { adminClient } from '@/lib/supabase/admin';
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server';

export interface Viewer {
  id: string;
  email: string | undefined;
  username: string | null;
  bio: string;
  avatarColor: string;
  role: 'user' | 'merchant' | 'admin';
  reputation: number;
  banned: boolean;
  isModerator: boolean;
  moderatedCells: string[];
  settings: { defaultRadius: number; locale: string; notifyAlerts: boolean; onboarded: boolean };
}

/** The verified signed-in user with profile, settings and roles (deduplicated per request). */
export const getViewer = cache(async (): Promise<Viewer | null> => {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  const user = data.user;
  if (!user) return null;
  const admin = adminClient();
  const [profile, settings, zones] = await Promise.all([
    admin
      .from('profiles')
      .select('username, bio, avatar_color, role, reputation, banned_at')
      .eq('id', user.id)
      .single(),
    supabase
      .from('user_settings')
      .select('default_radius, locale, notify_alerts, onboarded_at')
      .eq('user_id', user.id)
      .single(),
    admin.from('zone_moderators').select('h3_cell').eq('user_id', user.id),
  ]);
  if (!profile.data) return null;
  const cells = (zones.data ?? []).map((z) => z.h3_cell);
  return {
    id: user.id,
    email: user.email,
    username: profile.data.username,
    bio: profile.data.bio,
    avatarColor: profile.data.avatar_color,
    role: profile.data.role,
    reputation: profile.data.reputation,
    banned: profile.data.banned_at !== null,
    isModerator: cells.length > 0 || profile.data.role === 'admin',
    moderatedCells: cells,
    settings: {
      defaultRadius: settings.data?.default_radius ?? 1000,
      locale: settings.data?.locale ?? 'fr',
      notifyAlerts: settings.data?.notify_alerts ?? true,
      onboarded: Boolean(settings.data?.onboarded_at),
    },
  };
});
```

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import type { Database } from '@nl/shared';
import { cookies } from 'next/headers';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';

/** Supabase client acting as the signed-in user (RLS applies). Server components & routes. */
export async function createClient() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  return createServerClient<Database>(
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => cookieStore.getAll(),
        setAll: (toSet) => {
          try {
            for (const { name, value, options } of toSet) cookieStore.set(name, value, options);
          } catch {
            // Called from a Server Component: cookies are refreshed by src/proxy.ts instead.
          }
        },
      },
    },
  );
}

/** Verified current user (validated against the Auth server), or null. */
export async function getUser() {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  return data.user;
}
```

```ts
import { CATEGORY_COLORS } from '@nl/shared';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { initialsColor } from '@/components/Avatar';
import { buildCsp } from './csp';
import { safeNext } from './redirect';

const lum = (hex: string) => {
  const ch = (i: number) => {
    const c = parseInt(hex.slice(i, i + 2), 16) / 255;
    return c <= 0.03928 ? c / 12.92 : ((c + 0.055) / 1.055) ** 2.4;
  };
  return 0.2126 * ch(1) + 0.7152 * ch(3) + 0.0722 * ch(5);
};
const contrast = (a: string, b: string) => {
  const [x, y] = [lum(a), lum(b)].sort((p, q) => q - p) as [number, number];
  return (x + 0.05) / (y + 0.05);
};

describe('accessibility of generated colours', () => {
  it('category chips keep white text at WCAG AA (4.5:1)', () => {
    for (const color of Object.values(CATEGORY_COLORS)) {
      expect(contrast('#ffffff', color)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
    }
  });
  it('avatar initials pick the readable text colour', () => {
    for (const bg of [
      '#ef4444',
      '#f97316',
      '#d97706',
      '#16a34a',
      '#0d9488',
      '#0284c7',
      '#4f46e5',
    ]) {
      expect(contrast(initialsColor(bg), bg)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4.5);
    }
  });
});

describe('csp', () => {
  const base = {
    nonce: 'abc',
    supabaseUrl: 'https://p.supabase.co',
    mapStyleUrl: 'https://tiles.example.org/styles/x',
    siteUrl: 'https://app.example.org',
  };
  it('is strict in production', () => {
    const csp = buildCsp({ ...base, isDev: false });
    expect(csp).toContain("script-src 'self' 'nonce-abc' 'strict-dynamic'");
    expect(csp).not.toContain('unsafe-eval');
    expect(csp).toContain("style-src 'self' 'nonce-abc'");
    expect(csp).toContain("frame-ancestors 'none'");
    expect(csp).toContain('connect-src');
    expect(csp).toContain('wss://p.supabase.co');
    expect(csp).toContain('upgrade-insecure-requests');
  });
  it('relaxes eval only in development', () => {
    expect(buildCsp({ ...base, isDev: true })).toContain("'unsafe-eval'");
  });
});

describe('safeNext (open redirect protection)', () => {
  it('keeps same-site paths and rejects others', () => {
    expect(safeNext('/carte?x=1')).toBe('/carte?x=1');
    expect(safeNext('//evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext('https://evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext('/\\evil.example')).toBe('/');
    expect(safeNext(null)).toBe('/');
  });
});
```

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { currentPosition } from '@/lib/platform';

export type LocationState =
  | { status: 'unknown' }
  | { status: 'primer' }
  | { status: 'locating' }
  | { status: 'ok'; lat: number; lng: number }
  | { status: 'denied' }
  | { status: 'error' };

const PRIMED_KEY = 'nl-location-primed';

function readPrimed(): boolean {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(PRIMED_KEY) === '1';
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * Viewer position for feed/map queries. The explanation screen is shown before the first
 * system prompt; afterwards the position is re-read on each visit. Nothing is persisted.
 * `?lat=&lng=` overrides it (manual exploration, demos and tests).
 */
export function useLocation() {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LocationState>({ status: 'unknown' });

  const locate = useCallback(async () => {
    setState({ status: 'locating' });
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(PRIMED_KEY, '1');
    } catch {
      /* private mode: the primer will simply show again next time */
    }
    try {
      const pos = await currentPosition();
      setState({ status: 'ok', lat: pos.coords.latitude, lng: pos.coords.longitude });
    } catch (e) {
      setState({ status: (e as GeolocationPositionError).code === 1 ? 'denied' : 'error' });
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const lat = Number(params.get('lat'));
    const lng = Number(params.get('lng'));
    let cancelled = false;
    void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      if (params.has('lat') && Number.isFinite(lat) && Number.isFinite(lng)) {
        setState({ status: 'ok', lat, lng });
      } else if (readPrimed()) {
        void locate();
      } else {
        setState({ status: 'primer' });
      }
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [locate]);

  return { state, locate, dismiss: () => setState({ status: 'error' }) };
}
```

```ts
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr';
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server';
import { buildCsp } from '@/lib/csp';
import { clientEnv } from '@/lib/env';
import { ONBOARDED_COOKIE } from '@/lib/onboarding';
/** App screens that first-time visitors only reach after the core onboarding. */
const GATED = /^\/(carte|me|u\/[^/]+|parametres|moderation|commerce|admin)?$/;

/** Refreshes the Supabase session cookies and sets a per-request CSP nonce. */
export async function proxy(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname, search } = request.nextUrl;
  if (GATED.test(pathname) && !request.cookies.has(ONBOARDED_COOKIE)) {
    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();
    url.pathname = '/onboarding';
    url.search = `?next=${encodeURIComponent(pathname + search)}`;
    return NextResponse.redirect(url);
  }

  const nonce = Buffer.from(crypto.randomUUID()).toString('base64');
  const csp = buildCsp({
    nonce,
    isDev: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development',
    supabaseUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    mapStyleUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL,
    siteUrl: clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL,
  });

  const forward = () => {
    const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
    headers.set('x-nonce', nonce);
    headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', csp);
    headers.set('cookie', request.cookies.toString());
    return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers } });
  };

  let response = forward();
  const supabase = createServerClient(
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    clientEnv.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    {
      cookies: {
        getAll: () => request.cookies.getAll(),
        setAll: (toSet) => {
          for (const { name, value } of toSet) request.cookies.set(name, value);
          response = forward();
          for (const { name, value, options } of toSet) response.cookies.set(name, value, options);
        },
      },
    },
  );
  // Revalidates and, if needed, refreshes the session; must run before any render.
  await supabase.auth.getUser();

  response.headers.set('Content-Security-Policy', csp);
  return response;
}

export const config = {
  matcher: [
    '/((?!_next/static|_next/image|serwist/|icons/|manifest.webmanifest|favicon.ico|.*\\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|svg|webp|ico)$).*)',
  ],
};
```

`apps\worker\scripts\check-blur.ts`:

```ts
// Manual verification of the face pipeline on real media (run inside the worker container):
//   node scripts/check-blur.ts image <file.jpg>                    → prints detected faces
//   node scripts/check-blur.ts video <in> <out.mp4> <poster.jpg>   → full blur + transcode
import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { YunetFaceDetector } from '../src/blur/yunet.ts';
import { blurAndTranscode } from '../src/media/pipeline.ts';

const [mode, input, output, poster] = process.argv.slice(2);
const model = process.env.FACE_MODEL_PATH ?? 'models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx';
const detector = await YunetFaceDetector.load(model);

if (mode === 'image' && input) {
  const size = spawnSync(
    'ffprobe',
    [
      '-v',
      'error',
      '-select_streams',
      'v:0',
      '-show_entries',
      'stream=width,height',
      '-of',
      'csv=p=0',
      input,
    ],
    { encoding: 'utf8' },
  );
  const [width = 0, height = 0] = size.stdout.trim().split(',').map(Number);
  const raw = spawnSync(
    'ffmpeg',
    ['-v', 'error', '-i', input, '-f', 'rawvideo', '-pix_fmt', 'rgb24', 'pipe:1'],
    {
      maxBuffer: 1 << 28,
    },
  );
  const started = Date.now();
  const faces = await detector.detect({ data: new Uint8Array(raw.stdout), width, height });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ width, height, ms: Date.now() - started, faces }, null, 2));
} else if (mode === 'video' && input && output && poster) {
  const started = Date.now();
  const stats = await blurAndTranscode(input, output, poster, {
    detectors: [detector],
    detectEvery: 2,
  });
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ ...stats, ms: Date.now() - started }));
} else {
  console.error('usage: check-blur.ts image <file> | video <in> <out.mp4> <poster.jpg>');
  process.exit(2);
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\geometry.ts`:

```ts
import type { Box, Frame } from './types.ts';

export function iou(a: Box, b: Box): number {
  const x1 = Math.max(a.x, b.x);
  const y1 = Math.max(a.y, b.y);
  const x2 = Math.min(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w);
  const y2 = Math.min(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h);
  const inter = Math.max(0, x2 - x1) * Math.max(0, y2 - y1);
  const union = a.w * a.h + b.w * b.h - inter;
  return union <= 0 ? 0 : inter / union;
}

/** Greedy non-maximum suppression, highest score first. */
export function nms(boxes: Box[], threshold: number): Box[] {
  const sorted = [...boxes].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const kept: Box[] = [];
  for (const box of sorted) if (kept.every((k) => iou(k, box) < threshold)) kept.push(box);
  return kept;
}

/** Grows a box by `ratio` on each side (privacy margin for hair, ears, motion). */
export function expand(box: Box, ratio: number): Box {
  const dx = box.w * ratio;
  const dy = box.h * ratio;
  return { ...box, x: box.x - dx, y: box.y - dy, w: box.w + 2 * dx, h: box.h + 2 * dy };
}

export interface Letterbox {
  /** CHW float32 tensor data, BGR order, values 0..255 (YuNet convention). */
  tensor: Float32Array;
  scale: number;
}

/**
 * Resizes (bilinear) an RGB frame into a size×size square, top-left aligned and zero padded,
 * and converts it to a BGR CHW float tensor.
 */
export function letterboxBgr(frame: Frame, size: number): Letterbox {
  const scale = size / Math.max(frame.width, frame.height);
  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.width * scale));
  const h = Math.max(1, Math.round(frame.height * scale));
  const plane = size * size;
  const tensor = new Float32Array(3 * plane);
  const src = frame.data;
  const sw = frame.width;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 1) {
    const fy = Math.min(frame.height - 1, (y + 0.5) / scale - 0.5);
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(fy));
    const y1 = Math.min(frame.height - 1, y0 + 1);
    const wy = fy - y0;
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 1) {
      const fx = Math.min(sw - 1, (x + 0.5) / scale - 0.5);
      const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(fx));
      const x1 = Math.min(sw - 1, x0 + 1);
      const wx = fx - x0;
      const i00 = (y0 * sw + x0) * 3;
      const i01 = (y0 * sw + x1) * 3;
      const i10 = (y1 * sw + x0) * 3;
      const i11 = (y1 * sw + x1) * 3;
      const o = y * size + x;
      for (let c = 0; c < 3; c += 1) {
        const top = (src[i00 + c] ?? 0) * (1 - wx) + (src[i01 + c] ?? 0) * wx;
        const bottom = (src[i10 + c] ?? 0) * (1 - wx) + (src[i11 + c] ?? 0) * wx;
        // RGB -> BGR planes.
        tensor[(2 - c) * plane + o] = top * (1 - wy) + bottom * wy;
      }
    }
  }
  return { tensor, scale };
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\pixelate.ts`:

```ts
import type { Box, Frame } from './types.ts';

/**
 * Irreversibly pixelates the boxes in place: each box is split into ~`blocks` cells across,
 * every cell is replaced by its mean colour.
 */
export function pixelate(frame: Frame, boxes: Box[], blocks = 6): void {
  const { data, width, height } = frame;
  for (const box of boxes) {
    const x0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(box.x));
    const y0 = Math.max(0, Math.floor(box.y));
    const x1 = Math.min(width, Math.ceil(box.x + box.w));
    const y1 = Math.min(height, Math.ceil(box.y + box.h));
    if (x1 <= x0 || y1 <= y0) continue;
    const cell = Math.max(4, Math.ceil((x1 - x0) / blocks));
    for (let cy = y0; cy < y1; cy += cell) {
      for (let cx = x0; cx < x1; cx += cell) {
        const ex = Math.min(x1, cx + cell);
        const ey = Math.min(y1, cy + cell);
        let r = 0;
        let g = 0;
        let b = 0;
        const n = (ex - cx) * (ey - cy);
        for (let y = cy; y < ey; y += 1) {
          for (let x = cx; x < ex; x += 1) {
            const i = (y * width + x) * 3;
            r += data[i] ?? 0;
            g += data[i + 1] ?? 0;
            b += data[i + 2] ?? 0;
          }
        }
        r = Math.round(r / n);
        g = Math.round(g / n);
        b = Math.round(b / n);
        for (let y = cy; y < ey; y += 1) {
          for (let x = cx; x < ex; x += 1) {
            const i = (y * width + x) * 3;
            data[i] = r;
            data[i + 1] = g;
            data[i + 2] = b;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
