`apps\worker\src\blur\plates.ts`:

```ts
import * as ort from 'onnxruntime-node';
import { letterboxBgr, nms } from './geometry.ts';
import { DisabledDetector, type Box, type Detector, type Frame } from './types.ts';

const INPUT = 640;

/**
 * Decodes a single-class YOLOv8-style detection head, output shape [1, 5, N]
 * (cx, cy, w, h, score per anchor), in the 640×640 input space.
 */
export function decodeYoloSingleClass(
  data: Float32Array,
  anchors: number,
  minScore: number,
): Box[] {
  const boxes: Box[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < anchors; i += 1) {
    const score = data[4 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    if (score < minScore) continue;
    const cx = data[i] ?? 0;
    const cy = data[anchors + i] ?? 0;
    const w = data[2 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    const h = data[3 * anchors + i] ?? 0;
    boxes.push({ x: cx - w / 2, y: cy - h / 2, w, h, score });
  }
  return boxes;
}

/**
 * Licence plate detector. No reliable, openly licensed plate model is bundled with the project:
 * it only runs when an operator provides one (PLATE_MODEL_PATH, YOLOv8 single-class ONNX export,
 * 640×640 input). See docs/PRIVACY.md for the real coverage.
 */
export class OnnxPlateDetector implements Detector {
  readonly name = 'plate-yolo';
  readonly enabled = true;
  private readonly session: ort.InferenceSession;
  private readonly minScore: number;

  private constructor(session: ort.InferenceSession, minScore: number) {
    this.session = session;
    this.minScore = minScore;
  }

  static async load(modelPath: string, minScore = 0.35): Promise<OnnxPlateDetector> {
    return new OnnxPlateDetector(await ort.InferenceSession.create(modelPath), minScore);
  }

  async detect(frame: Frame): Promise<Box[]> {
    const { tensor, scale } = letterboxBgr(frame, INPUT);
    // YOLO models expect RGB normalised to 0..1: swap the BGR planes back and rescale.
    const plane = INPUT * INPUT;
    const rgb = new Float32Array(tensor.length);
    for (let c = 0; c < 3; c += 1) {
      const src = tensor.subarray((2 - c) * plane, (3 - c) * plane);
      for (let i = 0; i < plane; i += 1) rgb[c * plane + i] = (src[i] ?? 0) / 255;
    }
    const inputName = this.session.inputNames[0] ?? 'images';
    const outputName = this.session.outputNames[0] ?? 'output0';
    const result = await this.session.run({
      [inputName]: new ort.Tensor('float32', rgb, [1, 3, INPUT, INPUT]),
    });
    const out = result[outputName];
    if (!out) return [];
    const anchors = out.dims[2] ?? 0;
    const boxes = decodeYoloSingleClass(out.data as Float32Array, anchors, this.minScore);
    return nms(boxes, 0.4).map((b) => ({
      x: b.x / scale,
      y: b.y / scale,
      w: b.w / scale,
      h: b.h / scale,
      score: b.score,
    }));
  }
}

export async function createPlateDetector(
  enabled: boolean,
  modelPath: string | undefined,
): Promise<Detector> {
  if (!enabled || !modelPath) return new DisabledDetector('plate');
  return OnnxPlateDetector.load(modelPath);
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\tracker.ts`:

```ts
import { expand, iou } from './geometry.ts';
import type { Box } from './types.ts';

interface Track {
  box: Box;
  vx: number;
  vy: number;
  /** Frames since the last matching detection. */
  missed: number;
}

export interface TrackerOptions {
  /** Frames a track survives without detection (covers detector misses and skipped frames). */
  ttl: number;
  /** IoU needed to associate a detection with an existing track. */
  matchIou: number;
  /** Safety margin added around every blurred box (fraction of its size per side). */
  margin: number;
}

/**
 * Simple IoU tracker: associates detections with tracks, extrapolates motion with a constant
 * velocity while a face is not detected, and keeps blurring for `ttl` frames after it was lost.
 */
export class BoxTracker {
  private tracks: Track[] = [];
  private readonly opts: TrackerOptions;

  constructor(opts: Partial<TrackerOptions> = {}) {
    this.opts = { ttl: 8, matchIou: 0.2, margin: 0.25, ...opts };
  }

  /** Advances one frame. Pass `detections` when the detector ran on this frame, else null. */
  step(detections: Box[] | null): Box[] {
    for (const t of this.tracks) {
      t.box = { ...t.box, x: t.box.x + t.vx, y: t.box.y + t.vy };
      t.missed += 1;
    }
    if (detections) {
      const free = new Set(this.tracks);
      for (const d of [...detections].sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)) {
        let best: Track | undefined;
        let bestIou = this.opts.matchIou;
        for (const t of free) {
          const v = iou(t.box, d);
          if (v >= bestIou) {
            best = t;
            bestIou = v;
          }
        }
        if (best) {
          free.delete(best);
          // Per-frame displacement since the last detection, smoothed.
          const lastX = best.box.x - best.missed * best.vx;
          const lastY = best.box.y - best.missed * best.vy;
          best.vx = 0.5 * best.vx + (0.5 * (d.x - lastX)) / best.missed;
          best.vy = 0.5 * best.vy + (0.5 * (d.y - lastY)) / best.missed;
          best.box = d;
          best.missed = 0;
        } else {
          this.tracks.push({ box: d, vx: 0, vy: 0, missed: 0 });
        }
      }
    }
    this.tracks = this.tracks.filter((t) => t.missed <= this.opts.ttl);
    return this.tracks.map((t) => expand(t.box, this.opts.margin));
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Axis-aligned box in pixel coordinates of the frame it was detected on. */
export interface Box {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  score: number;
}

/** Packed RGB24 frame (row-major, 3 bytes per pixel). */
export interface Frame {
  data: Uint8Array;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/**
 * A detector of things to blur (faces, licence plates…). Implementations must favour recall:
 * a missed face is a privacy incident, an extra blurred patch is not.
 */
export interface Detector {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly enabled: boolean;
  detect(frame: Frame): Promise<Box[]>;
}

/** Detector used when a capability is switched off or no reliable model is available. */
export class DisabledDetector implements Detector {
  readonly enabled = false;
  readonly name: string;
  constructor(name: string) {
    this.name = name;
  }
  async detect(): Promise<Box[]> {
    return [];
  }
}
```

`apps\worker\src\blur\yunet.ts`:

```ts
import * as ort from 'onnxruntime-node';
import { letterboxBgr, nms } from './geometry.ts';
import type { Box, Detector, Frame } from './types.ts';

const INPUT = 640;
const STRIDES = [8, 16, 32] as const;

export interface YunetOutputs {
  cls: Float32Array[];
  obj: Float32Array[];
  bbox: Float32Array[];
}

/**
 * Decodes YuNet (opencv_zoo face_detection_yunet_2023mar) raw outputs into boxes in the
 * 640×640 input space. Same maths as OpenCV's FaceDetectorYN.
 */
export function decodeYunet(out: YunetOutputs, minScore: number): Box[] {
  const boxes: Box[] = [];
  STRIDES.forEach((stride, s) => {
    const cols = INPUT / stride;
    const cls = out.cls[s];
    const obj = out.obj[s];
    const bbox = out.bbox[s];
    if (!cls || !obj || !bbox) return;
    for (let i = 0; i < cls.length; i += 1) {
      const c = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, cls[i] ?? 0));
      const o = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, obj[i] ?? 0));
      const score = Math.sqrt(c * o);
      if (score < minScore) continue;
      const row = Math.floor(i / cols);
      const col = i % cols;
      const cx = (col + (bbox[i * 4] ?? 0)) * stride;
      const cy = (row + (bbox[i * 4 + 1] ?? 0)) * stride;
      const w = Math.exp(bbox[i * 4 + 2] ?? 0) * stride;
      const h = Math.exp(bbox[i * 4 + 3] ?? 0) * stride;
      boxes.push({ x: cx - w / 2, y: cy - h / 2, w, h, score });
    }
  });
  return boxes;
}

/** Splits a frame into `n` overlapping tiles along its long side. */
export function tiles(
  frame: Frame,
  n: number,
  overlap: number,
): Array<{ x: number; y: number; frame: Frame }> {
  const horizontal = frame.width >= frame.height;
  const long = horizontal ? frame.width : frame.height;
  const size = Math.ceil(long / n) + overlap;
  const out: Array<{ x: number; y: number; frame: Frame }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 1) {
    const start = Math.max(0, Math.min(long - size, i * Math.ceil(long / n) - overlap / 2));
    const x = horizontal ? start : 0;
    const y = horizontal ? 0 : start;
    const w = horizontal ? size : frame.width;
    const h = horizontal ? frame.height : size;
    const data = new Uint8Array(w * h * 3);
    for (let row = 0; row < h; row += 1) {
      const from = ((y + row) * frame.width + x) * 3;
      data.set(frame.data.subarray(from, from + w * 3), row * w * 3);
    }
    out.push({ x, y, frame: { data, width: w, height: h } });
  }
  return out;
}

export class YunetFaceDetector implements Detector {
  readonly name = 'face-yunet';
  readonly enabled = true;
  private readonly session: ort.InferenceSession;
  private readonly minScore: number;

  private constructor(session: ort.InferenceSession, minScore: number) {
    this.session = session;
    this.minScore = minScore;
  }

  static async load(modelPath: string, minScore = 0.5): Promise<YunetFaceDetector> {
    const session = await ort.InferenceSession.create(modelPath, { intraOpNumThreads: 2 });
    return new YunetFaceDetector(session, minScore);
  }

  /**
   * Whole frame plus overlapping tiles along the long side: downscaling a 1280 px frame to
   * 640 px halves small faces below YuNet's ~10 px floor, tiles keep them near full size.
   */
  async detect(frame: Frame): Promise<Box[]> {
    const boxes = await this.detectOnce(frame);
    const long = Math.max(frame.width, frame.height);
    if (long > INPUT * 1.25) {
      for (const tile of tiles(frame, 2, 64)) {
        for (const b of await this.detectOnce(tile.frame))
          boxes.push({ ...b, x: b.x + tile.x, y: b.y + tile.y });
      }
    }
    return nms(boxes, 0.3);
  }

  private async detectOnce(frame: Frame): Promise<Box[]> {
    const { tensor, scale } = letterboxBgr(frame, INPUT);
    const result = await this.session.run({
      input: new ort.Tensor('float32', tensor, [1, 3, INPUT, INPUT]),
    });
    const pick = (name: string) => result[name]?.data as Float32Array;
    const boxes = decodeYunet(
      {
        cls: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`cls_${s}`)),
        obj: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`obj_${s}`)),
        bbox: STRIDES.map((s) => pick(`bbox_${s}`)),
      },
      this.minScore,
    );
    return nms(boxes, 0.3).map((b) => ({
      x: b.x / scale,
      y: b.y / scale,
      w: b.w / scale,
      h: b.h / scale,
      score: b.score,
    }));
  }
}
```

```ts
import { hostname } from 'node:os';
import { z } from 'zod';

const bool = z.enum(['true', 'false']).transform((v) => v === 'true');

const schema = z.object({
  DATABASE_URL: z.string().regex(/^postgres(ql)?:\/\//),
  SUPABASE_URL: z.url(),
  SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: z.string().min(20),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY: z.string().min(20),
  VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY: z.string().min(20),
  VAPID_SUBJECT: z.string().regex(/^(mailto:|https:\/\/)/),
  NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: z.url().default('http://localhost:3000'),
  WORKER_ID: z.string().min(1).default(hostname()),
  WORKER_CONCURRENCY: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(8).default(1),
  DETECT_EVERY: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(2),
  FACE_BLUR_ENABLED: bool.default(true),
  FACE_MODEL_PATH: z.string().default('models/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx'),
  PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED: bool.default(false),
  PLATE_MODEL_PATH: z
    .string()
    .optional()
    .transform((v) => v || undefined),
  POLL_INTERVAL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(500).default(10_000),
  OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(500).default(15_000),
});

export type WorkerEnv = z.infer<typeof schema>;

/** Validated at startup: the worker refuses to run with an incomplete configuration. */
export const loadEnv = (source: NodeJS.ProcessEnv = process.env): WorkerEnv => schema.parse(source);
```

```ts
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import pg from 'pg';
import { createPlateDetector } from './blur/plates.ts';
import { DisabledDetector, type Detector } from './blur/types.ts';
import { YunetFaceDetector } from './blur/yunet.ts';
import { loadEnv } from './env.ts';
import { claimJob, runJob, type JobDeps } from './jobs.ts';
import { Notifier } from './notify.ts';
import { storageClient } from './storage.ts';

const env = loadEnv();
const log = (msg: string, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>
  console.log(
    JSON.stringify({ t: new Date().toISOString(), worker: env.WORKER_ID, msg, ...extra }),
  );

async function loadDetectors(): Promise<Detector[]> {
  const detectors: Detector[] = [];
  if (env.FACE_BLUR_ENABLED) {
    if (!existsSync(env.FACE_MODEL_PATH))
      throw new Error(`face model missing: ${env.FACE_MODEL_PATH}`);
    detectors.push(await YunetFaceDetector.load(env.FACE_MODEL_PATH));
  } else {
    detectors.push(new DisabledDetector('face'));
  }
  detectors.push(await createPlateDetector(env.PLATE_BLUR_ENABLED, env.PLATE_MODEL_PATH));
  return detectors;
}

async function main() {
  const db = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: env.DATABASE_URL, max: env.WORKER_CONCURRENCY + 2 });
  const deps: JobDeps = {
    db,
    storage: storageClient(env),
    detectors: await loadDetectors(),
    detectEvery: env.DETECT_EVERY,
    log,
  };
  log('worker started', {
    detectors: deps.detectors.map((d) => `${d.name}:${d.enabled ? 'on' : 'off'}`),
  });

  let wake: (() => void) | undefined;
  const nap = (ms: number) =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, ms);
      wake = () => {
        clearTimeout(timer);
        resolve();
      };
    });

  // LISTEN gives near-instant pickup; polling covers missed notifications and scheduled retries.
  const listener = new pg.Client({ connectionString: env.DATABASE_URL });
  await listener.connect();
  await listener.query('listen media_jobs');
  listener.on('notification', () => wake?.());

  let stopping = false;
  const stop = () => {
    stopping = true;
    wake?.();
  };
  process.on('SIGTERM', stop);
  process.on('SIGINT', stop);

  const jobLoop = async (slot: number) => {
    while (!stopping) {
      try {
        const job = await claimJob(db, `${env.WORKER_ID}#${slot}`);
        if (job) await runJob(job, deps);
        else await nap(env.POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
      } catch (error) {
        log('job loop error', { error: String(error) });
        await nap(env.POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
      }
    }
  };

  const notifier = new Notifier(db, env, log);
  const outboxLoop = async () => {
    while (!stopping) {
      try {
        while ((await notifier.drain()) > 0) {
          /* drain until empty */
        }
      } catch (error) {
        log('outbox error', { error: String(error) });
      }
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, env.OUTBOX_INTERVAL_MS));
    }
  };

  await Promise.all([
    ...Array.from({ length: env.WORKER_CONCURRENCY }, (_, i) => jobLoop(i)),
    outboxLoop(),
  ]);
  await listener.end();
  await db.end();
  log('worker stopped');
}

main().catch((error) => {
  console.error(error);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

```ts
import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import type { Detector } from './blur/types.ts';
import { NonRetryableError } from './media/ffmpeg.ts';
import { blurAndTranscode } from './media/pipeline.ts';
import { RAW_BUCKET, VIDEO_BUCKET, removePaths } from './storage.ts';

export interface MediaJob {
  id: number;
  video_id: string | null;
  kind: 'process' | 'purge';
  payload: { raw_path?: string; paths?: string[] };
  attempts: number;
  max_attempts: number;
}

export interface JobDeps {
  db: Pool;
  storage: SupabaseClient;
  detectors: Detector[];
  detectEvery: number;
  log: (msg: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
}

export async function claimJob(db: Pool, workerId: string): Promise<MediaJob | null> {
  const { rows } = await db.query<MediaJob>('select * from public.claim_media_job($1)', [workerId]);
  return rows[0] ?? null;
}

async function processVideo(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  const { rows } = await deps.db.query<{ status: string; raw_path: string | null }>(
    'select status, raw_path from public.videos where id = $1',
    [job.video_id],
  );
  const video = rows[0];
  if (!video || video.status !== 'processing' || !video.raw_path) {
    // Withdrawn or already handled meanwhile: nothing to do.
    await deps.db.query('select public.complete_job($1)', [job.id]);
    return;
  }
  const dir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'nl-'));
  try {
    const { data, error } = await deps.storage.storage.from(RAW_BUCKET).download(video.raw_path);
    if (error || !data) throw new Error(`download failed: ${error?.message ?? 'empty'}`);
    const input = join(dir, 'input');
    const output = join(dir, 'output.mp4');
    const poster = join(dir, 'poster.jpg');
    await writeFile(input, Buffer.from(await data.arrayBuffer()));

    const started = Date.now();
    const stats = await blurAndTranscode(input, output, poster, {
      detectors: deps.detectors,
      detectEvery: deps.detectEvery,
    });

    const videoPath = `${job.video_id}.mp4`;
    const posterPath = `${job.video_id}.jpg`;
    for (const [path, file, type] of [
      [videoPath, output, 'video/mp4'],
      [posterPath, poster, 'image/jpeg'],
    ] as const) {
      const { error: upErr } = await deps.storage.storage
        .from(VIDEO_BUCKET)
        .upload(path, await readFile(file), { contentType: type, upsert: true });
      if (upErr) throw new Error(`upload ${path}: ${upErr.message}`);
    }
    await deps.db.query('select public.complete_process_job($1, $2, $3)', [
      job.id,
      videoPath,
      posterPath,
    ]);

    // The unblurred original is deleted as soon as the processed version is live.
    try {
      await removePaths(deps.storage, [video.raw_path]);
    } catch (e) {
      await deps.db.query(
        "insert into public.media_jobs (video_id, kind, payload) values ($1, 'purge', jsonb_build_object('paths', array[$2::text]))",
        [job.video_id, video.raw_path],
      );
      deps.log('raw removal deferred to a purge job', { job: job.id, error: String(e) });
    }
    deps.log('video processed', {
      job: job.id,
      video: job.video_id,
      ms: Date.now() - started,
      ...stats,
    });
  } finally {
    await rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  }
}

async function purge(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  await removePaths(deps.storage, job.payload.paths ?? []);
  await deps.db.query('select public.complete_job($1)', [job.id]);
  deps.log('files purged', { job: job.id, count: job.payload.paths?.length ?? 0 });
}

export async function runJob(job: MediaJob, deps: JobDeps): Promise<void> {
  try {
    if (job.kind === 'process') await processVideo(job, deps);
    else await purge(job, deps);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    if (error instanceof NonRetryableError) {
      await deps.db.query('update public.media_jobs set attempts = max_attempts where id = $1', [
        job.id,
      ]);
    }
    const { rows } = await deps.db.query<{ fail_media_job: string }>(
      'select public.fail_media_job($1, $2)',
      [job.id, message],
    );
    deps.log('job failed', {
      job: job.id,
      kind: job.kind,
      outcome: rows[0]?.fail_media_job,
      error: message,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import type { Readable } from 'node:stream';

export interface Probe {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  durationS: number;
  hasAudio: boolean;
  rotation: number;
}

/** Errors that retrying cannot fix (corrupt or out-of-spec media): the job fails at once. */
export class NonRetryableError extends Error {}

async function collect(stream: Readable): Promise<string> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  for await (const c of stream) chunks.push(c as Buffer);
  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
}

export async function run(cmd: string, args: string[]): Promise<void> {
  const child = spawn(cmd, args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe'] });
  const stderr = collect(child.stderr);
  const [code] = (await once(child, 'close')) as [number];
  if (code !== 0) throw new Error(`${cmd} exited ${code}: ${(await stderr).slice(-1500)}`);
}

export async function probe(path: string): Promise<Probe> {
  const child = spawn('ffprobe', [
    '-v',
    'error',
    '-print_format',
    'json',
    '-show_streams',
    '-show_format',
    path,
  ]);
  const [out, err] = await Promise.all([collect(child.stdout), collect(child.stderr)]);
  const [code] = (await once(child, 'close')) as [number];
  if (code !== 0) throw new NonRetryableError(`unreadable media: ${err.slice(-500)}`);
  const info = JSON.parse(out) as {
    streams: Array<{
      codec_type: string;
      width?: number;
      height?: number;
      tags?: { rotate?: string };
      side_data_list?: Array<{ rotation?: number }>;
    }>;
    format: { duration?: string };
  };
  const video = info.streams.find((s) => s.codec_type === 'video');
  if (!video?.width || !video.height) throw new NonRetryableError('no video stream');
  const sideRotation = video.side_data_list?.find((d) => d.rotation !== undefined)?.rotation;
  return {
    width: video.width,
    height: video.height,
    // MediaRecorder WebM files often lack a duration header; 0 means "unknown".
    durationS: Number(info.format.duration ?? 0) || 0,
    hasAudio: info.streams.some((s) => s.codec_type === 'audio'),
    rotation: Number(video.tags?.rotate ?? sideRotation ?? 0),
  };
}

/** Output size: at most 720p on the short side, even dimensions (H.264 requirement). */
export function targetSize(
  width: number,
  height: number,
  rotation: number,
): { width: number; height: number } {
  const rotated = Math.abs(rotation) % 180 === 90;
  const w = rotated ? height : width;
  const h = rotated ? width : height;
  const scale = Math.min(1, 720 / Math.min(w, h), 1280 / Math.max(w, h));
  const even = (n: number) => Math.max(2, Math.round((n * scale) / 2) * 2);
  return { width: even(w), height: even(h) };
}

export const FPS = 30;
export const MAX_DURATION_S = 31;
```

`apps\worker\src\media\pipeline.ts`:

```ts
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { once } from 'node:events';
import { BoxTracker } from '../blur/tracker.ts';
import { pixelate } from '../blur/pixelate.ts';
import type { Box, Detector, Frame } from '../blur/types.ts';
import { FPS, MAX_DURATION_S, NonRetryableError, probe, run, targetSize } from './ffmpeg.ts';

export interface PipelineOptions {
  detectors: Detector[];
  /** Run detectors every N frames; the tracker covers frames in between. */
  detectEvery: number;
}

export interface PipelineResult {
  frames: number;
  detectedFrames: number;
  maxBoxes: number;
}

/**
 * raw (WebM/MP4, any codec) → decoded RGB frames at 30 fps (≤720p, rotation applied) →
 * detection + tracking + pixelation in memory → H.264/AAC MP4 (+faststart) and a JPEG poster
 * taken from the blurred output. The unblurred pixels never reach the output file.
 */
export async function blurAndTranscode(
  input: string,
  output: string,
  poster: string,
  opts: PipelineOptions,
): Promise<PipelineResult> {
  const info = await probe(input);
  if (info.durationS > MAX_DURATION_S) throw new NonRetryableError(`too long: ${info.durationS}s`);
  const { width, height } = targetSize(info.width, info.height, info.rotation);
  const frameBytes = width * height * 3;
  const maxFrames = MAX_DURATION_S * FPS;

  // ffmpeg auto-rotates by default, so decoded frames are already upright.
  const decoder = spawn(
    'ffmpeg',
    [
      '-v',
      'error',
      '-i',
      input,
      '-vf',
      `fps=${FPS},scale=${width}:${height}:flags=bicubic,format=rgb24`,
      '-f',
      'rawvideo',
      '-pix_fmt',
      'rgb24',
      'pipe:1',
    ],
    { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] },
  );

  const encoderArgs = [
    '-v',
    'error',
    '-y',
    '-f',
    'rawvideo',
    '-pix_fmt',
    'rgb24',
    '-s',
    `${width}x${height}`,
    '-framerate',
    String(FPS),
    '-i',
    'pipe:0',
  ];
  if (info.hasAudio)
    encoderArgs.push(
      '-i',
      input,
      '-map',
      '0:v:0',
      '-map',
      '1:a:0',
      '-c:a',
      'aac',
      '-b:a',
      '96k',
      '-ac',
      '2',
    );
  else encoderArgs.push('-map', '0:v:0');
  encoderArgs.push(
    '-c:v',
    'libx264',
    '-preset',
    'veryfast',
    '-crf',
    '26',
    '-pix_fmt',
    'yuv420p',
    '-profile:v',
    'main',
    '-movflags',
    '+faststart',
    '-shortest',
    output,
  );
  const encoder = spawn('ffmpeg', encoderArgs, { stdio: ['pipe', 'ignore', 'pipe'] });

  const errors: string[] = [];
  decoder.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => errors.push(d.toString()));
  encoder.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => errors.push(d.toString()));
  const encoderClosed = once(encoder, 'close');
  const decoderClosed = once(decoder, 'close');

  const trackers = opts.detectors.filter((d) => d.enabled).map((d) => ({ d, t: new BoxTracker() }));
  let pending: Buffer = Buffer.alloc(0);
  const result: PipelineResult = { frames: 0, detectedFrames: 0, maxBoxes: 0 };

  const processFrame = async (data: Buffer) => {
    const frame: Frame = { data, width, height };
    const runDetector = result.frames % opts.detectEvery === 0;
    const boxes: Box[] = [];
    for (const { d, t } of trackers) {
      boxes.push(...t.step(runDetector ? await d.detect(frame) : null));
    }
    if (runDetector) result.detectedFrames += 1;
    result.maxBoxes = Math.max(result.maxBoxes, boxes.length);
    pixelate(frame, boxes);
    result.frames += 1;
    if (!encoder.stdin.write(data)) await once(encoder.stdin, 'drain');
  };

  for await (const chunk of decoder.stdout) {
    pending = pending.length ? Buffer.concat([pending, chunk as Buffer]) : (chunk as Buffer);
    while (pending.length >= frameBytes) {
      const frame = Buffer.from(pending.subarray(0, frameBytes));
      pending = pending.subarray(frameBytes);
      if (result.frames >= maxFrames) break;
      await processFrame(frame);
    }
  }
  encoder.stdin.end();
  const [[decCode], [encCode]] = (await Promise.all([decoderClosed, encoderClosed])) as [
    [number],
    [number],
  ];
  if (decCode !== 0 || encCode !== 0)
    throw new Error(`ffmpeg failed (${decCode}/${encCode}): ${errors.join('').slice(-1500)}`);
  if (result.frames === 0) throw new NonRetryableError('no frames decoded');

  await run('ffmpeg', [
    '-v',
    'error',
    '-y',
    '-ss',
    '0.5',
    '-i',
    output,
    '-frames:v',
    '1',
    '-q:v',
    '4',
    poster,
  ]);
  return result;
}
```

```ts
import type { Pool } from 'pg';
import webpush from 'web-push';
import type { WorkerEnv } from './env.ts';

interface OutboxRow {
  id: number;
  kind: 'alert_nearby' | 'video_rejected' | 'video_removed' | 'moderation_warning';
  user_id: string | null;
  video_id: string | null;
  payload: { note?: string };
}

interface Target {
  subscription_id: string;
  endpoint: string;
  p256dh: string;
  auth: string;
}

export interface PushMessage {
  title: string;
  body: string;
  url: string;
  tag: string;
}

/** Texts of system notifications (French UI; the payload stays small and position-free). */
export function alertMessage(captions: string[], videoIds: string[], site: string): PushMessage {
  const first = captions[0]?.trim() || 'Nouvelle alerte';
  return captions.length === 1
    ? {
        title: 'Alerte près de chez vous',
        body: first,
        url: `${site}/v/${videoIds[0]}`,
        tag: 'alerts',
      }
    : {
        title: `${captions.length} alertes près de chez vous`,
        body: `${first} et ${captions.length - 1} autre${captions.length > 2 ? 's' : ''}`,
        url: `${site}/?category=alert`,
        tag: 'alerts',
      };
}

export function noticeMessage(row: OutboxRow, site: string): PushMessage {
  switch (row.kind) {
    case 'video_rejected':
      return {
        title: 'Vidéo non publiée',
        body: 'Le traitement de votre vidéo a échoué. Vous pouvez la refilmer.',
        url: `${site}/me`,
        tag: 'video-status',
      };
    case 'video_removed':
      return {
        title: 'Vidéo retirée',
        body: 'Un modérateur a retiré votre vidéo. Vous pouvez contester la décision.',
        url: `${site}/me/decisions`,
        tag: 'moderation',
      };
    default:
      return {
        title: 'Avertissement de la modération',
        body: row.payload.note || 'Merci de relire les règles de la communauté.',
        url: `${site}/me/decisions`,
        tag: 'moderation',
      };
  }
}

export class Notifier {
  private readonly db: Pool;
  private readonly site: string;
  private readonly log: (msg: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;

  constructor(
    db: Pool,
    env: WorkerEnv,
    log: (msg: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => void,
  ) {
    this.db = db;
    this.site = env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.replace(/\/$/, '');
    this.log = log;
    webpush.setVapidDetails(
      env.VAPID_SUBJECT,
      env.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY,
      env.VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY,
    );
  }

  private async send(target: Target, message: PushMessage): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await webpush.sendNotification(
        { endpoint: target.endpoint, keys: { p256dh: target.p256dh, auth: target.auth } },
        JSON.stringify(message),
        { TTL: 3600, urgency: 'normal' },
      );
    } catch (error) {
      const status = (error as { statusCode?: number }).statusCode;
      if (status === 404 || status === 410) {
        // The browser dropped the subscription: forget it.
        await this.db.query('delete from public.push_subscriptions where id = $1', [
          target.subscription_id,
        ]);
      } else {
        this.log('push failed', { status, error: String(error) });
      }
    }
  }

  /** Drains one batch of the outbox. Alerts of the batch are grouped per user. */
  async drain(): Promise<number> {
    const { rows } = await this.db.query<OutboxRow>('select * from public.claim_outbox(200)');
    if (rows.length === 0) return 0;

    const alertIds = rows
      .filter((r) => r.kind === 'alert_nearby' && r.video_id)
      .map((r) => r.video_id as string);
    if (alertIds.length > 0) {
      const { rows: recipients } = await this.db.query<
        Target & { video_ids: string[]; captions: string[] }
      >('select * from public.claim_alert_recipients($1::uuid[])', [alertIds]);
      await Promise.all(
        recipients.map((r) => this.send(r, alertMessage(r.captions, r.video_ids, this.site))),
      );
      this.log('alerts pushed', { alerts: alertIds.length, devices: recipients.length });
    }

    for (const row of rows.filter((r) => r.kind !== 'alert_nearby' && r.user_id)) {
      const { rows: targets } = await this.db.query<Target>(
        'select * from public.user_push_targets($1)',
        [row.user_id],
      );
      await Promise.all(targets.map((t) => this.send(t, noticeMessage(row, this.site))));
    }
    return rows.length;
  }
}
```

```ts
import { groupByBucket } from '@nl/shared';
import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { WorkerEnv } from './env.ts';

export { RAW_BUCKET, VIDEO_BUCKET, bucketFor, isProtected } from '@nl/shared';

export const storageClient = (env: WorkerEnv): SupabaseClient =>
  createClient(env.SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });

/** Deletes files grouped by bucket; missing files are not an error. */
export async function removePaths(client: SupabaseClient, paths: string[]): Promise<void> {
  for (const [bucket, list] of groupByBucket(paths)) {
    const { error } = await client.storage.from(bucket).remove(list);
    if (error) throw new Error(`storage remove ${bucket}: ${error.message}`);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { expand, iou, letterboxBgr, nms } from './blur/geometry.ts';
import { pixelate } from './blur/pixelate.ts';
import { createPlateDetector, decodeYoloSingleClass } from './blur/plates.ts';
import { BoxTracker } from './blur/tracker.ts';
import { decodeYunet, tiles } from './blur/yunet.ts';
import { loadEnv } from './env.ts';
import { targetSize } from './media/ffmpeg.ts';
import { alertMessage, noticeMessage } from './notify.ts';
import { bucketFor, isProtected } from './storage.ts';

const box = (x: number, y: number, w = 10, h = 10, score = 0.9) => ({ x, y, w, h, score });

describe('geometry', () => {
  it('computes IoU', () => {
    expect(iou(box(0, 0), box(0, 0))).toBe(1);
    expect(iou(box(0, 0), box(20, 20))).toBe(0);
    expect(iou(box(0, 0), box(5, 0))).toBeCloseTo(50 / 150);
  });

  it('suppresses overlapping boxes keeping the best score', () => {
    const kept = nms([box(0, 0, 10, 10, 0.6), box(1, 1, 10, 10, 0.9), box(50, 50)], 0.3);
    expect(kept).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(kept[0]?.score).toBe(0.9);
  });

  it('expands boxes symmetrically', () => {
    expect(expand(box(10, 10, 10, 20), 0.25)).toMatchObject({ x: 7.5, y: 5, w: 15, h: 30 });
  });

  it('letterboxes into a BGR CHW tensor', () => {
    const data = new Uint8Array(4 * 2 * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) data.set([200, 100, 50], i * 3); // RGB
    const { tensor, scale } = letterboxBgr({ data, width: 4, height: 2 }, 8);
    expect(scale).toBe(2);
    const plane = 64;
    expect(tensor[0]).toBeCloseTo(50); // B plane first
    expect(tensor[plane]).toBeCloseTo(100);
    expect(tensor[2 * plane]).toBeCloseTo(200);
    expect(tensor[7 * 8 + 7]).toBe(0); // padding below the 8×4 image
  });
});

describe('YuNet decoding', () => {
  it('decodes a single confident anchor at stride 32', () => {
    const empty = (n: number, k = 1) => new Float32Array(n * k);
    const cls32 = empty(400);
    const obj32 = empty(400);
    const bbox32 = empty(400, 4);
    const idx = 3 * 20 + 5; // row 3, col 5
    cls32[idx] = 0.81;
    obj32[idx] = 1;
    bbox32.set([0.5, 0.5, Math.log(2), Math.log(3)], idx * 4);
    const boxes = decodeYunet(
      {
        cls: [empty(6400), empty(1600), cls32],
        obj: [empty(6400), empty(1600), obj32],
        bbox: [empty(6400, 4), empty(1600, 4), bbox32],
      },
      0.5,
    );
    expect(boxes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(boxes[0]?.score).toBeCloseTo(0.9);
    // cx = (5 + .5) * 32 = 176, w = 64 → x = 144; cy = 112, h = 96 → y = 64
    expect(boxes[0]?.x).toBeCloseTo(144);
    expect(boxes[0]?.y).toBeCloseTo(64);
    expect(boxes[0]?.w).toBeCloseTo(64);
    expect(boxes[0]?.h).toBeCloseTo(96);
  });
});

describe('tiles', () => {
  it('covers the long side with overlapping tiles and keeps pixel offsets', () => {
    const width = 1280;
    const height = 4;
    const data = new Uint8Array(width * height * 3);
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x += 1) data[x * 3] = x % 251;
    const [a, b] = tiles({ data, width, height }, 2, 64);
    expect(a?.x).toBe(0);
    expect(a?.frame.width).toBe(704);
    expect((b?.x ?? 0) + (b?.frame.width ?? 0)).toBe(1280);
    // first pixel of tile b equals the source pixel at its offset
    expect(b?.frame.data[0]).toBe((b?.x ?? 0) % 251);
  });
});

describe('plates', () => {
  it('decodes a YOLO single-class head', () => {
    const anchors = 3;
    const data = new Float32Array(5 * anchors);
    data.set([100, 0, 0], 0); // cx
    data.set([50, 0, 0], anchors); // cy
    data.set([40, 0, 0], 2 * anchors); // w
    data.set([20, 0, 0], 3 * anchors); // h
    data.set([0.8, 0.1, 0.2], 4 * anchors); // score
    const boxes = decodeYoloSingleClass(data, anchors, 0.35);
    expect(boxes).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(boxes[0]).toMatchObject({ x: 80, y: 40, w: 40, h: 20 });
  });

  it('is disabled unless explicitly enabled with a model', async () => {
    expect((await createPlateDetector(false, '/x.onnx')).enabled).toBe(false);
    expect((await createPlateDetector(true, undefined)).enabled).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('tracker', () => {
  it('keeps blurring a face for ttl frames after the detector loses it', () => {
    const t = new BoxTracker({ ttl: 3, margin: 0 });
    expect(t.step([box(10, 10)])).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(t.step(null)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(t.step([])).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(t.step(null)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(t.step(null)).toHaveLength(0);
  });

  it('follows a moving face between detections', () => {
    const t = new BoxTracker({ margin: 0 });
    t.step([box(0, 0)]);
    t.step(null);
    t.step([box(4, 0)]); // moved 4 px over 2 frames
    const predicted = t.step(null)[0];
    expect(predicted?.x).toBeGreaterThan(4);
    expect(t.step([box(6, 0)])).toHaveLength(1); // same track, no duplicate
  });

  it('applies the privacy margin', () => {
    const t = new BoxTracker({ margin: 0.25 });
    expect(t.step([box(10, 10, 20, 20)])[0]).toMatchObject({ x: 5, y: 5, w: 30, h: 30 });
  });
});

describe('pixelate', () => {
  it('replaces pixels inside the box by block means and leaves the rest untouched', () => {
    const width = 16;
    const height = 8;
    const data = new Uint8Array(width * height * 3);
    for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 1) data[i] = (i * 37) % 256;
    const before = Uint8Array.from(data);
    pixelate({ data, width, height }, [box(0, 0, 8, 8)], 2);
    const px = (arr: Uint8Array, x: number, y: number) =>
      Array.from(arr.subarray((y * width + x) * 3, (y * width + x) * 3 + 3));
    expect(px(data, 0, 0)).toEqual(px(data, 3, 3)); // same 4×4 block
    expect(px(data, 0, 0)).not.toEqual(px(before, 0, 0));
    expect(px(data, 12, 4)).toEqual(px(before, 12, 4));
  });

  it('clamps boxes outside the frame', () => {
    const data = new Uint8Array(4 * 4 * 3).fill(10);
    expect(() => pixelate({ data, width: 4, height: 4 }, [box(-10, -10, 100, 100)])).not.toThrow();
  });
});

describe('media helpers', () => {
  it('caps output at 720p with even dimensions and honours rotation', () => {
    expect(targetSize(1920, 1080, 0)).toEqual({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
    expect(targetSize(1920, 1080, 90)).toEqual({ width: 720, height: 1280 });
    expect(targetSize(641, 361, 0)).toEqual({ width: 642, height: 362 });
  });

  it('routes paths to buckets and protects demo media', () => {
    const user = '7b0f8f9e-6c2d-4c1a-9a51-3b6c1c3e2f10';
    const video = '1b0f8f9e-6c2d-4c1a-9a51-3b6c1c3e2f10';
    expect(bucketFor(`${user}/${video}.webm`)).toBe('raw-videos');
    expect(bucketFor(`${video}.mp4`)).toBe('videos');
    expect(isProtected('demo/clip-1.mp4')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('notifications', () => {
  it('groups alerts into one message', () => {
    expect(alertMessage(['Fuite d’eau'], ['a'], 'https://x').url).toBe('https://x/v/a');
    const grouped = alertMessage(['Fuite', 'Panne', 'Chien'], ['a', 'b', 'c'], 'https://x');
    expect(grouped.title).toBe('3 alertes près de chez vous');
    expect(grouped.body).toBe('Fuite et 2 autres');
  });

  it('builds moderation notices without position data', () => {
    const msg = noticeMessage(
      {
        id: 1,
        kind: 'moderation_warning',
        user_id: 'u',
        video_id: 'v',
        payload: { note: 'Floutez la plaque' },
      },
      'https://x',
    );
    expect(msg.body).toBe('Floutez la plaque');
  });
});

describe('env', () => {
  const base = {
    DATABASE_URL: 'postgresql://u:p@h:5432/db',
    SUPABASE_URL: 'http://localhost:1',
    SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: 'x'.repeat(30),
```

`docs\ARCHITECTURE.md`:

```md
# Architecture — Neighbors Live

Plan court, choix figés pour l'exécution. Les justifications de dépendances sont dans `DECISIONS.md`.

## Vue d'ensemble
```

Navigateur (PWA Next.js) Supabase (Postgres+PostGIS, Auth, Storage, Realtime, pg_cron)
┌─────────────────────────┐ HTTPS ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Caméra (MediaRecorder) │──TUS upload──▶ │ Storage: raw-videos (privé, upload owner) │
│ Feed / Carte / Modé │ │ videos (privé, lecture via URL signée)│
│ IndexedDB (file offline)│ │ Tables + RLS, RPC SQL, triggers │
│ Service worker (Serwist)│◀─Realtime──────│ Broadcast « alerts:<h3 r7> » (payload public) │
└──────────┬──────────────┘ └───────────────┬──────────────────────────────┘
│ fetch /api/* (cookies SameSite, Origin vérifié) │ pg (service, SKIP LOCKED + LISTEN)
┌──────────▼──────────────┐ ┌───────────────▼──────────────┐
│ Route handlers Next.js │──service role─▶│ Worker Node (Docker) │
│ validation Zod, géo, H3,│ │ ffmpeg + onnxruntime-node │
│ URL signées, rate limit │ │ media_jobs, notification_outbox│
└─────────────────────────┘ └──────────────────────────────┘

```

## Flux principaux

**Publication**

1. Client : enregistre ≤ 30 s (`MediaRecorder`, `mimeType` détecté : `video/mp4` Safari,
   `video/webm;codecs=vp9/vp8` sinon), relève la position (`enableHighAccuracy`), refuse si
   précision > 100 m.
2. `POST /api/videos` : Zod (catégorie, légende ≤ 140, lat/lng/accuracy, `expires_at` événement),
   cohérence position (bornes, précision, pas de saut physiquement impossible depuis la dernière
   publication de l'auteur), rate limit, calcul `h3_cell` (h3-js, rés. 8) → insère `videos`
   (`status='processing'`) et renvoie `video_id` + chemin d'upload `raw-videos/<uid>/<video_id>`.
3. Client : upload TUS résumable (Supabase Storage) avec le JWT de l'utilisateur ; policy storage :
   insertion uniquement dans son propre dossier, pas de lecture.
4. Trigger sur `storage.objects` (bucket `raw-videos`) → insère `media_jobs(kind='process')` et
   `pg_notify`.
5. Hors ligne : la vidéo + métadonnées vont dans IndexedDB ; au retour réseau, la position est
   relevée à nouveau et la publication n'est rejouée que si elle reste à < 100 m de la position
   d'origine avec une précision ≤ 100 m.

**Traitement (worker)**

- Boucle : `LISTEN media_jobs` + polling de secours ; prise de job via
  `UPDATE … WHERE id = (SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1)`.
- Pipeline : ffmpeg décode en `rawvideo rgb24` (720p max, fps conservé) → détection (interface
  `Detector`, visages YuNet ONNX une image sur 3 + suivi IoU/interpolation entre détections) →
  pixellisation des boîtes en mémoire → ffmpeg ré-encode H.264 + AAC (audio de la source) + poster.
- Succès : upload `videos/<video_id>.mp4` + poster, `status='active'`, suppression de l'original
  `raw-videos`. Échec : retries backoff exponentiel (3 tentatives), puis `status='rejected'` +
  notification à l'auteur.
- Détecteur de plaques : même interface, désactivé par flag tant qu'aucun modèle fiable n'est
  intégré (état réel documenté dans `PRIVACY.md`).
- Le worker traite aussi `notification_outbox` (envoi Web Push VAPID, regroupement, limite de
  fréquence) et les jobs `purge` (suppression des fichiers des vidéos expirées/supprimées/comptes
  supprimés).

**Lecture (feed / carte)**

- `GET /api/feed?lat&lng&radius&category&cursor` → RPC `nearby_videos` (SECURITY DEFINER,
  `ST_DWithin` sur `geography`, `status='active' AND expires_at > now()`), tri par score
  (fraîcheur décroissante pondérée par « utile » et distance), pagination par curseur opaque
  (`score,id`). La route signe en lot les URL vidéo/poster (TTL court) avec la clé service.
- La position de la requête n'est ni stockée ni journalisée.
- Carte : `GET /api/map` (même RPC, format GeoJSON) ; MapLibre GL, clustering côté source GeoJSON,
  style de tuiles via `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL`.
- Temps réel : trigger à l'activation d'une alerte → `realtime.send` sur le topic
  `alerts:<cellule H3 rés. 7>` avec un payload public uniquement (id, catégorie, position floutée).
  Le client s'abonne aux cellules couvrant son rayon. Pas de `postgres_changes` sur `videos`.

## Vie privée de la position

- `videos.location` exacte stockée (nécessaire à `ST_DWithin`), **privilèges de colonne révoqués**
  pour `anon`/`authenticated` : seules les fonctions SECURITY DEFINER y accèdent.
- Position publique = point accroché à une grille de ~50 m + décalage déterministe par vidéo
  (hash de l'id), calculée en SQL (`public_point(video)`). Distances renvoyées arrondies à 100 m
  pour empêcher la trilatération.
- Aucune position utilisateur persistée hors `push_subscriptions` (zone choisie = centre d'une
  cellule H3, jamais la position brute).

## Modèle de données (résumé)

`profiles` (pseudo unique, bio, couleur avatar, rôle `user|merchant|admin`, réputation, banni,
réglages) · `videos` · `media_jobs` · `reactions` · `comments` · `reports` (unique par
vidéo+reporter) · `moderation_actions` (append-only : aucun UPDATE/DELETE, même service) ·
`appeals` · `zone_moderators(user_id, h3_cell)` · `push_subscriptions` · `merchant_profiles` ·
`rate_limits(key, window_start, count)` · `notification_outbox`.

Fonctions : `nearby_videos`, `expire_videos` (pg_cron toutes les 5 min), `apply_report_threshold`
(trigger sur `reports` : 3 reporters distincts → `hidden`), `is_zone_moderator`,
`moderator_eligible`, `check_rate_limit`, `moderate_video`, `resolve_appeal`, `delete_my_account`.

## Rôles et autorisations

| Rôle               | Mécanisme                                                       |
| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| anon               | lecture des pages publiques uniquement ; feed via route serveur |
| user               | RLS `auth.uid()` sur ses lignes                                 |
| merchant           | `profiles.role='merchant'` + `merchant_profiles` ; quota N/jour |
| modérateur de zone | ligne `zone_moderators` pour la cellule H3 de la vidéo          |
| admin              | `profiles.role='admin'` ; peut annuler toute décision, bannir   |

Le rôle est lu en base (fonctions `is_admin()`, `is_zone_moderator(cell)`), jamais depuis un claim
modifiable par le client.

## Web

- Next.js App Router, TS strict, Tailwind. `next-intl` sans préfixe d'URL (locale en cookie/réglage),
  `fr` par défaut, `en` prêt.
- `@supabase/ssr` (cookies) pour l'auth par e-mail et mot de passe ; pseudo à l'inscription et
  callback PKCE pour les liens de confirmation ou de récupération.
- Mutations sensibles par route handlers (vérif `Origin`, Zod, rate limit) ; lectures simples via
  RPC/RLS.
- Serwist : precache de l'app shell, `NetworkFirst` pour l'API, `CacheFirst` pour les images et
  tuiles, **pas de cache des vidéos signées**, page `/offline`, mise à jour douce (bannière
  « nouvelle version »).
- En-têtes : CSP stricte (nonce), HSTS, `X-Content-Type-Options`, `Referrer-Policy`,
  `Permissions-Policy` (caméra/micro/géoloc en `self`).

## Tests

- Vitest : `packages/shared` (géo, schémas), route handlers (Supabase mocké au niveau client),
  worker (détecteur, tracker, pixellisation, retries).
- pgTAP (`supabase test db`) : chaque policy RLS par rôle, chaque fonction SQL.
- Playwright : Chromium avec `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` + fichier `.y4m`, géolocalisation
  simulée, lecture des e-mails de confirmation/récupération dans Mailpit (Supabase local).

## Local / déploiement

- Local : `pnpm db:start` = Supabase CLI (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Realtime, Mailpit) + migrations +
  `seed.sql` + génération/upload des médias de démo + `docker compose up worker`. `pnpm dev` = web.
- Cible de production envisagée : Supabase Cloud, web sur Vercel, worker sur Fly.io ; le guide de
  déploiement reste à écrire et à vérifier.

```

`docs\DECISIONS.md`:

```md
# Décisions et dépendances

Chaque dépendance ajoutée est listée ici avec sa justification. Versions exactes dans les
`package.json`.

## Décisions structurantes

| Date       | Décision                                                             | Raison                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 2026-10-25 | TypeScript 6.0 (et non 7.0)                                          | `typescript-eslint` 8.x supporte TS < 6.1 ; TS 7 (portage Go) n'est pas encore pris en charge par l'outillage lint.                                                 |
| 2026-10-25 | ESLint 9.39 (et non 10)                                              | `eslint-config-next` 16 embarque `eslint-plugin-react` / `import` non garantis sous ESLint 10.                                                                      |
| 2026-10-25 | Pas d'étape de build pour `@nl/shared`                               | Sources TS importées directement : Next via `transpilePackages`, le worker via le _type stripping_ natif de Node ≥ 22.18 (`erasableSyntaxOnly`). Moins d'outillage. |
| 2026-10-25 | H3 calculé côté application (h3-js), pas en SQL                      | L'extension `h3-pg` n'est pas garantie sur Supabase Cloud. La cellule est calculée et validée côté serveur.                                                         |
| 2026-10-25 | Table `notification_outbox` en plus du modèle demandé                | Découple les déclencheurs SQL (alerte activée, vidéo rejetée) de l'envoi Web Push fait par le worker ; reste « dans Postgres, sans file externe ».                  |
| 2026-10-25 | Temps réel par Broadcast (`realtime.send`) et non `postgres_changes` | `postgres_changes` sur `videos` exposerait la colonne de position exacte.                                                                                           |
| 2026-10-25 | Locale par cookie, pas de préfixe d'URL                              | Une PWA installée garde une seule URL de démarrage ; la langue est un réglage utilisateur.                                                                          |
| 2026-10-25 | Tuiles par défaut : OpenFreeMap                                      | Gratuit, sans clé, données OSM ; remplaçable via `NEXT_PUBLIC_MAP_STYLE_URL`.                                                                                       |

## Dépendances

### Racine (dev)

| Paquet                                                                       | Raison                                                                                         |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `eslint`, `@eslint/js`, `typescript-eslint`, `eslint-config-next`, `globals` | Lint imposé ; règles Next/React/a11y.                                                          |
| `prettier`                                                                   | Formatage imposé.                                                                              |
| `husky`, `lint-staged`                                                       | Hooks pre-commit imposés ; lint/format des seuls fichiers indexés.                             |
| `typescript`                                                                 | TS strict.                                                                                     |
| `supabase`                                                                   | CLI Supabase en devDependency (non installée globalement) : `db:start`, migrations, `test db`. |
| `@playwright/test`                                                           | E2E imposés.                                                                                   |

### `@nl/shared`

| Paquet                        | Raison                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `zod`                         | Validation imposée (formulaires, API, env, jobs).       |
| `h3-js`                       | Index H3 imposé pour les quartiers.                     |
| `vitest`, `@types/node` (dev) | Tests unitaires imposés ; types de `Buffer` (curseurs). |

### `@nl/web`

| Paquet                                           | Raison                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `next`, `react`, `react-dom`                     | Stack imposée.                                                                                                                        |
| `next-intl`                                      | i18n imposée.                                                                                                                         |
| `@serwist/turbopack`, `serwist`, `esbuild` (dev) | Service worker imposé (Serwist) ; la variante Turbopack est requise par Next 16 (Turbopack par défaut) et compile le SW avec esbuild. |
| `@supabase/supabase-js`, `@supabase/ssr`         | Client Supabase + session par cookies côté serveur (App Router).                                                                      |
| `maplibre-gl`                                    | Carte imposée.                                                                                                                        |
| `tus-js-client`                                  | Upload résumable (TUS, supporté nativement par Supabase Storage) : reprise après coupure réseau.                                      |
| `idb`                                            | Surcouche promesse d'IndexedDB (~1 ko) pour la file de publication hors ligne.                                                        |
| `tailwindcss`, `@tailwindcss/postcss`            | Style imposé.                                                                                                                         |

## Changements de décision

| Date       | Décision                                                                 | Raison                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 2026-10-25 | Authentification par **e-mail + mot de passe** (au lieu du lien magique) | Demande du porteur du projet. Inscription avec pseudo dans le même formulaire, connexion, « mot de passe oublié » par e-mail (flux PKCE via `/auth/callback` → `/reinitialiser`). Politique : 8 à 72 caractères, au moins une lettre et un chiffre (bcrypt tronque au-delà de 72 octets). Limitation de débit par IP et par e-mail haché sur inscription, connexion et réinitialisation ; messages qui ne révèlent pas l'existence d'un compte. Si la confirmation d'e-mail est activée sur le projet Supabase, l'inscription demande de cliquer le lien de confirmation. Comptes de démo locaux : mot de passe `voisins2026`. |
```

```md
# Progression — Neighbors Live

Légende : ⬜ à faire · 🟨 en cours · ✅ fait (codé + tests verts) · 🟢 vérifié (exécuté réellement dans
l'app) · ⚠️ écart documenté.
Règle : rien n'est 🟢 sans exécution réelle. Les écarts sont décrits dans la colonne « Notes ».

Dernière mise à jour : 2026-10-25 — lecteur du feed avec états de chargement/échec et nouvel essai URL, navigation admin contextualisée, recherche utilisateur par pseudo/UUID, pagination serveur et confirmations ajoutées ; contrôles bloqués par dépendances manquantes dans l’environnement. Audit contenu/UX et roadmap documentés ; clarification des
textes, onboarding raccourci, page publique commerçante, lisibilité du feed, reprise hors ligne
explicite et tableau de bord d’administration enrichi, avec file des vidéos en traitement. Typecheck,
lint, 47 tests unitaires, E2E ciblé et build réussis.

| Page publique de présentation commerçant                   | ✅   | `/commerces`, chemin de demande redirigé vers l’espace connecté ; E2E réussi                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

| Contexte des alertes et consigne d’urgence                 | ✅   | Alerte communautaire distinguée d’une alerte officielle ; appel au 112 rappelé ; E2E                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

| Tableau de bord d’administration                           | ✅   | File des vidéos `processing` (20 plus anciennes, auteur, date, état et tentatives du job) ; E2E vérifié                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Navigation, recherche et protections de l’administration   | 🟨   | Ancres de section responsive ; recherche pseudo/UUID et pagination serveur utilisateurs ; journal filtrable par action, acteur UUID et type de cible avec pagination ; confirmations commerce/sanction/révocation ; contrôle atomique des décisions commerce avec migration et assertion pgTAP. Les nouvelles modifications ne sont pas validées par TypeScript, ESLint, Vitest, pgTAP ou Playwright : liens `node_modules` cassés, cache hors ligne incomplet et accès réseau au registre refusé. |
| États de chargement du lecteur du feed                     | 🟨   | Affiche un état de chargement, une erreur compréhensible et un nouvel essai si l’URL signée manque ou échoue ; récupération automatique limitée à une tentative. Scénario E2E ajouté mais non exécuté faute des dépendances Playwright.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Mentions juridiques finales                                | ⬜   | Coordonnées et sous-traitants réels à fournir ; validation juridique requise                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Direction visuelle complète et tests utilisateurs          | ⬜   | Non réalisée ; à prototyper et tester sur appareils physiques                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |

## Limites connues

- Caméra/micro et push : testés uniquement dans Chromium desktop avec périphériques simulés ;
  aucun iPhone ni Android physique dans cet environnement.
- Le volet navigateur de l'outil de dev bloque caméra et géolocalisation : vérifications faites via
  Playwright et le paramètre `?lat=&lng=`.
- Le guide d’installation PWA est désormais facultatif dans l’onboarding, mais reste accessible
  directement depuis le réglage push.
```

`packages\shared\scripts\gen-seed.mjs`:

```mjs
// Generates supabase/seed.sql (deterministic): 3 neighbourhoods of Paris, 14 accounts
// (10 residents, 2 zone moderators, 1 admin, 1 merchant), ~40 live videos, reports, comments.
// Usage: node packages/shared/scripts/gen-seed.mjs > supabase/seed.sql
import { gridDisk, latLngToCell } from 'h3-js';

// Local demo password shared by every seeded account (documented in README; never in production).
const DEMO_PASSWORD = 'voisins2026';
const ZONE_RES = 8;
const RT_RES = 7;

// mulberry32: tiny deterministic PRNG so the seed is reproducible.
let state = 20261025;
const rand = () => {
  state |= 0;
  state = (state + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
  let t = Math.imul(state ^ (state >>> 15), 1 | state);
  t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
  return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
};
const pick = (arr) => arr[Math.floor(rand() * arr.length)];
const uuid = (n) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, '0')}`;
const vid = (n) => `10000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, '0')}`;
const q = (s) => `'${String(s).replaceAll("'", "''")}'`;

const hoods = [
  { key: 'belleville', name: 'Belleville', lat: 48.8722, lng: 2.3767 },
  { key: 'batignolles', name: 'Batignolles', lat: 48.8848, lng: 2.3184 },
  { key: 'butte', name: 'Butte-aux-Cailles', lat: 48.827, lng: 2.35 },
];

const users = [
  { n: 1, username: 'admin_nl', email: 'admin@neighbors.test', role: 'admin', days: 120, rep: 100 },
  {
    n: 2,
    username: 'modo_belleville',
    email: 'modo.belleville@neighbors.test',
    days: 90,
    rep: 45,
    mod: 'belleville',
  },
  {
    n: 3,
    username: 'modo_batignolles',
    email: 'modo.batignolles@neighbors.test',
    days: 75,
    rep: 38,
    mod: 'batignolles',
  },
  {
    n: 4,
    username: 'boulangerie_bello',
    email: 'boulangerie@neighbors.test',
    role: 'merchant',
    days: 40,
    rep: 12,
    merchant: 'Boulangerie de Belleville',
  },
  ...['lea', 'karim', 'sophie', 'tom', 'ines', 'hugo', 'nadia', 'paul', 'chloe', 'yanis'].map(
    (u, i) => ({
      n: 5 + i,
      username: u,
      email: `${u}@neighbors.test`,
      days: 5 + i * 3,
      rep: i,
    }),
  ),
];

const captions = {
  alert: [
    'Fuite d’eau sur le trottoir, attention en passant',
    'Rue barrée suite à un accident',
    'Chien perdu sans collier, très gentil',
    'Coupure de courant dans tout l’immeuble',
  ],
  deal: [
    'Primeur : cagettes de tomates à 2 € avant fermeture',
    'Vide-grenier improvisé en bas de chez moi',
    'Livres gratuits dans la boîte à partage',
    'Fin de marché : herbes fraîches offertes',
  ],
  event: [
    'Concert gratuit dans le square ce soir',
    'Atelier réparation vélo à la maison de quartier',
    'Fête des voisins dans la cour',
    'Projection plein air au parc',
  ],
  help: [
    'Je cherche quelqu’un pour arroser mes plantes ce week-end',
    'Qui peut prêter une perceuse ?',
    'Aide pour monter un frigo au 4e sans ascenseur',
    'Cours de soutien en maths, entraide entre parents',
  ],
  lost: [
    'Clés trouvées près de la boulangerie',
    'Doudou lapin bleu retrouvé sur un banc',
    'Écharpe rouge oubliée au café',
    'Carte de bibliothèque trouvée',
  ],
  shop: ['-20 % sur les viennoiseries jusqu’à 11 h', 'Nouvelle fournée de pain au levain'],
};
const clipFor = { alert: 1, deal: 2, event: 3, help: 4, lost: 5, shop: 6 };
const lifetimeHours = { alert: 6, deal: 48, event: 30, help: 168, lost: 168, shop: 24 };

const lines = [];
const out = (s) => lines.push(s);

out('-- GENERATED by packages/shared/scripts/gen-seed.mjs — do not edit by hand.');
out('-- Demo data only. Accounts sign in with email and password.');
out('');

// --- Accounts -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
out(
  'insert into auth.users (id, instance_id, aud, role, email, encrypted_password, email_confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at, raw_app_meta_data, raw_user_meta_data, confirmation_token, recovery_token, email_change_token_new, email_change_token_current, email_change, phone_change, phone_change_token, reauthentication_token) values',
);
out(
  users
    .map(
      (u) =>
        `  (${q(uuid(u.n))}, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', 'authenticated', 'authenticated', ${q(u.email)}, extensions.crypt(${q(DEMO_PASSWORD)}, extensions.gen_salt('bf')), now(), now() - interval '${u.days} days', now(), '{"provider":"email","providers":["email"]}', '{}', '', '', '', '', '', '', '', '')`,
    )
    .join(',\n') + ';',
);
out('');
out(
  'insert into auth.identities (id, user_id, provider_id, provider, identity_data, created_at, updated_at, last_sign_in_at) values',
);
out(
  users
    .map(
      (u) =>
        `  (${q(uuid(u.n))}, ${q(uuid(u.n))}, ${q(uuid(u.n))}, 'email', jsonb_build_object('sub', ${q(uuid(u.n))}, 'email', ${q(u.email)}, 'email_verified', true), now(), now(), now())`,
    )
    .join(',\n') + ';',
);
out('');
for (const u of users) {
  out(
    `update public.profiles set username = ${q(u.username)}, role = ${q(u.role ?? 'user')}, reputation = ${u.rep}, created_at = now() - interval '${u.days} days' where id = ${q(uuid(u.n))};`,
  );
}
out(
  `update public.user_settings set onboarded_at = now() where user_id in (${users.map((u) => q(uuid(u.n))).join(', ')});`,
);
out(
  `update public.profiles set bio = 'Je modère Belleville. Bienveillance avant tout.' where id = ${q(uuid(2))};`,
);
out(
  `update public.profiles set bio = 'Pain au levain et viennoiseries depuis 1987.' where id = ${q(uuid(4))};`,
);
out('');
const merchant = users.find((u) => u.merchant);
out(
  `insert into public.merchant_profiles (user_id, business_name, description, status, reviewed_by) values (${q(uuid(merchant.n))}, ${q(merchant.merchant)}, 'Boulangerie artisanale rue de Belleville', 'approved', ${q(uuid(1))});`,
);
out('');

// --- Videos ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const videoRows = [];
const zoneCells = { belleville: new Set(), batignolles: new Set(), butte: new Set() };
let vn = 0;
const residents = users.filter((u) => !u.role && !u.mod);

function addVideo({ author, hood, category, status = 'active', ageMin, lifeH }) {
  vn += 1;
  const r = 700 * Math.sqrt(rand());
  const theta = rand() * 2 * Math.PI;
  const lat = hood.lat + (r * Math.cos(theta)) / 111_320;
  const lng = hood.lng + (r * Math.sin(theta)) / (111_320 * Math.cos((hood.lat * Math.PI) / 180));
  const cell = latLngToCell(lat, lng, ZONE_RES);
  zoneCells[hood.key].add(cell);
  const clip = clipFor[category];
  const hasFiles = status === 'active' || status === 'hidden';
  videoRows.push({
    id: vid(vn),
    author: uuid(author.n),
    category,
    caption: pick(captions[category]),
    lat,
    lng,
    accuracy: Math.round(5 + rand() * 30),
    cell,
    rt: latLngToCell(lat, lng, RT_RES),
    status,
    merchant: category === 'shop',
    ageMin,
    lifeH: lifeH ?? lifetimeHours[category],
    video: hasFiles ? `demo/clip-${clip}.mp4` : null,
    poster: hasFiles ? `demo/clip-${clip}.jpg` : null,
  });
  return vid(vn);
}

const categories = ['alert', 'deal', 'event', 'help', 'lost', 'deal', 'help', 'event'];
for (const hood of hoods) {
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i += 1) {
    const category = categories[i % categories.length];
    const maxAge = Math.min(lifetimeHours[category] * 60 - 30, 30 * 60);
    addVideo({ author: pick(residents), hood, category, ageMin: Math.floor(5 + rand() * maxAge) });
  }
}
// Merchant offers (Belleville).
addVideo({ author: merchant, hood: hoods[0], category: 'shop', ageMin: 45 });
addVideo({ author: merchant, hood: hoods[0], category: 'shop', ageMin: 300 });
// Old clean videos of the moderators (eligibility history), already expired.
for (const mod of users.filter((u) => u.mod)) {
  const hood = hoods.find((h) => h.key === mod.mod);
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i += 1) {
    addVideo({
      author: mod,
      hood,
      category: 'help',
      status: 'expired',
      ageMin: (20 + i) * 24 * 60,
      lifeH: 72,
    });
  }
}

out(
  'insert into public.videos (id, author_id, category, caption, location, public_location, accuracy_m, h3_cell, realtime_cell, status, is_merchant, mime_type, duration_ms, video_path, poster_path, created_at, published_at, expires_at) values',
);
out(
  videoRows
    .map((v) => {
      const point = `extensions.st_setsrid(extensions.st_makepoint(${v.lng.toFixed(6)}, ${v.lat.toFixed(6)}), 4326)::extensions.geography`;
      const created = `now() - interval '${v.ageMin} minutes'`;
      return `  (${q(v.id)}, ${q(v.author)}, ${q(v.category)}, ${q(v.caption)}, ${point}, ${point}, ${v.accuracy}, ${q(v.cell)}, ${q(v.rt)}, ${q(v.status)}, ${v.merchant}, 'video/mp4', 8000, ${v.video ? q(v.video) : 'null'}, ${v.poster ? q(v.poster) : 'null'}, ${created}, ${created}, ${created} + interval '${v.lifeH} hours')`;
    })
    .join(',\n') + ';',
);
out('');

// --- Moderators: every zone cell of their neighbourhood plus its ring ------------------------
const modRows = [];
for (const mod of users.filter((u) => u.mod)) {
  const cells = new Set();
  for (const c of zoneCells[mod.mod]) for (const d of gridDisk(c, 1)) cells.add(d);
  for (const c of [...cells].sort()) modRows.push(`  (${q(uuid(mod.n))}, ${q(c)})`);
}
out('insert into public.zone_moderators (user_id, h3_cell) values');
out(modRows.join(',\n') + ';');
out('');

// --- Interactions ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
const active = videoRows.filter((v) => v.status === 'active');
const reactions = new Set();
for (const v of active) {
  const count = Math.floor(rand() * 5);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
    const u = pick(residents);
    if (uuid(u.n) !== v.author) reactions.add(`  (${q(v.id)}, ${q(uuid(u.n))})`);
  }
}
out('insert into public.reactions (video_id, user_id) values');
out([...reactions].join(',\n') + ';');
out('');

const comments = [
  'Merci pour l’info !',
  'J’y passe tout à l’heure',
  'Super initiative 👏',
  'Toujours d’actualité ?',
  'Bien vu, merci',
];
const commentRows = active.slice(0, 15).map((v, i) => {
  const u = residents[(i + 3) % residents.length];
  return `  (${q(v.id)}, ${q(uuid(u.n))}, ${q(comments[i % comments.length])})`;
});
out('insert into public.comments (video_id, author_id, body) values');
out(commentRows.join(',\n') + ';');
out('');

// Reports: three videos reach the threshold (auto-hidden by trigger), one has a single report.
const reported = [active[1], active[14], active[27]].filter(Boolean);
const reportRows = [];
for (const v of reported) {
  for (const u of residents.filter((r) => uuid(r.n) !== v.author).slice(0, 3)) {
    reportRows.push(`  (${q(v.id)}, ${q(uuid(u.n))}, 'recognizable_person', 'Visage visible')`);
  }
}
const single = active[5];
const singleReporter = residents.find((r) => uuid(r.n) !== single.author);
reportRows.push(`  (${q(single.id)}, ${q(uuid(singleReporter.n))}, 'false_info', '')`);
out('insert into public.reports (video_id, reporter_id, reason, details) values');
out(reportRows.join(',\n') + ';');
out('');
out('-- Rate-limit counters created by the seed itself must not block demo users.');
out('delete from public.rate_limits;');

process.stdout.write(lines.join('\n') + '\n');
```

```ts
export const CATEGORIES = ['alert', 'deal', 'event', 'help', 'shop', 'lost'] as const;
export type Category = (typeof CATEGORIES)[number];

export const RADII_M = [300, 1000, 3000] as const;
export type Radius = (typeof RADII_M)[number];

export const MAX_RECORDING_MS = 30_000;
export const MAX_ACCURACY_M = 100;
export const CAPTION_MAX = 140;
export const COMMENT_MAX = 280;
export const BIO_MAX = 160;
export const MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES = 60 * 1024 * 1024;

/** H3 resolution of moderation zones ("quartiers"), ~0.74 km² per cell. */
export const H3_ZONE_RES = 8;
/** Coarser H3 resolution used for realtime alert topics, ~5 km² per cell. */
export const H3_REALTIME_RES = 7;

const HOUR = 3_600_000;
export const LIFETIME_MS: Record<Exclude<Category, 'event' | 'shop'>, number> = {
  alert: 6 * HOUR,
  deal: 48 * HOUR,
  help: 7 * 24 * HOUR,
  lost: 7 * 24 * HOUR,
};
export const MAX_LIFETIME_MS = 7 * 24 * HOUR;
export const MERCHANT_DURATIONS_H = [6, 24, 48, 72, 168] as const;

export const REPORT_REASONS = [
  'recognizable_person',
  'address_or_plate',
  'dangerous',
  'harassment',
  'spam',
  'false_info',
  'other',
] as const;
export type ReportReason = (typeof REPORT_REASONS)[number];

export const MODERATION_ACTIONS = ['validate', 'hide', 'remove', 'warn'] as const;
export type ModerationAction = (typeof MODERATION_ACTIONS)[number];

export const VIDEO_STATUSES = [
  'processing',
  'active',
  'hidden',
  'removed',
  'expired',
  'rejected',
] as const;
export type VideoStatus = (typeof VIDEO_STATUSES)[number];

export const CATEGORY_COLORS: Record<Category, string> = {
  alert: '#dc2626',
  deal: '#15803d',
  event: '#7c3aed',
  help: '#2563eb',
  shop: '#b45309',
  lost: '#0e7490',
};
```

```ts
import { cellToLatLng, getHexagonEdgeLengthAvg, gridDisk, latLngToCell, UNITS } from 'h3-js';
import { H3_REALTIME_RES, H3_ZONE_RES } from './constants.ts';

export interface LatLng {
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
}

const EARTH_RADIUS_M = 6_371_008.8;
const toRad = (deg: number) => (deg * Math.PI) / 180;

export function haversineMeters(a: LatLng, b: LatLng): number {
  const dLat = toRad(b.lat - a.lat);
  const dLng = toRad(b.lng - a.lng);
  const h =
    Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 +
    Math.cos(toRad(a.lat)) * Math.cos(toRad(b.lat)) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_M * Math.asin(Math.sqrt(h));
}

export function isPlausiblePosition({ lat, lng }: LatLng): boolean {
  if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng)) return false;
  if (lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180) return false;
  // (0,0) is the classic "no fix" value returned by broken GPS stacks.
  return !(Math.abs(lat) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(lng) < 1e-6);
}

/** Rejects moves faster than `maxSpeedMps` (default ~250 km/h) between two publications. */
export function isPlausibleMove(
  prev: LatLng & { at: Date },
  next: LatLng & { at: Date },
  maxSpeedMps = 70,
): boolean {
  const seconds = Math.max(1, (next.at.getTime() - prev.at.getTime()) / 1000);
  return haversineMeters(prev, next) / seconds <= maxSpeedMps;
}

export const zoneCell = ({ lat, lng }: LatLng): string => latLngToCell(lat, lng, H3_ZONE_RES);

export function zoneCenter(cell: string): LatLng {
  const [lat, lng] = cellToLatLng(cell);
  return { lat, lng };
}

/** Realtime topic cells (res 7) whose union covers a disk of `radiusM` around the point. */
export function realtimeCells({ lat, lng }: LatLng, radiusM: number): string[] {
  const edge = getHexagonEdgeLengthAvg(H3_REALTIME_RES, UNITS.m);
  const k = Math.ceil(radiusM / (edge * 1.5)) + 1;
  return gridDisk(latLngToCell(lat, lng, H3_REALTIME_RES), k);
}

export const realtimeCell = ({ lat, lng }: LatLng): string =>
  latLngToCell(lat, lng, H3_REALTIME_RES);

/** Public distances are bucketed to 100 m so they cannot be used to trilaterate a video. */
export const bucketDistance = (meters: number): number =>
  Math.max(100, Math.round(meters / 100) * 100);
```

```ts
import { LIFETIME_MS, MAX_LIFETIME_MS, type Category } from './constants.ts';

export interface LifetimeOptions {
  /** Required for `event`: end of the event. */
  eventEndsAt?: Date | undefined;
  /** Required for `shop`: duration chosen by the merchant. */
  merchantHours?: number | undefined;
}

/** Expiry date of a video; throws if the category-specific option is missing or invalid. */
export function computeExpiresAt(category: Category, now: Date, opts: LifetimeOptions = {}): Date {
  const max = now.getTime() + MAX_LIFETIME_MS;
  if (category === 'event') {
    const end = opts.eventEndsAt?.getTime();
    if (end === undefined || end <= now.getTime() || end > max) {
      throw new RangeError('event_end_invalid');
    }
    return new Date(end);
  }
  if (category === 'shop') {
    const hours = opts.merchantHours;
    if (hours === undefined || hours <= 0 || hours * 3_600_000 > MAX_LIFETIME_MS) {
      throw new RangeError('merchant_duration_invalid');
    }
    return new Date(now.getTime() + hours * 3_600_000);
  }
  return new Date(now.getTime() + LIFETIME_MS[category]);
}
```
